MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE). No upstream dsh code is included.

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: session cost pill in the composer dock, priced with the official CNY peak/off-peak rates.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-spend-pill

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/debug-null/dsh-spend-pill?label=release)](https://github.com/debug-null/dsh-spend-pill/releases/latest)
[![CI](https://github.com/debug-null/dsh-spend-pill/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/debug-null/dsh-spend-pill/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/debug-null/dsh-spend-pill)](LICENSE)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 插件：在输入框下方显示**本次会话已花费的人民币金额**，点击查看明细。

![界面示意](assets/preview.svg)

<sub>界面示意：输入框下方的费用 pill（高亮）与点击后弹出的明细面板。</sub>

## 功能

- 在输入框下方的 composer dock 里增加一个费用 pill：`≈ ¥1.05`，就在系统自带的「轮次/步数」
  「缓存命中 / Token 用量」旁边。
- **点击**弹出明细：模型及其费用、未缓存输入 / 缓存命中输入 / 缓存写入 / 输出的 token 数与金额、
  高峰时段小计、空闲时段小计和合计；按 Esc 或点击弹层外部关闭。
- 按**每次请求结算时的模型和时段**计价：会话中途切换模型、或一轮跨越 12:00 / 14:00 / 18:00
  的峰谷边界，都能正确累加；时段以请求发出时间判定。
- **内置 2026 年法定节假日**：节假日（以及周末）按空闲价计费，不再是简单的「工作日」判断。
- 不联网、不保存任何数据，金额由会话自身的 provider 上报 token 用量推导。

## 安装

目前尚未发布到 npm，直接安装 GitHub Release 里的预构建包：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add \
  https://github.com/debug-null/dsh-spend-pill/releases/latest/download/dsh-spend-pill.tgz
```

Web 界面也可以在 **设置 → 插件 → 安装 bundle** 里粘贴同一个 URL。安装后刷新 Web 页面即可。

## 价格与计费规则

官方价目（人民币 / 百万 tokens，见
[DeepSeek API 文档](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing)）：

| 模型 | 时段 | 缓存命中 | 未命中 | 输出 |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `deepseek-flash` | 高峰 | ¥0.04 | ¥2 | ¥8 |
| `deepseek-flash` | 空闲 | ¥0.02 | ¥1 | ¥4 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | 高峰 | ¥0.30 | ¥9 | ¥27 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | 空闲 | ¥0.15 | ¥4.5 | ¥13.5 |

高峰时段为**北京时间工作日 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00**，其余时间（含周末与法定节假日）按空闲价
（高峰价的一半）计费。内置的 2026 年节假日来自
[国务院办公厅通知](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202511/content_7047091.htm)；2027 年的安排
公布后，用下面的 `holidays` 配置补上即可。旧模型 id `deepseek-v4-flash`、
`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` 按 `deepseek-flash` 计价。

模型没有内置价格时（第三方 provider、未来新模型），按 `fallbackModel`（默认 `deepseek-flash`）
估算，并在弹层里标注「按 deepseek-flash 价格估算」。

## 可选配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖价格、别名、回退模型或节假日表：

```yaml
- id: cost-pill
  name: dsh-spend-pill
  config:
    prices:
      my-model:
        peak: { cacheHit: 0.04, cacheMiss: 2, output: 8 }
        offPeak: { cacheHit: 0.02, cacheMiss: 1, output: 4 }
    aliases:
      my-legacy-model: my-model
    fallbackModel: deepseek-flash
    # 整表替换内置日历，日期为北京时间（YYYY-MM-DD）
    holidays: ['2027-01-01', '2027-02-05', '2027-02-06']
```

`prices` 与 `aliases` 是在内置表上的增量覆盖；`holidays` 是整表替换。配置变化会改变投影的
`stateVersion`，已缓存的历史费用会按新配置重新计算。

## 说明

- 金额是按 provider 上报用量估算的参考值，不是账单；账户余额不在本插件范围内。
- 一段会话里切换过模型时，弹层会分模型列出各自费用，但 token 明细仍按桶汇总。
- 会话还没有产生计费用量时，pill 不显示。

## 开发与测试

```sh
node --check index.js && node --check client.js
node --test
```

`lib/cost.js` 是纯函数计价折叠（不依赖 DSH），`test/cost.test.mjs` 覆盖峰谷边界、节假日、
请求时间判段、同 Turn/Step 替换、重试、旧模型别名、第三方模型回退与配置覆盖；GitHub Actions
在每次 push / PR 时运行同样的检查。

---

## English

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI plugin that shows what the current session has cost so far, in
CNY, in the composer dock row — and opens a click-through breakdown dialog.

- Prices every settled assistant attempt with the **official DeepSeek CNY list price for the model
  and the period that attempt ran in** (peak / off-peak, request-time based), including the 2026
  Chinese public-holiday calendar.
- Click the pill for model, uncached input / cache-hit input / cache-write / output tokens with
  amounts, peak and off-peak subtotals, and the total. Escape or an outside click closes it.
- No network requests; figures come from the session's own provider-reported token usage.

### Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add \
  https://github.com/debug-null/dsh-spend-pill/releases/latest/download/dsh-spend-pill.tgz
```

### Pricing

Official list prices in CNY per 1,000,000 tokens
([DeepSeek API docs](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing)): `deepseek-flash`
peak ¥0.04 cache-hit / ¥2 cache-miss / ¥8 output, off-peak half; `deepseek-v4-pro` peak ¥0.30 / ¥9 /
¥27, off-peak half. Peak is Beijing time, weekdays 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, excluding the
built-in 2026 public holidays; everything else bills off-peak.

Models without a built-in price are estimated at the `fallbackModel` price and the dialog says so.
Prices, aliases, the fallback model and the holiday list can be overridden through the plugin
`config` in `cordis.patch.yml`.

### Development

```sh
node --check index.js && node --check client.js
node --test
```

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

## 相关链接

- 掘金文章：[给 DeepSeek Harness 写费用插件：把「这次会话花了多少钱」算准](https://juejin.cn/spost/7697150457639108662)

plugins.description: 关掉后关于子代理的提示词整块消失，「子智能体」卡片也不再显示；打开后卡片回来，提示词只在会话里确实有子代理时才注入。
plugins.readme_text:
# @local/dsh-subagent-gate —— 原生子代理总开关

设置 → **通用设置** 里的一行开关（`settings.general.item`，order 95，在"上传 Session Log"下面）。

## 行为

| 开关 | 效果 |
|---|---|
| **关** | ① 不注入任何子代理提示词；② 往 profile 补丁写一条自维护的禁用块（见下），把 `ui-settings-subagent`、`ui-subagent` 两行停掉 → **插件页里的「子智能体」卡片消失**，会话里的子代理卡片 UI 也不再加载 |
| **开** | ① 上面那条禁用块被自动撤掉，卡片回来；② 只有**该会话确实有子代理记录**时才注入提示词；③ 无记录的会话一个字的提示词都不给 |

注入的提示词（开关打开 + 会话有记录时）：

```
[原生子代理] 本会话有 N 条子代理记录（本机原生子代理已关闭）：
- 写作子代理 [done]
- 校对子代理 [running]
说明：subagent / subagent_fork / list_agents 等原生工具在本机不存在，不要调用它们，也不要假装派过子代理。
需要派子代理时用免费桥接：freesub_run(task="…")（Qoder CN 的免费模型）。
用户问起这些历史记录时，照实说明原生子代理已被总开关关闭。
```

> 措辞就是上面这段；不满意的直接改 `index.js` 里 `systemPrompt.context(...)` 的 `text()` 返回值。

## 它写进 profile 补丁的东西（自维护块）

```yaml
# === subagent-gate: begin（由「原生子代理总开关」自动维护，勿手改）===
- id: ui-settings-subagent
  disabled: true
- id: ui-subagent
  disabled: true
# === subagent-gate: end ===
```

关 → 写入；开 → 撤掉。补丁文件是活的，写完立即重载，**不需要重启**。

## 验收记录（2026-10-16）

| 场景 | 实测 |
|---|---|
| 关：插件行被停掉 | 网页启动载荷里 `dsh-client-ui-settings-subagent` / `dsh-client-ui-subagent` 出现次数 **0** |
| 开：复原 | 两者回到 **5**，禁用块被自动删除，补丁回到基线 67 行 |
| 开 + 会话有子代理记录 | 注入上方那段提示词 |
| 开 + 会话无记录 | 注入内容 = `""` |
| 关 | 注入内容 = `""` |

## 边界（重要）

本开关只管**提示词**与**插件页可见性**，**不会**把原生"派子代理"的能力重新打开：
真正派子代理还需要 `subagent` 行的 `maxDepth > 0`，以及 `tool-subagent` 等工具行启用。
如果哪天想要"打开=真的能派"，那是第二条档位，需要显式再加（目前故意不做，因为原生子代理很贵）。

## 机制订正 + 踩坑（2026-10-16 二次修订）

设置页那行能不能出现，取决于**宿主 Config 的字段有没有标 `.volatile()`** ——
`dsh-settings` 的原文是："表单只展示活动且可唯一定位的 profile 条目中的 **volatile 字段**"。
没标 = 不会被服务 = 浏览器侧 `configForms.whileServed([namespace])` 永远不成立 = 那行永远不出现。
本插件三个字段现在都是 `.default(...).description(...).volatile()`。

> **踩坑留痕**：第一版照着另一个插件抄了
> `settings.installSection(ctx, name, Config, config, {...})`，**这个方法在 DSH 里根本不存在**
> （整个 runtime 零匹配），所以表单一直没被服务。已改成真接口
> （`settings.configure({ auto: false }, ctx.fiber)`，且做了 typeof 守卫）。

**源码改动不热重载**（宿主按路径缓存已加载模块）：本文件的改动需要**重启该实例**才生效。
而 `.volatile()` 字段的**值**改动是热的，改完立刻生效。

## v0.1.2（方案 A：把真相告诉模型）2026-10-16

关掉总开关时注入（每个会话、每次组装提示词）：

    [原生子代理] 本机原生子代理已关闭（总开关处于"关"）。
    不要调用 subagent / subagent_fork / list_agents / send_message / interrupt_agent —— 它们必然失败（maxDepth 0）。
    需要派子代理时用免费桥接：freesub_run(task="…")。

开启时：会话有子代理记录 → 注入历史记录说明；无记录 → 一个字都不注入。

### 为什么不是"把工具删掉"（查证结论，别再试了）

`dsh-tools` 的实现写死了两条约束：

    if (scope === undefined) throw new Error("tools.restrict() requires a scoped context (agent.ctx) …")
    if (unknown.length > 0) throw new Error("tools.restrict() names unknown global tool(s) …")

即：**必须在 agent 作用域调用**，且**只能点名全局工具**。而 `subagent` / `subagent_fork`
是由 **agent preset 平面**（`preset-standard` 的 `plugins` 列表）注册的 scope-local 工具，
既不在全局工具表里、也不在任何外部插件够得着的作用域里 —— **外部插件无法摘掉它们**。
（`agent/request` 也没戏：`LlmCallConfig` 里没有 tools 字段，文档明确"不能改模型可见内容"。）

所以本插件的边界是：**管得住"我注入的提示词"和"插件页可见性"，管不住 preset 给的工具**。
唯一的真删法是覆写 preset 的 plugins 列表，代价是会与「子智能体」设置页抢同一份配置 —— 已明确不做。

### 诊断

`subagent-gate\gate.log`：每次 apply / 开关变化 / 写补丁结果都留痕（这个组合里 `ctx.logger` 不存在，所以写文件）。

### 源码改动仍需重启

`hmr` 的 `root` 已指向本目录，但实测**没有触发热重载**（gate.log 无新 apply 行）。
所以改 `index.js` 后请用桌面「重启 DSH 3080」快捷方式重启一次；**开关值的改动是热的**，不需要重启。

plugins.description: 按路由模型上下文窗口的比例触发自动压缩：比例精确可控，不预留固定余量。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-compact

**按比例精确触发的上下文压缩闸门**（DeepSeek Harness 插件）。

DSH 原生在窗口用掉约 **67.85%** 时就开始压缩；本插件让它等到你设定的比例（默认 **90%**）。

```
触发点 = floor(窗口 × triggerRatio)      ← 没有固定余量扣减
```

## 为什么需要它

DSH 0.2 把压缩引擎挂在 **agent preset** 里，带出厂默认 `thresholdRatio: 0.8` /
`headroomTokens: 65536`。preset 平面**任何 patch 层都够不到**，所以原生触发点是：

```
min(W × 0.8, W − O − 65536)
```

在 1M 窗口 + 256K 输出预留下 = `min(800000, 678464)` = **678,464 = 67.85%**。
你配置的比例从来不是生效的那一项。本插件绕过该公式，用 `floor(W × ratio)` 做闸门。

实现方式：`agentPresets.serviceFor(agent,'compaction')` 取到 preset 作用域的活引擎，
包住它的 `compactIfNeeded`；阈值以下返回 `null`（引擎不被调用），阈值以上原样交还。
`agent/request-error` 的溢出恢复**永不拦截**。

不改 DSH 配置文件、不改 preset、不写盘（除监视器）。**卸载即完全恢复原生行为。**

## 配置

全部走 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（本插件是纯 host 插件，**没有 GUI 设置面板**）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-compact
  config:
    enabled: true
    routes: '*'
    triggerRatio: 0.9
    minOutputReserve: 0
    dryRun: false
    monitorPath: '<log-dir>/dsh-compact-monitor.jsonl'
```

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `routes` | `'*'` | 生效路由：`provider` 或 `provider/model`，逗号/空格分隔 |
| `triggerRatio` | `0.9` | 窗口用到此比例时压缩，范围 `[0.05, 0.98]` |
| `minOutputReserve` | `0` | 输出保护底线（token）：剩余空间低于它则提前压缩；`0` = 关闭 |
| `dryRun` | `false` | `true` = 只记录判定、**绝不压缩** |
| `monitorPath` | 系统临时目录 | 判定监视器（JSONL）。**空则不写** |

### monitorPath 是必要的

被抑制的检查**既不调用引擎、也不写会话事件**，所以在会话日志里完全不可见。
监视器是唯一的观测通道，每行一条判定：

```json
{"decision":"skip","contextWindow":1000000,"reservedCompletionTokens":256000,
 "thresholdTokens":900000,"nativeThresholdTokens":678464,
 "measuredTokens":14113,"surfaceTokens":11864,"pendingTokens":2249}
```

- `thresholdTokens` = 本插件阈值；`nativeThresholdTokens` = DSH 原生阈值
- **`decision:"skip"` 且 `measuredTokens ≥ nativeThresholdTokens`** 即：插件拦下了一次原生本会执行的压缩

## 安装

**只需在插件页装上，不用改任何配置文件。** schema 默认值即目标配置：
`enabled: true`、`triggerRatio: 0.9`、`routes: '*'`、`minOutputReserve: 0`、`dryRun: false`。

命令行等价写法（CLI 会写 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles`）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add 'dsh-compact@file:D:/桌面/DSH与自动化/dsh-compact'
```

要改 `triggerRatio` 等值时才需要在 `profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` 加一行
（本插件是纯 host 插件，**没有 GUI 设置面板**）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-compact
  config:
    triggerRatio: 0.9
```

`monitorPath` 默认 `<DSH_HOME>/logs/dsh-compact-monitor.jsonl`，目录会自动创建。

### 关于热插拔

- **配置改动是热的**：`cordis.patch.yml` 由 `profileReload: live` + HMR 的配置监听生效，无需重启。
- **启用/禁用是热的**：插件页的开关会启用/停用该行。
- **改插件源码不是热的**——因为 base bundle 的 `hmr` 行默认 `root: []`（只监听配置，不监听模块）。
  这对本机所有插件一视同仁。若要让源码也热重载，在 profile patch 里放开监听：

  ```yaml
  - id: hmr
    disabled: false
    config:
      root: ['.', 'D:/桌面/DSH与自动化/dsh-compact']
  ```

## 验证状态

- **31 项测试全过**（策略 11 + host 接线 10 + 验收 10）
- **对照实验已通过**（窗口 80000、输出预留 1000，只改插件比例）：

| | A 组 ratio 0.05 | B 组 ratio 0.9 |
|---|---|---|
| 引擎原生阈值 | 13464 | 13464 |
| 插件阈值 | 4000 | 72000 |
| 实测 | 14063 | 14113 |
| 决策 | delegate | **skip** |
| 会话压缩事件 | **有**（start+summary+end） | **无** |

B 组在实测已超过原生阈值的情况下被拦下，引擎零调用；A 组同样实测下引擎真的压了。

**已知局限**：上述对照在 `W=80000` 下完成；真实 1M 部署走同一代码路径，但未在 1M 下观察到压缩。

## 开发中修掉的三个缺陷（都曾让它静默空转）

| # | 缺陷 | 后果 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `setSource` 整体替换配置 | settings 文档没有 `monitorPath` → 监视器静默失效 |
| 2 | `routedTarget` 只读已记录 envelope | 首个请求前 `config:null` → 闸门永久早退 |
| 3 | 用 `measure(session)` 当压力 | pre-step 时消息未入 surface → **恒为 0，永远放行** |

第 3 个意味着插件在修复前**从未真正抑制过一次压缩**。三个缺陷各有回归测试锁住。

## 测试

```bash
node --test test/policy.test.js test/index.test.js test/acceptance.test.js
```

需要 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 可解析。本目录已有 junction 指向 DSH 依赖树；
装进 profile 后由 DSH 自己的依赖树满足（`verifiedWith: 0.2.0-rc.2`）。

## 边界

- 只拦**自动压力检查**；溢出恢复与手动 `/compact` 不受影响
- **不改剪枝**（`dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner` 是另一个插件）；触发点推后，剪枝也随之推后
- `routes` 为空字符串 = 停用闸门（不干预任何路由），不会回退到 `*`

plugins.description: Enhanced session tree for the DSH sidebar (fork of ui-workspace): tag chips, group-by-tag, drag-to-move across workspaces, delete with backup.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-tree

An enhanced session tree for the DSH sidebar: the official `ui-workspace` tree plus tags, tag grouping, drag-to-move across workspaces, and a delete action that can back sessions up first.

Forked from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` (0.1.7 tree) and shipped as a separate bundle so the official package stays untouched.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| DSH | `0.2.1-rc.2` (developed and tested against it) |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `~4.0.5` |
| React | 18.2+ |
| Mode | Web UI (`web` or `desktop` profile) |
| **Companion** | **[`dsh-session-manager`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-manager) — required for tags, moves and deletes** |

Earlier DSH releases are untested.

## Install

Two packages, in this order:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:minhaoli/dsh-session-manager
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:minhaoli/dsh-session-tree
```

Then **disable the official `ui-workspace` row**, because this package registers the same `uiWorkspace` service:

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- id: ui-workspace
  disabled: true
```

Reload the page after installing — the client half is served as a separate module.

## The session-manager dependency

The browser half does not talk to the host over an IPC bridge. It calls a same-origin REST API under `/api/dsh-session-manager/`:

| Call | Endpoint |
|---|---|
| Read all tags | `GET /api/dsh-session-manager/tags` |
| Write one session's tags | `PUT /api/dsh-session-manager/tags` |
| Delete sessions | `POST /api/dsh-session-manager/sessions/delete` |
| Move sessions | `POST /api/dsh-session-manager/sessions/move` |

Those four endpoints are served by **`dsh-session-manager`**. Without it, `tagRead()` catches the failure and returns `{}` — the tree still renders, but every tag is empty, writes silently do nothing, and drag-to-move / delete fail. If tags look broken, check that `dsh-session-manager` is installed and that its REST routes registered (`webServer` present).

## What it adds to the official tree

| Feature | Where |
|---|---|
| Tag chips on session rows | `sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action` |
| Tag / move / delete menu entries | `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` |
| Grouping the tree by tag | the tree header |
| Drag a session onto another workspace | the session row |
| Archive and unarchive | the row menu (unarchive is the direction the GUI lacks) |

The tag data lives in `~/.dsh/session-tags.json`, written by `dsh-session-manager`, so tags survive restarts and ride along when a session moves across workspaces.

The client polls for tag refreshes every 20 seconds. That is the interval a tag written from another window shows up in this one.

## Implementation notes

- `lib/index.js` is a host-side placeholder — `export default function apply() {}`. The bundle patch mounts both halves in one row, so the host half has to exist for the package to compose.
- `lib/client.js` (≈260 KB, 6015 lines) is the built fork. Its `sourceMappingURL` still points at `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` and the CSS tag keeps `dataset.plugin = "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace"` — that is the upstream provenance, not a bug.
- `client.js` defines `class UiWorkspaceService extends Service` and calls `super(ctx, "uiWorkspace")`. That is why the official row must be disabled: two registrations of `uiWorkspace` cannot coexist.
- The package mounts into `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`, `sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action` and `shell.overlay`, and injects the official client packages it builds on (`dsh-api-remotes`, `dsh-api-session-controller`, `dsh-api-workspace-controller`, `dsh-client-connection`, `dsh-client-locale`, `dsh-client-shortcuts`, `dsh-client-ui-conversation`, `dsh-client-ui-layout`, `dsh-client-ui-renderer`, `dsh-client-ui-session`, `dsh-client-ui-sidebar`).

## Companion plugins

- [`dsh-session-manager`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-manager) — **required**: the REST API this tree reads and writes.
- [`dsh-session-query-vector`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-query-vector) — semantic session search backend.
- [`dsh-session-search`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-search) — in-conversation find bar.
- [`dsh-ui-reload`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-ui-reload) — one-click frontend reload button.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE). The bundled client code derives from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace`; keep the upstream license terms in mind when redistributing.

plugins.description: Configurable Canvas text backgrounds with multilingual glyphs, gradient palettes, ripples, and a draggable tuning panel.
plugins.readme_text:
# 字间 · Glyph Studio

## DSH 插件版

本项目是文字背景效果的独立编辑器，可调节文字、配色和动画参数。
用于 DeepSeek Harness 的版本见
[逍遥游 · Glyph Water 插件](https://github.com/Aimer779/dsh-xiaoyaoyou)。
插件仅在新建会话页显示背景，进入普通对话后自动关闭。
安装包与兼容版本见[插件发布页](https://github.com/Aimer779/dsh-xiaoyaoyou/releases)。
需要安装 DSH 插件时，请使用插件仓库；本仓库用于调参与效果开发。

可配置的本地文字背景工具。使用 Canvas 2D，无需安装依赖。

## 打开

用浏览器直接打开 `index.html`。
也可在此目录运行 `python -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1`，
然后打开 http://127.0.0.1:8765 。

## 内容

- 内置《逍遥游》、ASCII、英文、日文四种预设。
- 在“内容”页编辑文字，点击“应用文字”更新背景。
- “排列方式”支持按输入顺序或随机打乱；两种模式均循环铺满网格。
- 随机排列保留字符及重复次数，不逐帧跳字。“重新打乱”生成新排列。
- 排列方式与随机种子随配置保存，刷新和导入后可恢复。
- 支持混合语言和组合字符，空白不占格，标点保留。
- Unicode 字形使用 `Intl.Segmenter` 分段，不拆分组合附标或 emoji 序列。
- 自定义内容最多 4000 个 UTF-16 代码单元、512 种字形，以限制图集内存。
- 衬线、无衬线、等宽字体使用系统字体；可显示字符取决于系统字体覆盖范围。
- 内容以固定网格逐字循环铺排，不是段落排版。

## 配色

“配色”页提供雾白、墨夜、青瓷、暮紫、暖砂预设。
每个预设只更改配色，保留内容与动画参数。

- 背景支持三色线性或径向渐变，以 Oklab 插值。
- 颜色可通过原生调色板或 HEX 输入设置。
- 线性渐变可调角度，径向渐变可调中心位置。
- 中间色位置可调，基础字色和点缀色独立设置。
- 点缀不再限制为蓝色，可用于任何深浅主题。
- 字体和字色更改时重建缓存图集；背景渐变变化不重建图集。

## 面板与配置

面板分为“内容、配色、波纹、背景、点缀、渲染”六页。
滑块与数字框实时同步；问号按钮展开参数说明。
标题栏可拖拽，位置自动保存；“归位”回到右上角。
拖拽手柄支持方向键微调。减号收起，加号展开。
标题、分类和底部操作固定，仅参数区域滚动。
下拉框使用原生 `appearance: base-select` 定制弹层与选项。
保留浏览器的方向键选择、确认、取消及边缘避让行为。
当前内置 Chromium 已验证；不支持该 CSS 的浏览器会使用自身下拉外观。
鼠标点击只改变边框；键盘导航使用细内描边，高对比度模式保留焦点提示。

完整配置包含文字、字体、配色和动画参数，自动保存在本浏览器。
文件地址与 HTTP 地址使用独立存储空间。
“更多”中可导出或导入 JSON；输入无效时拒绝应用。
“恢复默认”重置全部配置。动效预设只调整动画与渲染参数。

## 动效

字形坐标固定，明暗遮罩迁移形成游雾感。
点击留白触发波纹；面板中的“试一次波纹”触发单次预览。
“暂停动效”冻结所有动画。页面隐藏时暂停。
系统开启减少动态效果时显示静态背景。

点缀每轮在显现区域选择不规则的邻字簇：
簇数 0～12、每簇字数 1～12，3 字及以上不共线。
背景面积不足时簇数减少，每个生成簇保持设定字数。
点缀停留时间 0.8～4 秒，实际时长受动画速度倍率影响。
点缀强度为 0 关闭染色；较深波前保留基础字色。

## 实现与验证

- `content.js`：文字、配色预设，字形分段与渐变生成。
- `settings.js`：默认配置、参数范围、导入校验。
- `app.js`：字形图集、固定网格绘制、动画调度。
- `ambient.js`：游雾透明度场。
- `ripple.js`：波前与余波衰减。
- `tint.js`：局部点缀簇。
- `panel.js`、`appearance-panel.js`：调参、内容和配色界面。
- `panel-position.js`：面板拖拽和边界约束。

当前网格为 18×20 CSS px，字号 14px。图集缓存 17 级混合字色。
每字每帧只绘制一次，避免叠画改变透明度。
FPS 是动画回调频率，绘制耗时仅为 JavaScript 提交时间，不含 GPU 完成时间。

运行：

```powershell
node content.test.cjs
node ripple.test.cjs
node ambient.test.cjs
node tint.test.cjs
```

测试覆盖 Unicode 分段、文字与配色校验、配置往返、波纹、固定字形位置、
明暗连续变化、点缀数量与消退。浏览器交互另行检查。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 后台上下文压缩插件：提前准备摘要，减少长对话等待，提供压缩历史、耗时与用量记录。
plugins.readme_text:
# Faster Compress

**让上下文摘要提前准备，少打断一次正在推进的工作。**

中文 · [English](README.en.md)

![Node.js 22.19+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-%E2%89%A522.19-356D50?style=flat-square)
![DSH 0.2.0-rc.2](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-tested_on_0.2.0--rc.2-0A7A78?style=flat-square)
![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-526B7A?style=flat-square)

![原版需要停下来等摘要；Faster Compress 提前在后台生成摘要，到 step 边界再提交。](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GallenShao/dsh-faster-compress/v0.2.2/assets/overview-zh.svg)

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 提供**后台上下文压缩**，减少长任务中停下来等摘要的时间，并通过压缩历史查看结果、耗时和用量。

## 安装，只填一个包名

打开 DSH 侧边栏的 **插件 → 添加插件**，输入：

```text
dsh-faster-compress
```

点击安装，完成后重新启动 DSH。**默认即用，无需 API Key，也不用编辑 YAML。**

已验证 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2**，需要 **Node.js ≥ 22.19**。它沿用当前对话的模型和已有凭据；摘要、预热请求仍按模型服务的规则计费。

<details>
<summary>只用命令行？</summary>

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-faster-compress
```

然后重新启动 `dsh web`。桌面端请使用应用内的“添加插件”。

</details>

## 装上后，改变了什么？

- **边工作，边准备。** 达到准备阈值后，后台生成摘要，主任务在安全余量内继续推进。
- **准备好，就应用。** 在下一次模型请求前替换上下文，保留期间新增的消息；正常回合结束后也会保留摘要，供下一轮校验复用。
- **失败时有兜底。** 摘要失败或失效时回退原生压缩，仍可使用 `/compact`。

## 压缩历史

打开会话顶部的 **压缩历史**，即可查看：

- **内容与状态**：摘要、原文摘录、是否已应用，以及失败原因。
- **耗时**：后台准备、压缩等待与应用后的首输出时间。
- **用量**：压缩前后的实测输入 token，以及摘要请求和缓存用量。

支持搜索、筛选、复制，并跟随 DSH 主题。

## 设置

进入 **插件 → 已安装 → 更快压缩 · Faster Compress**，修改后保存即可生效，无需重启。

| 设置 | 默认值 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 后台准备时机 | **100%** | 摘要经常来不及时可调低；此比例相对于准备阈值，并非上下文容量 |
| 预热新上下文 | **关闭** | 可选的额外请求，适合服务有余力且能复用缓存时尝试 |
| 显示压缩历史标签 | **开启** | 显示或隐藏会话中的历史页 |

通常保持默认即可。高级选项可调整输出预留、安全余量和并发数；升级保留已有设置。

## 使用须知

- 适合长对话和频繁工具调用。后台摘要仍占用模型资源并按服务商规则计费，不能保证消除所有等待。
- 未应用的摘要只保存在内存中。重启后会重新准备，或回退原生压缩。
- 历史会在 `$DSH_HOME/data/faster-compress/traces/` 保存摘要与原文摘录。隐藏标签页不会停止记录；清理这些副本时，先停止 DSH，再删除该目录。

[开发与测试](https://github.com/GallenShao/dsh-faster-compress/blob/main/tests/README.md) · [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md) · [发布记录](https://github.com/GallenShao/dsh-faster-compress/blob/main/RELEASES.md) · [源代码](https://github.com/GallenShao/dsh-faster-compress) · [MIT License](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Delete sessions from the DSH sidebar context menu: the log and replay cache go to the Recycle Bin; live sessions are queued for removal on the next start.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-delete

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

Adds **「删除会话 / Delete session」** to the sidebar's Session context menu in
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) and performs a real,
recoverable deletion.


![Session context menu with the Delete entry](assets/03-session-menu.en.png)

![Confirmation before deleting](assets/04-confirm-dialog.en.png)

## What it does

Hover a session row and click its **⋯** button → **Delete session**.

| Session state | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| **Cold** (not loaded in this app run) | Deleted immediately; its log and replay cache go to the Windows **Recycle Bin** (fallback: `<DSH_HOME>/.session-trash/`). The sidebar list refreshes itself through the client Session controller — no page reload needed. |
| **Live** (the session open right now, or one opened earlier in this run) | DSH exposes no "close a session" API, so the files cannot be removed safely. The plugin offers to **queue** it: `POST /dsh-session-delete/queue` writes `<DSH_HOME>/.session-delete-queue.json`, and the **next start** drains that queue before anything is opened. |

After a restart that removed queued sessions, a small notice in the corner lists
what was deleted (titles, up to five, with a count for the rest) and reports any
entry that could not be removed and stays queued.

## Files removed

For one session id:

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `<DSH_HOME>/sessions/<project>/session-<id>/` | the append-only event log |
| `<DSH_HOME>/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json` | the replay/projection cache |

Nothing else is touched. Attachments are shared, content-addressed blobs and are
deliberately left alone. The Workspace registry keeps its `sessionIds` entry —
the registry has no "unregister a session" API, and the sidebar already skips ids
whose stored session is gone.

## Safety

- A **live** session is refused (`409`); only the queue path can remove it, on the
  next start.
- The HTTP routes sit behind the Host's browser trust fence
  (`connection.requestRejection`) and accept only `session-<uuid>` ids.
- Deletions are recoverable: Recycle Bin, or a stamped directory under
  `<DSH_HOME>/.session-trash/`.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x (the `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` and
  `shell.overlay` slots).
- Windows for Recycle Bin support; on other platforms files fall back to the
  trash directory.

## Install

Listed in the plugin market once the registry entry is merged. Manual install:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:ashulam/dsh-session-delete
# or from a local checkout:
cd <profile dir>
pnpm add file:<path to this repo>
# then add "dsh-session-delete" to dsh.profile.bundles in package.json
```

## Layout

- `lib/index.js` — host half: `POST /dsh-session-delete/delete`,
  `POST /dsh-session-delete/queue`, `GET /dsh-session-delete/last-drain`
  (plus the boot-time queue drain).
- `client/client.js` — browser half: the context-menu entry and the boot notice.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — inserts the host row into the profile.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH 原生多平台账号、模型路由、错峰签到、事件通知与额度预测插件
plugins.readme_text:
# 积分中枢 · DSH Credit Hub

[![Plugin CI](https://github.com/spdw666/dsh-credit-hub/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/spdw666/dsh-credit-hub/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

**DSH 原生多平台账号、模型路由、错峰签到、事件通知与额度预测插件。** 当前发布版 **0.2.1**。

Native DSH account and model routing management with staggered check-ins, event notifications, and measured quota forecasts.

## 安装

使用 [GitHub Release](https://github.com/spdw666/dsh-credit-hub/releases/latest) 中的预构建包，无需在安装时重新构建前端：

```sh
dsh plugin add https://github.com/spdw666/dsh-credit-hub/releases/latest/download/dsh-credit-hub.tgz
```

也可通过 GitHub 源安装；仓库已提交 `lib/` 与引擎必要预构建文件：

```sh
dsh plugin add github:spdw666/dsh-credit-hub
```

市场条目使用同一稳定 tarball 地址。市场收录须经维护方 PR 审核；仓库有 Release 不等于已经收录。

### 运行条件

- 宿主提供官方 `@deepseek-ai/*` 与 React，不打包或替换一份 DSH。
- 独立 worker 需要 **Node >=22.23.3 且支持 `node:sqlite`**。优先使用显式配置，其后检测现有 task runtime、DSH 自带独立 Node、PATH。每个候选会真实执行 SQLite 内存查询，Electron 命令包装器不当作独立 Node。
- 默认数据位于 DSH 用户目录的 `plugins/credit-hub`。可通过插件配置指定 `taskRoot`、`configFile`、`nodeExecutable`、`allowScheduler`。
- 部分平台另需其登录态、原生身份或独立运行资产。千问办公的特定编码链需要 Python、cryptography、wasmtime；缺少这些平台条件不影响其他平台管理。

## 使用入口

**DSH 设置 → 积分中枢**，包含账户、模型路由、签到任务、用量记录、接力策略、设置。具备主面板/侧栏能力的版本另有侧栏入口，早期版本使用设置入口。

模型提供方 ID 为 `credit-hub`。本插件拥有独立账号快照、SQLite、刷新缓存与日志，不依赖原 AI 积分网关服务；同一官方账号的额度、限流与令牌状态仍是共享上游状态。

## 主要功能

### 后装 Agent 自动发现

默认每 60 秒检查受支持客户端的已知登录位置。可解析的已登录格式会复制到插件独立目录，识别身份，建立账号/上游，再获取实际模型目录；新路由默认启用，可在账户页关闭。原客户端只读，既有账号开关与路由保持。同一身份更新、不同身份新增，新账号不擅自增加签到任务。

候选包含 WorkBuddy、Trae、千问办公、ZCode、MiniMax、Qoder、CodeBuddy、CodeArts、Cline、LobsterAI、Loomy、小浣熊和 OpenCode 的已知版本路径。未安装、未登录、需要独立配置、已接入及目录失败分开呈现。加密 WorkBuddy、Qoder 原生身份、MiniMax lease、OpenCode 独立服务等条件未满足时不会伪装成已接通。SQLite/WAL 与 Trae 身份元数据纳入内容校验。

### 账号与模型

- 账号启用与模型调用资格分开控制；模型调用关闭不代表签到关闭。
- WorkBuddy 国内/国际 JSON、ZIP、workbuddy-switch JSON 先预览再确认导入，支持选择导出；不将此格式冒充所有平台通用格式。
- 模型目录、账号快照接入和真实调用成功分别记录。
- 接力保留完整 messages、tools、tool IDs/results 与输出预算，不为回退裁剪上下文。

### 错峰签到

每平台配置时间窗口、窗口内持久随机预约、启动补跑分散与全局并发上限。启动仅自动补跑当天从未尝试项；失败、未确认和运行中项不因重启重放。自动/手动共享有界队列，同账号串行，支持“今日未签到”、单个/已选/全部补签。跨午夜及 DST 按真实时区时刻处理。

**自动签到默认关闭**。后台发现和版本检查不等于签到；启用排程、手动补签和任务执行是不同操作。

### 事件 → 通知出口

签到失败、凭据 N 天内过期、余额低于阈值、接力触发、连续三次最终请求失败、版本更新，可映射到 DSH 内通知或通用 Webhook/IM 接收器。事件使用固定脱敏摘要、持久队列、去重与有限重试，不外发 token、原始账号身份或完整上游错误正文。

DSH 隐藏/失焦时保留通知，聚焦显示后确认；这是应用内通知，不冒充操作系统推送。Webhook 以 2xx 确认通用 JSON 信封接收，特定 IM 厂商业务码由接收器转换。Webhook 地址/请求头只存本地私有设置，普通快照不返回这些值。

### 额度 burn-down 与预留建议

按最近七天同单位计费数据，或可比较的余额净下降，计算消耗速度、预计耗尽时间和逐账号预留建议：

```text
预计耗尽小时 = 当前同单位余额 / 每小时可测消耗
建议预留 = 每小时消耗 × 距下次签到/续费小时 × 安全系数
建议比例 = 建议预留 / 已知总额度 × 100%
```

默认安全系数 1.25，可逐账号填写续费/补充时间。至少三个有效样本和 24 小时测量跨度；缺测不填零、Token 不换算积分、充值上升不算负消费、陈旧/过期余额不输出精确耗尽时间。显示覆盖率、来源和假设，不冒充完整官方账单。单账号建议不自动覆盖全局接力阈值，超过原引擎 50% 比例上限会明确提示。

### 版本提醒

默认每小时检测发布包 `repository` 对应的 GitHub `package.json.version`，也支持 HTTPS 清单/npm 元数据。发现更高版本进入事件出口，不后台覆盖运行代码。正式市场用户通过市场更新；`link:` 开发安装可收到版本提醒，但不伪装成市场安装。仅改代码而不递增包版本不算新发布。

## 界面示例

以下是实际 React 管理页和独立引擎使用 **SAMPLE 测试数据**的截图，不是任何用户真实账号：

![账号管理](docs/screenshots/accounts-sample.png)

![额度预测](docs/screenshots/forecast-sample.png)

## 兼容证据

已审计 32 个已知官方 tag（0.1.0-rc.7～0.2.1-rc.2）的源码/API，并逐版执行真实 Typert、LLM、PiAiAdapter 模块契约，保留旧 stream 与新版 snapshot/prepare 分支。13 个早期 tag 使用设置页入口。

这不是 32 个完整历史桌面安装验收。完整桌面实际验收宿主为 0.2.1-rc.2；未来版本按能力检测，不预先声称已实测。公开矩阵位于 `test-fixtures/compatibility-matrix.json`。

## 开发

```sh
npm ci --legacy-peer-deps
npm run sdk:install
npm run build
npm test
npm run test:engine
npm run verify
```

`sdk:install` 只用于开发/CI，安装锁定的官方 SDK；生产宿主提供这些接口。Qwen 离线编码测试可设置 `CREDIT_HUB_TEST_PYTHON` 为装有 cryptography/wasmtime 的 Python；未配置的额外平台测试会明确跳过。CI 会安装这些依赖并执行。

`lib/client.js` 使用官方 `__ModuleLoader__`、slots 与 Connection RPC/Typert，无 iframe。发布包保留预构建客户端和 vendor 核心。构建/测试不需要真实账号或上游生成。

## 派生与许可证

独立包名 `dsh-credit-hub`，并非覆盖原项目。引擎派生自 [spdw666/multi-agent-checkin-dsh](https://github.com/spdw666/multi-agent-checkin-dsh) 0.6.0 的 MIT 核心；原生 UI、隔离 worker、发现/通知/预测/调度与兼容集成为本项目实现。保留原许可证和第三方归属，见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)、`engine/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` 与 vendor 许可证。

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: Use domain expertise to rethink goals, methods and prompts. Portable Agent Skill with a DeepSeek Harness bundle.
plugins.readme_text:
# Ambitious Prompt · 进阶提示词设计

[GitHub](https://github.com/sonwe1e/ambitious-prompt) · MIT · Standard Agent Skills format

Install with the open skills CLI:

```sh
npx skills add sonwe1e/ambitious-prompt --skill ambitious-prompt
```

For DeepSeek Harness, the same skill is also available as a native skill-provider bundle. In DSH's **Plugins** page, install `https://github.com/sonwe1e/ambitious-prompt.git#v0.1.0`. The bundle adds its own skill provider without enabling the optional global default mode. It declares compatibility with DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, the tested preview host. If an existing user-level copy has the same name, DSH's provider priority chooses the winning entry; check the loaded source path instead of assuming the new bundle took precedence. See [DSH's official skill provider](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/skill/skill-filesystem/README.md).

The community [DSH market index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next/main/marketplace/index.json) lists this bundle and [Flow Next](https://github.com/sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next), a companion native DSH mode. Agent Skill installation and DSH bundle installation are two distribution options for this same skill; neither automatically changes another user's global instructions.

从用户的零散表达推断可能的真实意图，用专业判断重构目标、工作主线与跨领域方法，再通过少量讨论形成更有雄心、可执行的提示词。用户不必预先知道自己应该做什么。默认中文，也会跟随用户的语言偏好。

A portable Agent Skill that infers intent, contributes domain expertise, and develops ambitious prompts across altitude, depth, and range. Works with Codex, Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness, OpenCode, ZCode, and the China and international editions of WorkBuddy. The skill itself needs no additional runtime or API key; the optional installer uses Python 3.9+.

## 它怎样工作

- 先根据用户的线索提出有实质差异的任务理解，解释推荐，而非等待用户自己定义完整需求。
- 提炼能改变设计的机制、依赖、瓶颈或权衡，让专业判断影响目标、顺序、分支与停止条件，减少执行模型需要重新摸索的关键决策。
- 高度：判断眼前交付物服务于什么结果，并据此改变主线与内容取舍。
- 深度：补上专业人士会做的判断，依据可比证据设定挑战目标，区分硬要求、候选阈值与诊断统计，不用未经校准的数字冒充质量标准。
- 广度：主动引入结果成立所需的相关方法，将内容、教学、视觉或其他专业贡献整合进同一方案。
- 通过具体提案帮助用户形成偏好；产品目的与体验取舍由用户选择或明确委托，专业实现由模型判断，已有选择不重复询问。
- 按本轮意图交付判断、方向建议、提示词或实际成果，让专业认识改变目标、方法和结果。

复杂任务将执行决策与支撑资料分层：主干说明为何这样做、关键前提、何时转向或结束；详细契约、历史背景与必要检查各保留一次，并保持约束力。若撤去专业判断后计划完全不变，就需要重新设计，而不是继续加长清单。已可靠的前提可以沿用，明确的小任务保留原范围，不强行套用审计或工程流程。

证据强弱直接影响行动：历史观察限定适用范围，专业解释保持可检验，未确定的方向保持有条件。模拟策略可能制造观察结果，不能直接代表真实使用；核心能力未验证，也不能靠展示“未知”算作完成。有依据时明确提出进取目标，缺少数值依据时提供具体结果与范围有限的校准路径，保持任务可推进。

例如，“做一篇论文的 PPT”可能服务于方法讲解、专题入门或研究判断。确定适合的目标后，将机制例子、证据比较、教学顺序和视觉层级一起设计。又如推理加速，要利用基准与瓶颈判断提出有依据的进取目标，而不是把“想快多少”交给用户决定。

## 安装

下载或克隆本仓库，在仓库根目录运行：

```sh
python scripts/install.py --agents all --dry-run
python scripts/install.py --agents all
```

也可只安装到选定工具：

```sh
python scripts/install.py --agents claude dsh opencode zcode
python scripts/install.py --agents workbuddy workbuddy-intl
```

macOS/Linux 如果只有 `python3`，将以上 `python` 替换为 `python3`。没有 Python 时，可以把 `skills/ambitious-prompt/` 整个目录复制到下表中的 skills 根目录，并将根目录的 `LICENSE` 和 `NOTICE.md` 一起放入复制后的技能目录。

| Agent | 默认用户级技能目录 | 调用方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Codex | `~/.agents/skills/ambitious-prompt/` | `$ambitious-prompt` |
| Claude Code | `~/.claude/skills/ambitious-prompt/` | `/ambitious-prompt` |
| DeepSeek Harness / dsh | `~/.dsh/skills/ambitious-prompt/` | `/ambitious-prompt` |
| OpenCode | `~/.config/opencode/skills/ambitious-prompt/` | 自然语言要求加载 `ambitious-prompt` skill |
| ZCode | `~/.zcode/skills/ambitious-prompt/` | `$ambitious-prompt` |
| WorkBuddy 国内版 | `~/.workbuddy/skills/ambitious-prompt/` | 自然语言要求加载 `ambitious-prompt` skill |
| WorkBuddy 海外版 / WorkBuddyAI | `~/.workbuddy-ai/skills/ambitious-prompt/` | 自然语言要求加载 `ambitious-prompt` skill |

`~` 表示当前用户的主目录，Windows 通常是 `%USERPROFILE%`。这里的 Claude 指本机 Claude Code；云端 Claude/Cowork 不会自动读取本机安装目录。

安装器遵循 `CODEX_HOME`、`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`、`DSH_HOME`、`OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR` 和 `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` 的对应路径覆盖。若已存在旧版 Codex 安装 `~/.codex/skills/ambitious-prompt/`，会保留该位置，避免再安装一个同名副本。可用 `--home PATH` 指定隔离的用户目录，此时忽略环境变量覆盖。

WorkBuddy 两版使用各自默认目录，安装器不会将通用 `WORKBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR` 同时应用到两版，以免覆盖另一版。自定义数据目录的用户应将技能复制到实际配置目录下的 `skills/`。这两个路径已核对本机 Windows 国内版 5.8.3、海外版 5.8.4 的实现；其他版本或平台应先确认实际目录。

安装器复制技能和许可文件；不会修改 agent 配置，也不会启动模型。重复安装相同文件不会改写它们。发现同名文件内容不同时会在写入前停止；升级时先自行备份并移走旧的 `ambitious-prompt` 目录，再重新安装。各安装目录是副本，后续更改源码不会自动同步。

## 开始使用

显式调用 skill 指定方法，最终交付仍由本轮请求决定：评议交付判断与依据，探索交付有取舍的推荐和必要讨论，提示词编写交付自包含提示词，执行请求交付实际成果。“先评议再修改”会完成两者，普通问答和只要计划的请求也保持各自范围。提到或引用一份执行提示词不等于要求实际执行。

用户启用默认执行模式后，这四类请求都会先在内部完善理解，再直接交付相应结果；不要求展示优化稿，也不增加一次模型调用。简单任务直接给结果和必要下一步，不默认附冗长验收报告；必要检查仍完成，复杂失败和用户要求的交接细节仍保留。

要跨项目默认启用，将 [默认启动规则模板](integrations/default-instructions.md) 中的 `{{SKILL_PATH}}` 替换为本机该 agent 的 `ambitious-prompt/SKILL.md` 绝对路径，再将整个标记区块合并进对应用户级指令入口，保留原有规则：

| Agent | 用户级启动指令 |
| --- | --- |
| Codex | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md`，自定义 `CODEX_HOME` 时使用对应目录 |
| Claude Code | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`，自定义配置目录时使用对应目录 |
| dsh | `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`，未设置时为 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` |
| OpenCode | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md`，自定义配置目录时使用对应目录 |
| ZCode | `~/.zcode/AGENTS.md` |
| WorkBuddy 国内版 | 个性化设置的自定义提示词；本机存于 `~/.workbuddy/app/app-config.json` 的 `personalization.customPrompt` |
| WorkBuddy 海外版 / WorkBuddyAI | 个性化设置的自定义提示词；本机存于 `~/.workbuddy-ai/app/app-config.json` 的 `personalization.customPrompt` |

WorkBuddy 使用产品已有的个性化入口，不依赖未经验证的全局 `AGENTS.md` 路径。优先从设置界面合并规则。若直接编辑配置文件，先备份，保留其他键和已有提示词，再重启客户端并新建任务：上述版本的个性化收集器从内存配置读取，磁盘写入本身不能证明热加载。技能已发现、默认规则已配置与某个会话实际采用规则应分别验证。

这是用户可选的持久偏好；`scripts/install.py` 只安装技能，不替其他用户自动启用。需要关闭时删除两个 `ambitious-prompt-default` 标记之间的整个区块，保留文件其余内容。本轮说“只优化提示词”或“这次按原话做”即可临时覆盖。

启动指令与 skill 内容的刷新机制不同，文件写入不证明旧会话已重新加载。新会话按各客户端配置读取；已有会话可明确要求重新读取对应启动文件和 skill，必要时按客户端说明刷新。加载机制参考：[Codex](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/agent-configuration/agents-md)、[Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory)、[dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/context/agent-instructions/README.md)、[OpenCode](https://opencode.ai/docs/rules/)、[ZCode](https://zcode.z.ai/en/docs/agents)。

Claude Code / dsh：

```text
/ambitious-prompt 我想做一个论文分享，但还没想清楚该讲到什么程度。请根据我的情况提出更好的任务方案，再帮我形成提示词。
```

Codex / ZCode：

```text
$ambitious-prompt 我想用 AI 改善每周做报告的过程。请从我的表达推断目标，用专业知识提出我没想到的改进，再形成提示词。
```

OpenCode 或支持自然语言加载技能的其他 agent：

```text
请加载 ambitious-prompt skill，用专业知识从高度、深度和广度帮我重新设计这个任务，再生成提示词：……
```

Claude Code 中如果刚创建了顶层 skills 目录，可运行 `/reload-skills` 或重新开始会话；ZCode 中在 Settings → Skills 点击 Refresh 并确认启用。其他工具可新建会话后查看技能列表。若不能发现技能，检查自定义安装目录和该工具的 skill 加载功能是否启用。

## 兼容性与验证边界

核心只有标准 YAML frontmatter、Markdown 指令和相对引用。`agents/openai.yaml` 是 Codex 的可选界面元数据，其他 agent 无需使用它。skill 不要求特定提问工具；没有结构化提问工具时，直接通过对话提问。

安装路径和调用方式依据以下官方资料核对；具体加载行为仍取决于已安装版本及配置。通过文件校验不等于已在每个模型中完成多轮效果测试。

- [Codex：Build skills](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/build-skills)
- [Claude Code：Extend Claude with skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills)
- [DSH：Filesystem skill provider](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/skill/skill-filesystem/README.md)
- [DSH：Skill invocation](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/skill/tool-skill/README.md)
- [OpenCode：Agent Skills](https://opencode.ai/docs/skills/)
- [ZCode：Skill](https://zcode.z.ai/en/docs/skill)
- [WorkBuddy：技能安装与管理](https://www.workbuddy.cn/docs/workbuddy/From-Beginner-to-Expert-Guide/Function-Description/Skills-Market)；具体目录与个性化配置另按上述本机版本核对，未据此宣称所有旧会话已热加载。

## 维护与测试

编辑 `skills/ambitious-prompt/SKILL.md` 维护核心指令；交互示例在 `skills/ambitious-prompt/references/dialogue-examples.md`，目标校准方法在同目录的 `expert-calibration.md`。新增的 [任务组织示例](skills/ambitious-prompt/references/task-reframing.md) 展示专业判断如何重组软件收尾、反馈分析与创作任务。不需要将用户的真实对话、材料、凭据或 agent 配置加入本仓库。

```sh
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

测试覆盖安装、重复运行、冲突保护、只预览不写入、自定义路径，以及 WorkBuddy 两版目录隔离和已有设置保留，不运行任何 agent 或消耗模型额度。

效果评估见 [行为评估案例](evals/scenarios.md)，需要观察真实对话和最终提示词。文件结构校验、安装测试或人工编写示例不能证明模型在这些案例上已经通过；执行评估时应保留具体输出与判断依据。

## 来源与许可证

方法框架受 Felix Rieseberg 的
[How to be more ambitious: A tutorial for humans with models](https://felixrieseberg.com/how-to-be-more-ambitious-a-tutorial-for-humans-with-models/)
启发。本项目独立编写访谈流程和示例，未收录原文全文或配图。

项目采用 [MIT License](LICENSE)。具体出处和第三方内容范围见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: delegate one task to your local Reasonix as a subagent (Reasonix 子智能体)
plugins.readme_text:
# Reasonix 子智能体（DeepSeek Harness 插件）

把单个任务从 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）委派给本机的 [Reasonix](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix)。插件页显示为「Reasonix 子智能体」，用法与官方的「Codex 子智能体」「Claude Code 子智能体」一致。

*A DeepSeek Harness plugin that delegates one task to your local Reasonix over the Agent Client Protocol, using Reasonix's native authentication and settings.*

## 前置条件

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**（见[兼容性](#兼容性)）
- 已安装 Reasonix，并且 DSH 宿主能在 PATH 中找到 `reasonix`（Desktop 会读取登录 shell 的 PATH）
- Reasonix 已配置好模型与密钥（`reasonix setup`）。可用 `reasonix doctor` 检查。

## 安装

**Desktop / Web 插件页**：插件 → 添加插件 → 安装第三方插件，填入：

```
github:SivanCola/dsh-subagent-reasonix
```

**命令行**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:SivanCola/dsh-subagent-reasonix
```

装完后重启该 profile（Desktop 需重启应用）。插件默认启用，会给所有 agent 增加全局工具 `subagent_reasonix`。

## 使用

在对话里让 DSH 把任务交给 Reasonix，最好点名工具：

```
用 subagent_reasonix 让 Reasonix 去做：给 src/utils/date.ts 的 formatDate 补单元测试，跑通 npm test 后告诉我结果。
```

1. DSH 调用 `subagent_reasonix`，先返回子智能体 id。
2. Reasonix 在当前会话的工作目录里新建会话，独立完成任务。
3. 完成后，Reasonix 的最终答案作为通知回到对话，DSH 继续回复。

Reasonix 看不到你和 DSH 的对话历史，任务要写完整：路径、要求、怎样算完成。每次委派都是全新会话，不能追问；中间步骤记录在 `~/.reasonix/sessions/`，不回传 DSH。

## 工作方式

纯配置 bundle，没有 JS 代码。`cordis.patch.yml` 插入两行：

- `subagent-reasonix`：DSH 的通用 ACP 提供方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp`，每次委派启动一个新的 `reasonix acp` 进程。
- `tool-subagent-reasonix`：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent`，把它暴露为全局工具 `subagent_reasonix`。

Reasonix 读取自己的 `~/.reasonix` 配置与密钥，所以模型、provider、沙箱、写入范围都沿用 Reasonix 原生设置。ACP 提供方会清理父进程里疑似凭据的环境变量，不影响 Reasonix。

## 调整配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中按 id 覆盖。覆盖会替换整个 `config`，需写全：

```yaml
- id: subagent-reasonix
  config:
    providerName: reasonix
    command: /absolute/path/to/reasonix   # PATH 里找不到 reasonix 时
    args: [acp, --workspace-only, --sandbox-bash, enforce]   # 收紧写入范围与 bash 沙箱
    permission: allow
```

`args` 可用 `reasonix acp --help` 中的参数，例如 `--model`、`--profile economy|balanced|delivery`。

## 安全

`permission: allow` 会自动批准 Reasonix 的所有权限请求（子智能体无人值守），实际边界取决于 Reasonix 自身的沙箱与写入范围设置。如果你的 Reasonix 关闭了 bash 沙箱，子智能体执行的命令不受沙箱限制；需要时按上文加 `--workspace-only --sandbox-bash enforce`。

## 兼容性

依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp` 锁定为 `0.2.1-rc.2`，与 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 匹配。DSH 升级后，此插件需要同步发布新版本。

## 已知问题

- [dsh-external/issues#668](https://github.com/dsh-external/issues/issues/668)：父代理不知道如何等待外部子代理，可能用 `sleep` 阻塞，导致结果晚到。可在请求里加一句「启动后直接结束本轮，等完成通知」。
- [dsh-external/issues#669](https://github.com/dsh-external/issues/issues/669)：DSH 的 ACP 提供方把子智能体的过程说明和最终答案拼在一起回传。

## 许可

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.
