plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | - The `source` argument selects one tool, or omit it to run every source enabled in settings. - The `path` argument selects the workspace root for project-scoped files (defaults to the session workspace; workspace files only load when the Import workspace files setting is on). - Imports are deduplicated through a ledger at `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-noema-imports.json`, keyed by file path +

plugins.description: Validated, agent-composed interactive UI inside DeepSeek Harness conversations
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-intelligent-ui

在 **DeepSeek Harness 当前对话中**，让 Agent 根据任务选择文字、结构化 UI 或交互式 UI，组合严格校验的组件，并把界面作为本地计算、授权工具操作和后续 Agent 请求的入口。

**0.2.0** 在 P0 上增加 P1 工具/Agent 联动、持久化操作记录，以及 P2 组件级 Streaming 与 Patch。本次任务的 P3 定义为工程加固与验收：真实模型、权限与审批、重复请求、故障恢复、热启停、资源边界和性能测量。具体通过的检查、修复与未验证范围见 [VALIDATION](docs/VALIDATION.md)。

插件使用 Harness 公开扩展点，不 Fork Harness，不修改核心 Agent Loop，不复制 OpenAI 私有实现或协议。UI DSL 是数据；模型不能通过它执行任意 JavaScript、HTML、CSS 或系统命令。

## 兼容范围

| 项目 | 核查与运行版本 |
|---|---|
| Harness | `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2`，Web profile |
| 官方源码快照 | `687f282e8625c6b8d11ff58211a90524be2e4317`，2026-10-18 |
| Cordis / React | `4.0.5` / Harness 提供的 React `18.3.1` |
| Node | 要求 `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`；验收使用 `24.19.0` |
| 文档 DSL | `1.0` 保留原有本地交互；`1.1` 增加显式外部动作 |
| Wire 协议 | Action/Stream 独立版本化，不改变 Harness Session V4 |

Harness 处于开发者预览阶段，本包锁定已核查版本。Desktop、TUI、其他 Harness 版本及多 Host 共享操作存储不在本次验收范围。接口证据见 [SOURCE_AUDIT](docs/SOURCE_AUDIT.md)。

## 安装与启动

TGZ 已含 Host、Client、类型声明、Schema 和示例，无需先构建。

```bash
# 如尚未安装 Harness：
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2

# 初始化或读取 Web profile；已有 profile 不会因此重置。
dsh web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-plugin-intelligent-ui-0.2.0.tgz
dsh web --dump-config
dsh web
```

本项目未发布到 npm registry，请使用交付的 TGZ。安装时 Harness 的包管理器仍可能访问 npm registry 解析依赖。模型账户和凭据沿用 Harness 已有配置，插件没有单独的 API key 设置，也不读取密钥。

### 启用 P1 / P2

默认启用 P0，**外部动作和组件流默认关闭**。使用交付源码中的 [examples/intelligent-ui.patch.yml](examples/intelligent-ui.patch.yml)，或创建以下管理员配置：

```yaml
- id: intelligent-ui
  config:
    actions:
      enabled: true
      capabilities:
        - id: read_file
          toolName: read
          title: Read text file
          description: Read using existing Harness workspace permissions.
          risk: read
          resultFields: [totalLines]
        - id: write_file
          toolName: write
          title: Write text file
          description: Write through Harness after mandatory confirmation.
          risk: write
          resultFields: [operation]
    streaming:
      enabled: true
```

```bash
dsh web --patch ./examples/intelligent-ui.patch.yml
```

配置把已注册工具映射为 capability，**不会授予该工具原本没有的权限**。目标工具必须在所属 Agent 作用域可见，参数仍须符合真实 Schema。所有 `risk: write` 操作需要 Harness 原生审批；现有工具策略要求的其他审批也继续生效。管理员必须正确声明副作用，不能把写入工具错误标成 `read`。

`resultFields` 仅开放 canonical result 的指定标量字段。示例 `read` 暴露 `totalLines`，不会自动把文件内容或原始输出放进 UI。复杂文件列表等功能应注册可信适配工具，筛选返回数据，再明确配置公开字段。

### 启用、禁用、升级和卸载

Plugins 页面管理 bundle 启用状态。支持即时应用的 Web profile 会卸载/恢复贡献；其他 profile 可重启 Host 使配置生效。停用不删除 Session 或账本，重新启用仅恢复显示，不重新执行动作。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-plugin-intelligent-ui-NEW_VERSION.tgz
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-intelligent-ui
```

## 在聊天中使用

无需特殊命令。可关闭的规划章节提供三种输出形式和组件语法，模型按任务决定是否调用 UI 工具。没有按关键词选择整页模板，也不会强制所有回答生成 UI。

**普通问题**

> 1 + 1 等于多少？

预期直接文字回答。

**本地计算器**

> 创建一个复利收益计算器：本金用数字输入框，年收益率和年限用滑块；显示期末总额和收益，让结果随输入立即更新。

控件和受限表达式在浏览器本地运行，滑块变化不发起模型请求。固定年收益率示例不包含追加投资、税费等假设；它用于参数探索，不提供精确十进制账本语义。

**数据比较**

> 用表格和合适的图表比较这些虚构产品：A 价格199、续航8小时；B 价格249、续航12小时；C 价格179、续航6小时。注明数据来自用户。

**工具面板（P1）**

> 创建文件操作面板：读取 fixture.txt，允许编辑新内容，点击保存后通过现有工具写入，并遵守审批。先只生成界面，等我点击后才执行。

点击后，Host 从当前 Session 保存的 UI 重新解析 capability 和参数，写入操作记录，再提交正常 Agent turn。模型调用 `intelligent_ui_action` 执行保留的动作。此桥接设计复用真实 Agent 上下文、工具权限和原生审批，因此外部动作通常需要一次模型调用；本地输入和计算不需要。

**逐步生成（P2）**

> 逐步生成数量分析面板。先给我数量输入和结果，再添加说明与图表；新增组件时保留我正在输入的值。

Agent 使用 `intelligent_ui_open`、`intelligent_ui_patch`、`intelligent_ui_complete` 和 `intelligent_ui_cancel`，通过正常工具结果传递完整 checkpoint，复用原生 Session 流。组件更新验证 Schema、稳定 ID、基线版本和资源预算。此版本不实现逐 Token 编译器。

## 状态与持久化边界

| 数据 | 保存位置 / 恢复行为 |
|---|---|
| 文档、初始 state、derived、动作声明 | 正常 `tool/result.meta`；历史会话可恢复 |
| 每步流式 checkpoint | 正常工具结果；每帧含完整已验证快照 |
| 本地输入和未提交草稿 | 当前实例内；增量更新保留，刷新恢复初始值 |
| 明确提交的请求、参数、审批与执行状态 | Host storage-domain 账本，用于授权、幂等和恢复 |
| 公开工具回执 | Host 保存，scoped Remote 查询；挂载仅恢复显示 |

刷新、历史回放、热启用均不会提交动作，也不会把历史 `resultMap` 再写入字段。只有本次明确提交的成功回执允许更新字段；如果用户在等待期间继续编辑，则保留新草稿，并在独立面板显示真实结果。

同一 `requestId` 的重试复用原记录，参数变化被拒绝；新的用户点击才产生新请求。Host 重启时停止未确认开始的操作，把已经进入执行但结局不明的操作标为 `unknown`，不会自动重试。取消运行中的工具不等于回滚。

账本容量固定，满后拒绝新增，不自动删除幂等记录。当前实现针对单 Host，不承诺分布式 exactly-once。

## 开发与验证

```bash
npm ci
npm run check
npm run test:package
npm pack
```

`check` 包含 TypeScript、全部 Vitest 测试和构建。测试直接使用锁定版本的 Cordis、ToolRuntime、Session/Agent、Gateway/Registry 和官方 conversation assembler，并区分单元、浏览器、完整 Harness 与真实模型验证。

```text
host/       UI tool、规划、capability、动作服务/账本、组件流
client/     原生 Conversation/ToolView、React registry、状态与 dispatcher
remote/     正式 Host/Client TYPERT contribution
shared/     DSL、表达式、Action/Stream 协议、验证和预算
schema/     构建生成的 JSON Schema
examples/   本地交互、数据、动作、组件流示例与启用配置
tests/      Host、Gateway、shared、assembler 和 React DOM 测试
scripts/    构建、打包、浏览器、Harness、真实模型和性能验收
docs/       源码审计、架构、安全、协议和验证记录
lib/        Host ESM、Client lazy factory、Remote 与声明文件
```

### 无模型费用的验收

```bash
npx playwright install chromium
npm run test:browser
npm run test:harness:advanced
```

Linux 容器需要 Chromium 系统依赖和字体。advanced 脚本启动真实 Harness，在隔离 profile 中通过官方插件管理器安装 TGZ，仅以确定性 Messages/SSE 替代模型。它验证原生工具、审批、回执、重放、callback、流式、热启停与重启，不需要上游源码副本，也不使用已有用户 `DSH_HOME`。

原有 `npm run test:harness` 使用上游官方 mock server，需要 `../upstream-deepseek-harness` 或 `DSH_UPSTREAM_DIR` 指向上述固定提交。

### 真实模型验收（主动运行会产生调用费用）

把密钥保存在项目外的权限受限文件中；设置 Messages-compatible HTTPS base URL 和精确模型 ID：

```bash
export IUI_LIVE_KEY_FILE=/absolute/private/path/api-key
export IUI_LIVE_BASE_URL=https://your-authorized-provider.example/v1
export IUI_LIVE_MODEL=your-model-id
npm run test:live
npm run test:live:harness
npm run test:live:advanced
```

上述 URL 和模型是占位符。脚本在 base URL 后追加 `/messages`，禁止重定向，限制调用次数、输出和超时。有代理的 Node 环境可按需使用 `node --use-env-proxy scripts/harness-live-advanced.mjs`。真实密钥仅由测试代理进程使用，隔离 Harness 只获得本机一次性凭据。交付物不包含测试密钥、测试 profile 或完整服务日志。

指定 `deepseek-v4.1-flash` 的实际结果见 [VALIDATION](docs/VALIDATION.md)。少量样本不代表总体规划成功率；测试观察到首个 DSL 无效、模型读取反馈后修复的情况，报告保留这一限制。

```bash
npm run benchmark
```

benchmark 测量有界文档验证、本地更新和 React 服务端渲染，结果不是浏览器帧率或生产 SLA。

## 配置与安全

`enabledPlanning` 默认 true；`maxDocumentBytes` 范围 1,024–262,144。动作默认超时60秒，入队有效期1小时，全局最多2,048条、每Session128条。流默认最多256个generation、每个256个checkpoint，另受累计字节限制。管理员 patch 可在 Schema 范围内调整。

执行前边界包括组件白名单、严格属性、表达式 AST、状态值域、Markdown 禁用外部资源、双端校验，以及主体/Session/参数来源/工具权限校验。按钮只能引用声明的 action ID；模型不能提交工具名、主体或“已确认”标志。详见 [SECURITY](docs/SECURITY.md)。

完整文档：

- [SOURCE_AUDIT：真实扩展点](docs/SOURCE_AUDIT.md)
- [ARCHITECTURE：模块与执行路径](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [HOST_INTEGRATION：授权、账本、审批与生命周期](docs/HOST_INTEGRATION.md)
- [HOST_STREAMING：真实流工具、持久化与恢复边界](docs/HOST_STREAMING.md)
- [UI_DSL：组件、表达式、动作与流](docs/UI_DSL.md)
- [CLIENT_INTEGRATION：挂载、作用域、恢复与竞态](docs/CLIENT_INTEGRATION.md)
- [SECURITY：信任与资源边界](docs/SECURITY.md)
- [VALIDATION：测试及 A–F 验收](docs/VALIDATION.md)
- [ROADMAP：完成范围和剩余工作](docs/ROADMAP.md)

## 许可

项目源码采用 MIT License。DeepSeek Harness 和依赖保留各自许可；lockfile 固定版本，浏览器构建包含的第三方许可见 `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt`。

plugins.description: Genspark tools for DeepSeek Harness: web search, crawl, image/video/audio generation, media analysis, X/Instagram/Reddit search and 18 /genspark-* commands, all via @genspark/cli.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-genspark

A plugin that brings **Genspark**'s AI capabilities into DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
Search, research, image/video/audio generation, media analysis, and social network search
(X / Instagram / Reddit) can all be called from the composer with `/genspark-*` commands.

Japanese: [README_ja.md](README_ja.md)

## Getting started

### 1. Install the CLI and log in

```powershell
npm install -g @genspark/cli
gsk login      # opens the browser → approve with your Genspark account
gsk me         # success if your email, plan, and remaining credits are shown
```

- Credentials are stored in `~/.genspark-tool-cli/config.json`. **This plugin never holds secrets**
  (it only uses what the CLI has saved).
- On machines without a browser (CI, servers), you can authenticate with an API key instead.

  ```powershell
  $env:GSK_API_KEY = "gsk_..."   # your Genspark API key
  ```

- To switch accounts, run `gsk logout` → `gsk login`.
- You can check the login state at any time with `/genspark` (or `gsk me`).

### 2. Install the plugin into a profile

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install-to-profile.ps1 -Profile "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web" -Sync
```

To install it into the desktop app as well, run the same command against `...\.dsh\profiles\desktop`.

### 3. Restart DSH

**Reloading the page is not enough** (the plugin is loaded only once, when the server starts).
After restarting, run `/genspark`; if your account and remaining credits appear, you are ready to go.

## Commands

Available from the composer's `+` menu, or by typing `/` at the start of a line.
(When opening the menu with `+`, **leave the input field empty** — commands that take arguments
only appear as suggestions when it is empty.)

### Search and research

| Command | What it does | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `/genspark` | Connection status, account, remaining credits | `/genspark` |
| `/genspark-search` | Web search | `/genspark-search DeepSeek V4 reviews` |
| `/genspark-image-search` | Image search | `/genspark-image-search cherry blossoms in full bloom` |
| `/genspark-crawl` | Read the body of a page | `/genspark-crawl https://example.com/article` |
| `/genspark-scholar` | Find academic papers | `/genspark-scholar diffusion model speech` |
| `/genspark-maps` | Look up maps and places | `/genspark-maps cafes near Tokyo Station` |
| `/genspark-summarize` | Summarize a long document (PDF supported) | `/genspark-summarize <URL> What are the key points?` |

### Create

| Command | What it does | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `/genspark-image` | Generate an image | `/genspark-image Mount Fuji at sunset` |
| `/genspark-video` | Generate a video | `/genspark-video cherry petals falling, 5 seconds` |
| `/genspark-audio` | Generate speech or music | `/genspark-audio Good morning` |

Artifacts are saved to `<working directory>/genspark-out/`, and the save path and size are displayed.

Typical wait times (measured): images 15–40 s / audio 30–60 s / **video 1–2 min** (about 50 s for a
5-second 720p clip; longer videos take longer). Generation and analysis commands reply with
"Sending to Genspark…" immediately after input, and the result arrives in the chat afterwards.

### Understand

| Command | What it does | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `/genspark-analyze-media` | Describe what is in an image, video, or audio file (audio is transcribed) | `/genspark-analyze-media genspark-out/test_cat.jpg What is it doing?` |

### Social search

`/genspark-social` lets the **AI decide** which service to search and runs the appropriate
search on X / Instagram / Reddit (the command itself calls no API, so credits are spent only on
the searches that are actually performed).

| Command | What it does | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `/genspark-social` | The AI picks and searches X, Instagram, and Reddit | `/genspark-social DeepSeek Harness reviews` |
| `/genspark-x` | Search X (Twitter) only (posts, users, profiles) | `/genspark-x recent posts from @elonmusk` |
| `/genspark-instagram` | Search Instagram only (posts, users) | `/genspark-instagram @natgeo` |
| `/genspark-reddit` | Search Reddit only (posts, comments, subreddits) | `/genspark-reddit local llm reviews` |

- You can get the same results by asking the AI (e.g. "check what people say about Genspark on X"
  → `genspark_x_search`).
- By default, results show up to **25** items with author, date, reaction counts, and post URL
  (newest first).
- About 1.6 credits per call (measured). Instagram searches take 10–15 seconds, and Reddit's
  "post with comments" and "subreddit posts" can take around 40 seconds.
- On X, passing "@username" returns **that user's posts**, while passing a "topic" runs a post
  search. Instagram works the same way. Reddit accepts `sort` (top / new, etc.) and a time range.
- **Search tips** (measured): keep queries to 1–2 words / for Japanese topics use `language="ja"`
  (the AI adds it when you ask for results "in Japanese") / "#hashtags" do not narrow anything /
  on Reddit, naming a subreddit such as "in r/LocalLLaMA" tends to work better.
- If you see "failed to execute", it does not necessarily mean the feature is unsupported
  (transient failures do happen). The plugin **retries automatically once**. If it still fails,
  wait a while or change the wording.
- Comment fetching is often empty in practice (that is not a failure). Reddit search results do
  not include score (vote count), so results are ordered by date instead.

### Advanced

| Command | What it does | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `/genspark-models` | List the generation models you can choose from | `/genspark-models video` |
| `/genspark-tools` | Search across all 327 tools | `/genspark-tools slack` |
| `/genspark-run` | Run any tool once | `/genspark-run me` |

### Using attachments

The following 5 commands accept images, video, audio, and documents **attached directly**.
When you attach something, the text in the input field is treated as the instruction or question.

| Command | How the attachment is used |
|---|---|
| `/genspark-analyze-media` | The target to analyze (image, video, audio) |
| `/genspark-summarize` | The document to summarize |
| `/genspark-crawl` | The page file to read |
| `/genspark-image` | A reference image (editing, style transfer) |
| `/genspark-video` | The first frame (create a video from an image) |

Example: attach a photo of a cat and run `/genspark-analyze-media What is it doing?`

## Choosing a generation model

Each command runs with a default model, but **Genspark offers many models and you can switch
between them**.

| Kind | Default | Available |
|---|---|---|
| Image generation | `nano-banana-2-flash-lite` | 15 models |
| Video generation | `kling/v3` | 21 models |
| Audio / music generation | Genspark's own default | 25 models |
| Transcription | `whisper-1` | 3 models |

How to use them:

- **See the list** — `/genspark-models` (filter by `video`, `image`, `audio`, `transcribe`, or part
  of an id)
- **Ask the AI** — "Which video models are available?" "List the audio models"
  → the AI returns the list via `genspark_models`
- **Generate with a specific model** — "Create a sunset video with gemini/veo3.1"
  → the AI runs it with the `model` argument set
- **Model details** — "Tell me the specs of kling/v3"
  → the AI reports supported aspect ratios, durations, and whether audio is available via
  `get_model_info`

> Model names are not pinned in the plugin. The list is read from Genspark's catalog every time,
> so models that are added or retired are picked up automatically.

> If you type "model list" or "usage" into a generation command (`/genspark-image`,
> `/genspark-video`, `/genspark-audio`), it returns the list or the usage **without generating
> anything** (no credits are spent). When you want to generate, just describe what you want.

## Settings

You normally do not need to change anything. Only when necessary, add these to the plugin
settings of your profile.

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Set to false to unregister all tools |
| `cliEntry` | `""` | Absolute path to the CLI entry (auto-detected when empty) |
| `nodePath` | `""` | node.exe for child

plugins.description: In-browser audio and video previews in the DSH right Sidebar, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route so a remote browser can play and seek large files without opening a native app on the Host.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-media-web-preview

Play **video and audio inside the DSH right Sidebar** — including from a remote
browser, where the native **Open** button would otherwise launch QuickTime or
Music on the Host Mac.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-media-web-preview)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-media-web-preview)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-media-web-preview)](LICENSE)

## The problem

DeepSeek Harness's document preview renders text, Markdown, code, images, PDF,
HTML, Office documents and spreadsheets. It has no audio or video renderer, and
`mp4`, `mp3`, `wav`, `flac`, `ogg`, `m4a`, `aac`, `wma` and `opus` are listed as
known binary containers with no viewer. Opening one shows:

> Preview is not available for this file type yet. **Open**

`Open` asks the **Host** to launch the file in a native application. On the
machine running the Host that is fine; from a phone, another laptop, or a
Tailscale peer it opens a window on a screen you are not looking at.

## What this plugin does

It registers two document renderers, `video` and `audio`, and draws the
browser's native player in the preview pane. A companion Host route streams the
file with HTTP `Range`, so seeking works and a large video is never read into
memory or into the conversation.

- **Native controls** — play/pause, seek, volume, fullscreen (video), and the
  browser's own picture-in-picture where available.
- **Seek without downloading everything** — `206 Partial Content` +
  `Content-Range`; the player asks for the bytes it needs.
- **Remote-browser ready** — the URL is document-relative, so the same preview
  works under `http://127.0.0.1:3080`, a LAN address, a Tailscale MagicDNS name,
  or `tailscale serve` on port 80. No configuration.
- **Download / open in a new tab** — both actions sit under the player.
- **Localized** — English and Simplified Chinese dictionaries.
- **Zero runtime dependencies** — one Host module and one browser bundle.

## Formats

| Kind | Suffixes |
| --- | --- |
| Video | `mp4` `m4v` `webm` `ogv` `mov` `mkv` `avi` `mpg` `mpeg` `3gp` `3g2` `ts` `m2ts` |
| Audio | `mp3` `m4a` `m4b` `aac` `wav` `flac` `ogg` `oga` `opus` `weba` `aiff` `aif` `wma` `mid` `midi` |

Playback is the browser's decision: Chromium plays H.264/AAC MP4, WebM, Ogg and
most audio, but usually cannot decode Matroska (`.mkv`) or AVI. When a codec is
unsupported the player shows an explicit message and the download link rather
than failing silently.

## Install

From npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-media-web-preview
```

From a local directory:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-media-web-preview
```

`dsh plugin add` records the dependency **and** appends the package to
`dsh.profile.bundles`; the package ships `dsh.bundle.patch`, so no manual
`insert:` row is needed in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.

The Host half hot-mounts into the running `dsh web`; **refresh the page once**
so the browser bundle enters the module graph. If your build only composes
plugins at boot, restart `dsh web` instead.

Then open any supported file in the Sidebar's **Files** tab. The native **Open**
menu stays available at the top.

## Why a second file route

DSH already has `GET /api/file`, used by the image and Markdown previews. It
always answers with a full `200`, **ignores `Range`**, and caps the response at
the attachment image limit (20 MB by default). That is fine for images and
hopeless for video: no seeking, and a large file just returns `413`.

Rather than change a shared route, this plugin adds a range-capable sibling:

| | `/api/file` | `/api/media` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full response | `200` | `200` |
| `Range` request | ignored (full `200`) | `206` + `Content-Range` |
| Seeking | must download the whole file | immediate |
| Byte cap | ~20 MB | bounded by the filesystem |
| Reads | whole file buffered | 1 MiB chunks via `ctx.fs.readByteRange` |

Both routes sit under `/api`, so the Connection service applies the same Host /
Origin check and browser-cookie authentication to both.

## Implementation

```
lib/index.js      Host: GET/HEAD /api/media, Range parsing, chunked streaming
lib/client.js     Browser: documentPreviews + sidebar.right.tab.document
cordis.patch.yml  bundle insert row
```

The browser half registers through `ctx.documentPreviews` with
`loading: 'renderer'` and declares the suffixes as binary so nothing falls back
to a text preview. The player reads the absolute path from the `file` resource
(`useResource(resourceAddress).value.absolutePath`), builds a document-relative
`api/media?path=…` URL, and calls `content.loaded(version)` once to end the
loading state.

The Host half registers `ctx.connection.fetch.register({ path: '/api/media',
methods: ['GET', 'HEAD'] })`. Requests resolve through `ctx.fs`, so the Host's
own file policy still applies; `parseRange` turns `Range` into a closed
interval. `416` carries `bytes */<size>`; `HEAD` returns headers only;
`download=1` adds an attachment `Content-Disposition`.

## Security

- The route lives under `/api`, so it inherits the same authentication and
  Host/Origin checks as every other DSH API. Unauthenticated requests get `401`;
  an untrusted Host gets `403`.
- Only absolute paths are accepted; there is no directory listing, and nothing
  bypasses the filesystem provider's resolution and access policy.
- Responses carry `Cache-Control: private, no-store` and
  `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`.
- No telemetry, no outbound network requests, no runtime dependencies.

## Verified

- A 59.6 s MP4 plays and seeks to 40 s over a Tailscale MagicDNS URL.
- A 28.6 MB MP4 returns `413` on `/api/file` but `200` / `206` on `/api/media`.
- `Range: bytes=0-1023` returns `206`, `Content-Length: 1024`,
  `Content-Range: bytes 0-1023/<size>`.
- Unauthenticated requests return `401`; an invalid range returns `416` with
  `bytes */<size>`.
- An MP3 reads its metadata and seeks to 30 s.

## Compatibility

- DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` web composition, and later versions that keep providing
  `ctx.documentPreviews`, `sidebar.right.tab.document`, `ctx.connection.fetch`
  and `ctx.fs.readByteRange`.
- Node 22+.
- Also usable from the DSH desktop app: the in-app route is document-relative.

## Scope

This plugin focuses on the **stock right Sidebar** and **remote-browser
playback**. It does not provide playlists, subtitle tracks, playback-speed
controls, or inline media cards in the chat transcript — other community
plugins cover those. Playback behaviour is whatever the browser's native
controls provide.

## Development

```sh
npm test        # node --test: Range parsing and MIME mapping
```

There is no build step. `lib/client.js` is a hand-written module-loader bundle
(`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`) that requests only `react` and
`react/jsx-runtime`, so it uses the Host's own React.

End-to-end check: with the plugin installed in a DSH web instance, open a
supported file and confirm the `<video>`/`<audio>` element reaches `readyState`
`4` and that `currentTime` follows after a seek.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 Wilson Cheng

plugins.description: 这是一个零配置即可用在DSH harness当中，免费使用opencode免费模型的插件
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-opencode-zen-free

把 **OpenCode Zen 的免费模型**接入 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** 的模型选择器。

- **免 key 即可用**：默认走公共额度，不需要 OpenCode Console 账号
- **零本地依赖**：不需要本机装过 OpenCode，不需要登录，不读任何本地数据
- **零第三方依赖**：只依赖 Node 内置模块与 DSH 自身的包
- 支持工具调用，`bash` / `read` 是真实可执行的工具，不是占位

---

## 安装

### 1. 复制到 profile

```bash
PROFILE="$USERPROFILE/.dsh/profiles/desktop"
cp -r dsh-opencode-zen-free "$PROFILE/node_modules/"
```

### 2. 注册到 profile

编辑 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`：

`dependencies` 加入：

```json
"dsh-opencode-zen-free": "file:./node_modules/dsh-opencode-zen-free"
```

`dsh.profile.bundles` 数组加入：

```json
"dsh-opencode-zen-free"
```

### 3. 配置

编辑 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`，追加：

```yaml
- id: llm-opencode-zen-free
  name: "dsh-opencode-zen-free"
  config:
    mode: anonymous          # 免 key 走公共额度；改成 private 用自己的 key
    providerId: "opencode-zen-free"
    displayName: "OpenCode Zen 免费模型"
```

想用自己的 Console API key（公共额度被限流时更稳）：

```yaml
- id: llm-opencode-zen-free
  name: "dsh-opencode-zen-free"
  config:
    mode: private
    apiKey: "oc_sk_你的key"
```

### 4. 重启 DSH

模型选择器会出现「**OpenCode Zen 免费模型**」分组。

---

## 可用模型

| 模型 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `space-bunny-free` | Stealth 模型，零留存策略 |
| `big-pickle` | Stealth 模型，免费期数据可能用于改进 |
| `longcat-2.5-preview-free` | 零留存 |
| `mimo-v2.6-flash-free` | 免费期数据可能用于改进 |
| `glm-5.3-flash-free` | 限时免费，零留存 |
| `deepseek-v4.1-flash-free` | 限时免费 |
| `nemotron-3.5-lightning-free` | NVIDIA 试用端点，勿传敏感数据 |
| `nemotron-3.5-super-vl-free` | NVIDIA 试用端点，支持图片输入 |
| `beam-free` | 数据保留 30 天；**中国大陆/香港/澳门不可用** |

> 免费模型由 OpenCode 侧提供，可用性与数据条款随时可能变化，以官方说明为准。

---

## 配置项

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `anonymous` | `anonymous` 免 key；`private` 用自己的 Console API key |
| `apiKey` | — | Console API key，仅 `private` 模式使用；留空则读 `OPENCODE_API_KEY` |
| `baseUrl` | `https://opencode.ai/zen/v1` | 上游端点 |
| `providerId` | `opencode-zen-free` | 在模型选择器里的 provider id |
| `displayName` | `OpenCode Zen 免费模型` | 模型分组显示名 |
| `maxAttempts` | `12` | 上游偶发错误时的最大重试次数 |
| `retryBaseDelayMs` | `400` | 首次重试等待毫秒（之后按倍数增长） |
| `retryMaxDelayMs` | `4000` | 重试等待上限毫秒 |
| `streamIdleTimeoutMs` | `180000` | 流式响应空闲超时 |
| `registerGateTools` | `true` | 把 `bash` / `read` 注册为可执行工具 |

---

## 常见问题

**模型调用返回 `RegionError`**

该模型不在你所在地区开放。`beam-free` 明确排除中国大陆/香港/澳门等地区，换其他模型即可。

**间歇性失败**

上游偶发空响应错误，插件会自动重试（默认最多 12 次）。若持续失败，换一个模型，或切到 `private` 模式使用自有额度。

**`private` 模式全部 401**

`apiKey` 没配上。检查 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `apiKey`，或设置环境变量 `OPENCODE_API_KEY`。

**看不到「OpenCode Zen 免费模型」分组**

1. 确认 `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 都加了
2. 确认 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `id` 是 `llm-opencode-zen-free`
3. 重启 DSH Desktop

**模型不调用工具**

`bash` 与 `read` 需要注册成功才会被调用。若启动日志里有「未找到工具注册表」告警，说明宿主的工具服务未就绪——重启 DSH 通常可解决。

---

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-opencode-zen-free
```

并从 `cordis.patch.yml` 删除 `llm-opencode-zen-free` 段落。

---

## 说明

- 免费额度为共享池，高峰期可能被限流，`private` 模式更稳。
- 部分免费模型会把输入用于改进模型，**勿传敏感数据**。
- 建议仅用于个人实验，不要用于生产环境。

想了解免费层的准入机制与实现细节，见 [NOTES.md](NOTES.md)。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vnc-client

A VNC client tab for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) right sidebar.

It connects to **any** VNC/RFB server — not just the machine the harness runs on — through a
WebSocket-to-TCP bridge that runs in the Harness Host. Servers are saved from the plugin's own
page under **Settings → Plugins → dsh-vnc-client**.

![The Remote desktop tab connected to a server](docs/screenshot-connected.png)

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-vnc-client
```

Then restart the harness. A plugin bundle is composed at boot, so the tab does not appear until
the Host restarts.

To connect the sidebar guide's **Remote desktop** entry to a specific server, open
**Settings → Plugins → dsh-vnc-client**, add the server, and click **Test** to confirm it
answers before switching to it.

## What it does

- Opens a **Remote desktop** tab in the right sidebar, beside Files, Preview and Terminal.
- Speaks RFB 3.3/3.7/3.8 directly in the browser: Raw, CopyRect, Hextile, Tight and ZRLE
  rectangles; DesktopSize, ExtendedDesktopSize, LastRect and Cursor pseudo-encodings.
- Sends keyboard and pointer events back to the server, plus wheel, the server's cursor
  shape, and clipboard in both directions.
- Saves servers with an optional VNC password.

![Saved servers in the plugin's settings](docs/screenshot-settings.png)

## How it is put together

A DSH plugin is two halves in one package:

| Half | Where | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `src/host/index.js` | Mounts a WebSocket upgrade route and a `TypertRemoteService` for saving servers |
| Client | `src/client/app.js` | Registers the sidebar tab type, the settings seats, and the guide command |

A browser cannot open a raw TCP socket, so the Host accepts a WebSocket at
`/api/vnc/bridge?target=<id>` — authenticated by the same connection check the Gateway uses —
and pumps bytes to and from the VNC server. **The password is never put in the URL**: it travels
over the RPC channel and is resolved by the Host at connect time, so it stays out of access logs.

Servers live in `vnc-client/targets.json` under the Harness home, written `0600` in a `0700`
directory. The list RPC reports only whether a password is set, never the password itself.

### Encodings

`DecompressionStream` emulates persistent zlib, because Tight and ZRLE keep deflate state across
rectangles and a browser has no incremental inflater. VNC authentication needs DES, which Node
dropped and WebCrypto never had, so `src/client/rfb/des.js` implements it.

JPEG is deliberately **not** advertised: a Tight JPEG rectangle cannot be painted without a
separate decoder, and offering it would make the client pick an encoding it cannot draw.

## Development

```sh
node scripts/build.mjs     # src/ → lib/
node --test "test/*.test.mjs"
```

`scripts/build.mjs` inlines the client's ES modules into the single factory body the harness
loads, and refuses to build a bundle containing a `jsx` call React would silently render as
nothing — a null props object, or children passed as trailing arguments where the runtime expects
a key. Both fail in the browser as an empty sidebar tab, far from the call that caused them.

The tests cover DES against FIPS vectors and OpenSSL, every supported encoding round-tripped
through an independently written encoder, the handshake against a real socket (including
one-byte-at-a-time fragmentation), the WebSocket server against Node's own client, and the
built bundle's contract.

## Licence

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

# dsh-tool-cards

[中文](#中文) | [English](#english)

## 中文

**为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 提供交互式聊天卡片。**

在一条助手消息内直接渲染滑块、下拉、分段控件、日期选择器、表单、图表和表格——用户按下提交按钮后，参数快照会作为新消息回传给智能体。

> [!NOTE]
> 这是 `chat-ui/1.0` 消息格式的独立实现，不是任何官方 ChatGPT 协议，也不复现任何私有实现。

### 它做什么

```
模型调用 chat_ui({ title, ui })
  → host 校验载荷（组件白名单、深度、节点数、action 形状）
  → 工具结果 meta 携带 { kind: 'chat-ui/1.0', title, ui }
  → 卡片被"提升"为最终聊天输出（不折叠进工具过程）
      拖动 / 勾选 / 输入 → 仅本地状态，零请求
      按下提交按钮   → POST /chat-ui/action { actionId, operation, values }
  → host 通过 agent.followup() 把它变成一条用户消息
  → 智能体在下一轮看到参数快照
```

### 为什么卡片要被"提升"

`chat_ui` 是一次工具调用，而工具结果通常属于 *process* 区段——模型思考结束后 DSH 会把这一段折叠起来，卡片也会跟着消失。所以 client 端注册了一个由 `tool/result` 事件驱动的自定义聊天节点（`chat-ui-card`），锚定到会话输出流上；工具行则降级为一行占位符加一个原始数据展开。

如果 `uiConversation` 不可用，插件会回退为在工具行内渲染卡片，功能仍然可用。

### 组件

共 26 种注册组件：

| 分组 | 类型 |
|---|---|
| 输入 | `Slider` `Checkbox` `Radio` `Select` `Segmented` `Input` `Textarea` `Date` `Button` |
| 容器 | `Form` `Pressable` `Popover` `Carousel` |
| 视觉 | `Chart`（柱/线/饼/散点）`Map` |
| 展示 | `Card` `Metric` `Text` `Heading` `Row` `Column` `Divider` `Badge` `Alert` `Table` `KeyValue` |

表达式使用白名单 JSON AST——`{ op: "mul", args: [{ var: "a" }, { var: "b" }] }`，支持 `add`/`sub`/`mul`/`div`/`round`/`eq`/`and`/`or`/`not`。**没有 eval，不生成代码。**

### 安装

```bash
# 在你的 DSH profile 里
dsh plugin add dsh-tool-cards
```

或在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` 中手动加入 bundle 行：

```json
{ "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["...", "dsh-tool-cards"] } } }
```

然后重启 DSH（profile patch 在启动时读取）。

### 用法

`chat_ui` 工具会出现在模型的工具集里。它的描述告诉模型何时使用它（调参数、多维对比、"给我做个计算器"），何时不该用（纯解释、一次性结论）。

最小载荷示例：

```json
{
  "title": "药剂投加量计算器",
  "ui": {
    "schemaVersion": "chat-ui/1.0",
    "initialState": { "soilTons": 1000, "doseGPerKg": 2 },
    "tree": {
      "id": "root",
      "type": "Card",
      "props": { "title": "药剂投加量" },
      "children": [
        { "id": "soil", "type": "Input", "label": "土壤质量 (t)", "bind": "soilTons",
          "props": { "inputType": "number", "min": 0 } },
        { "id": "dose", "type": "Slider", "label": "投加量 (g/kg)", "bind": "doseGPerKg",
          "props": { "min": 0.1, "max": 5, "step": 0.1 } },
        { "id": "total", "type": "Metric", "label": "理论药剂质量", "props": { "unit": "t" },
          "value": { "op": "round", "args": [
            { "op": "div", "args": [
              { "op": "mul", "args": [{ "var": "soilTons" }, { "var": "doseGPerKg" }] }, 1000
            ] }, 3 ] } },
        { "id": "submit", "type": "Button", "label": "提交这次配比", "actionId": "apply" }
      ]
    },
    "actions": {
      "apply": {
        "kind": "submitToAgent",
        "operation": "apply-dose",
        "includeKeys": ["soilTons", "doseGPerKg"]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Action 类型：`submitToAgent`、`callTool`、`openUrl`（仅 http/https）。

### 按钮与文案约定

- 提交按钮是卡片**唯一的出口**：全宽、加粗、上方有分隔线。
- 按钮文案描述**用户的下一个动作**，由模型按当前任务决定——"应用这组参数""计算推荐投加量""提交这次配比"。

### 限制

每条消息：≤ 120 个节点，树深度 ≤ 8，≤ 60 个状态键，≤ 20 个 action，文本 ≤ 4000 字符。由 host 强制执行，畸形载荷在到达 client 前就会被拒绝。

### 说明与注意事项

- `Chart` 和 `Map` 是手绘 SVG。`Map` 只做坐标投影示意，不连接任何瓦片服务。
- client bundle 将 `react` 保持为 external（由 host 提供），内联了 `@json-render/*` 和 `zod`，因为它们不在平台模块基线里。
- 样式只使用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token，自动跟随亮/暗主题。

### 开发

```bash
git clone https://github.com/wszw142857-beep/dsh-tool-cards
cd dsh-tool-cards
npm install
npm run build     # 重新生成 src/card-css.js 和 lib/client.js
npm run check     # protocol + bundle 自测
```

更多测试工具在 `tools/`（不随 npm tarball 发布）：

| 脚本 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `tools/selftest.mjs` | 15 项检查：协议校验、bundle 导出面、提升机制、回归防护 |
| `tools/bundle-rehearsal.mjs` | 10 项检查：在 static-plugin 上下文中运行 `apply()`，含/不含 `uiConversation` |
| `tools/e2e-full.mjs` | 全链路：真实工具定义 → 事件定义 → 真实 React 渲染 → 拖动 → 提交 |
| `tools/preview.mjs` | 渲染真实 bundle 并输出可直接截图的页面 |

## English

**Interactive chat cards for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).**

Render sliders, selects, segmented controls, date pickers, forms, charts and tables **inside an
assistant message** — then send the resulting parameter snapshot back to the agent when the user
presses the submit button.

> [!NOTE]
> This is a standalone implementation of the `chat-ui/1.0` message format. It is not an official
> ChatGPT protocol and does not reproduce any private implementation.

### What it does

```
model calls chat_ui({ title, ui })
  → host validates the payload (component whitelist, depth, node count, action shapes)
  → tool result meta carries { kind: 'chat-ui/1.0', title, ui }
  → the card is promoted to final chat output (not folded into the tool process)
      dragging / checking / typing → local state only, zero requests
      pressing the submit button  → POST /chat-ui/action { actionId, operation, values }
  → host turns it into a user message via agent.followup()
  → the agent sees the parameter snapshot on its next turn
```

### Why the card is "promoted"

`chat_ui` is a tool call, and tool results normally belong to the *process* section, which DSH
collapses once the model finishes thinking — taking the card with it. So the client registers a
custom chat node (`chat-ui-card`) driven by the `tool/result` event and anchors it to the session
output stream. The tool row degrades to a one-line placeholder plus a raw-data disclosure.

If `uiConversation` is unavailable, the plugin falls back to rendering the card inside the tool row,
so the feature still works.

### Components

26 registered component types:

| Group | Types |
|---|---|
| Inputs | `Slider` `Checkbox` `Radio` `Select` `Segmented` `Input` `Textarea` `Date` `Button` |
| Containers | `Form` `Pressable` `Popover` `Carousel` |
| Visuals | `Chart` (bar/line/pie/scatter) `Map` |
| Display | `Card` `Metric` `Text` `Heading` `Row` `Column` `Divider` `Badge` `Alert` `Table` `KeyValue` |

Expressions use a whitelisted JSON AST — `{ op: "mul", args: [{ var: "a" }, { var: "b" }] }` with
`add`/`sub`/`mul`/`div`/`round`/`eq`/`and`/`or`/`not`. **No eval, no generated code.**

### Install

```bash
# in your DSH profile
dsh plugin add dsh-tool-cards
```

Or add the bundle row yourself in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`:

```json
{ "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["...", "dsh-tool-cards"] } } }
```

Then restart DSH (a profile patch is read at startup).

### Usage

The `chat_ui` tool appears in the model's tool set. Its description tells the model when to reach
for it (parameter tuning, multi-dimensional comparison, "build me a calculator") and when not to
(pure explanation, one-shot answers).

A minimal payload:

```json
{
  "title": "药剂投加量计算器",
  "ui": {
    "schemaVersion": "chat-ui/1.0",
    "initialState": { "soilTons": 1000, "doseGPerKg": 2 },
    "tree": {
      "id": "root",
      "type": "Card",
      "props": { "title": "药剂投加量" },
      "children": [
        { "id": "soil", "type": "Input", "label": "土壤质量 (t)", "bind": "soilTons",
          "props": { "inputType": "number", "min": 0 } },
        { "id": "dose", "type": "Slider", "label": "投加量 (g/kg)", "bind": "doseGPerKg",
          "props": { "min": 0.1, "max": 5, "step": 0.1 } },
        { "id": "total", "type": "Metric", "label": "理论药剂质量", "props": { "unit": "t" },
          "value": { "op": "round", "args": [
            { "op": "div", "args": [
              { "op": "mul", "args": [{ "var": "soilTons" }, { "var": "doseGPerKg" }] }, 1000
            ] }, 3 ] } },
        { "id": "submit", "type": "Button", "label": "提交这次配比", "actionId": "apply" }
      ]
    },
    "actions": {
      "apply": {
        "kind": "submitToAgent",
        "operation": "apply-dose",
        "includeKeys": ["soilTons", "doseGPerKg"]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Action kinds: `submitToAgent`, `callTool`, `openUrl` (http/https only).

### Button and copy conventions

- The submit button is the card's **only** exit: full-width, bold, separated by a rule above it.
- Button labels describe **the user's next action**, decided by the model for the task at hand —
  "应用这组参数", "计算推荐投加量", "提交这次配比".

### Limits

Per message: ≤ 120 nodes, tree depth ≤ 8, ≤ 60 state keys, ≤ 20 actions, ≤ 4000-char text.
Enforced on the host, so a malformed payload is rejected before it reaches the client.

- `C

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：固定 Web 启动 token 等。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，每个插件是 `plugins/<包名>/` 下独立的 npm 包。

## 插件

| 插件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| [dsh-fixed-pairing-token](plugins/dsh-fixed-pairing-token/) | 把 DSH Web 的启动 token 固定成配置值，重启后收藏的 GUI 地址仍然可用。 |

## 使用前提

- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`。
- 能运行 `dsh web`。profile 目录位于 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>`，未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时为 `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>`。

## 安装插件

从本仓库安装单个插件：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add \
  "github:Xinglei-dev/dsh-plugin#path:/plugins/<包名>"
```

需要锁定版本时在 `#` 后写 commit，并用 `&` 连接 `path:` 片段：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add \
  "git+https://github.com/Xinglei-dev/dsh-plugin.git#<commit>&path:/plugins/<包名>"
```

需要注意：

- 不能省略 `path:` 片段。仓库根没有 `package.json`，省略后 pnpm 会把整个仓库当成一个包安装。
- 安装或删除插件后重启 DSH 进程，新配置才会生效。

各插件的配置方法写在该插件目录的 README 里。

## 仓库结构

```text
plugins/<包名>/
├── package.json          # 包名与目录名一致，dsh.bundle.patch 指向同目录的 cordis.patch.yml
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 安装时向 profile 插入的 loader entry
├── lib/index.js          # 插件本体
├── test/                 # 离线测试
└── README.md             # 安装、配置、排障与适用的 DSH 版本
```

仓库的开发约定见 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)。

## 兼容性

每个插件针对具体的 DSH 版本开发，适用的版本写在插件自己的 README 里。DSH 处于 `0.2.x` 预发布阶段，内部接口仍会变化；插件依赖的非公开接口一旦变化，插件会在加载阶段报错，不会继续按旧行为运行。升级 DSH 后先看插件 README 的版本范围，不兼容时升级插件。

## 反馈

问题和建议提到 [Issues](https://github.com/Xinglei-dev/dsh-plugin/issues)。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text:
# apk-devkit

**DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件** —— 让 DSH 里的 AI 用自然语言直接对 APK 做解包、回编、签名、DEX 处理、资源与文件编辑，不用敲命令行。

它本身不实现任何逆向算法，是一个**编排层**：把已有的开源命令行工具（`apktool` / `aapt2` / `apksigner` / `zipalign` / `baksmali` / `smali` / `d8` / `APKEditor`）包装成 AI 可调用的工具。

> ⚠️ **平台支持：仅 Windows 10/11（64 位）。**
> Linux / macOS / Termux **不在支持范围，也无法安装** ——
> `package.json` 声明了 `os: ["win32"]`、`cpu: ["x64", "arm64"]`，
> 在其他平台上 `npm install` 会直接拒绝（EBADPLATFORM）。
> 32 位 Windows（ia32）同样不支持。

---

## 一、安装

### 方式 A：本地目录（开发调试，推荐）

```bash
cd /path/to/parent
dsh plugin --profile web add ./apk-devkit
```

以 `link:` 方式链接，改完代码重启 Web UI 即生效，无需重装。

### 方式 B：npm

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add apk-devkit
```

### 方式 C：GitHub 源

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:qftuftfutg/apk-devkit
```

### 验证是否挂载成功

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep apk-devkit
dsh --profile web
```

启动后确认：

- `--dump-config` 输出里能看到 `apk-devkit` 行
- 启动日志正常应包含一行
  `[apk-devkit] loaded; registering N tools; workspace=...`
  —— 这是插件正常的加载日志，**不是报错**。
  `N` 应为 **37**。
  若同时出现 `[apk-devkit] 模块加载失败 X: ...` 或
  `[apk-devkit] N 个模块未加载`，说明对应模块有问题（多为依赖缺失），
  工具数会少于 37 —— 这些行是**正常的故障排查信息**，不是多余的报错
- 会话中 AI 能列出 `apk_decode`、`file_read`、`apkedit_decode` 等工具

**若工具不可见**，按顺序排查：

1. `dsh --dump-config` 里**根本没有** `apk-devkit` 行
   → `dsh.bundle.patch` 缺失或路径错，插件被当成普通依赖**静默忽略**
   → 检查 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 与 `files` 是否含 `cordis.patch.yml`
2. 有 entry 但工具不可见
   → `inject: ['tools']` 声明不全，loader 让 entry 一直 `waiting for service: X`
3. 报 `Cannot find module '@deepseek-ai/...'`
   → 有人往 `plugin.mjs` 里加了宿主包 import（**禁止**，见文件头注释）
4. 报 `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM`
   → `"type": "commonjs"` 与宿主 ESM 冲突，见交接文档第十部分新发现 1
5. 是否在 `$DSH_HOME` 个人 patch 层重复 insert 了同一 `id`
   （两层同 id 会导致 loader 组合失败）

> 关于 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `id`：**不必**等于 `plugin.mjs` 导出的 `name`。
> `id` 是 patch 层用于定位/覆盖该行的键，`name` 是模块说明符（包名或文件路径）。
> 将来若发布为 `@<scope>/apk-devkit`，**`name` 必须同步改，`id` 可不变**。

---

## 二、依赖

### 必需

| 依赖 | 版本 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows | 10 / 11 | **当前唯一支持的平台** |
| Node.js | ≥ 18 | **推荐 20 LTS**（`fs.cp` 在 Node 18 早期版本有符号链接循环卡死的 bug） |
| JDK | 17+ | `java -version` 必须可用（所有 jar 依赖它） |

### 外部工具

放进 `apk-devkit/tools/windows/`，或设环境变量 `APK_TOOLS_DIR` 指向其所在目录
（如 Android SDK 的 `build-tools\<ver>\`）。

查找顺序：`<tool>.exe` → `<tool>.bat` / `.cmd` → `<tool>.jar`（走 `java -jar`）→ 系统 PATH。

> **`APK_TOOLS_DIR` 指向的就是工具所在目录本身**，不会再往下拼 `windows` 子目录。
> 例如指向 Android SDK 的 `build-tools\34.0.0\` 时，直接在该目录下找 `aapt2.exe`。

```
apktool      解包 / 回编
aapt2        读取 APK 基本信息
apksigner    签名 / 验签
zipalign     对齐
baksmali     DEX → smali
smali        smali → DEX
d8           JAR → DEX
apkeditor    二进制资源（ARSC/XML）编辑，不依赖 aapt2
```

`apkeditor` 获取：
<https://github.com/REAndroid/APKEditor/releases>
下载后**重命名为小写** `apkeditor.jar` 再放入（会自动走 `java -jar`）。

完整清单与放置规则见 [tools/README.md](./tools/README.md)。

未安装的工具，相关调用会返回明确报错与安装提示，不会静默失败。

### 可选

`sharp` —— 图片模块（`img_convert` / `img_resize`）依赖它。Windows 上无预编译包，
默认跳过安装：

```bash
npm install --omit=optional        # 跳过 sharp
npm i sharp                        # 需要图片模块时再单独装
```

不装 sharp 不影响其余 35 个工具。

---

## 三、环境变量

| 变量 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `APK_WORKSPACE` | `./workspace` | 工作区根目录，所有路径操作限定于此 |
| `APK_TOOLS_DIR` | `./tools` | 外部工具目录 |
| `APK_KS_PASS` | — | 签名 keystore 密码（可选，通常由参数传入） |
| `APK_KEY_PASS` | — | 签名私钥密码 |

所有文件操作的路径都会被 `lib/runner.js#guard` 强制限制在 workspace 内，
传入 `../` 等越界路径会被拒绝。

---

## 四、工具清单（38 个，10 个模块）

| 模块 | 数量 | 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|
| apk | 3 | `apk_info` | 读包名、版本、minSdk、权限 |
| | | `apk_decode` | 解包到目录（出 smali） |
| | | `apk_build` | 回编为未签名 APK |
| apkedit | 7 | `apkedit_info` | 深度信息：资源表/DEX/签名/语言/文件清单 |
| | | `apkedit_decode` | 二进制资源解码为 json/xml |
| | | `apkedit_build` | 重建 APK（**自带 zipalign**） |
| | | `apkedit_merge` | 合并分割包（目录形式已可用；XAPK/APKM/APKS 待实测） |
| | | `apkedit_refactor` | 混淆资源名反混淆 |
| | | `apkedit_xmlStrings` | 打印 XML 字符串池（字符常量池） |
| | | `apkedit_xmlTree` | 树形打印编译后 XML |
| sign | 3 | `sign_apk` | V1/V2/V3 签名 |
| | | `sign_verify` | 验签并输出证书 |
| | | `sign_align` | zipalign 对齐 |
| dex | 3 | `dex_disassemble` | DEX → smali |
| | | `dex_assemble` | smali → DEX |
| | | `dex_jar2dex` | JAR → DEX |
| dex2jar | 1 | `dex2jar_jar` | DEX → JAR（d2j-dex2jar） |
| diff | 2 | `diff_files` | 文本文件按行对比 |
| | | `diff_dirs` | 目录递归对比 |
| zip | 4 | `zip_list` / `zip_extract` / `zip_add` / `zip_remove` | 压缩包增删改查 |
| file | 12 | `file_read` / `file_write` | 文本读写（自动剥 BOM） |
| | | `file_list` | 列目录（**AI 定位文件的眼睛**） |
| | | `file_stat` | 存在性/类型/大小/mtime |
| | | `file_delete` / `file_mkdir` | 删除 / 建目录 |
| | | `file_copy` / `file_move` / `file_rename` / `file_batchRename` | 复制/移动/改名 |
| | | `file_readHex` / `file_patch` | 十六进制读写（对应"十六进制"功能） |
| img | 2 | `img_convert` / `img_resize` | 图片转换 / 缩放 |
| hash | 1 | `hash_compute` | md5 / sha1 / sha256 |

`npm run list-tools` 输出完整清单（含 inputSchema）。

> 运行时若看到 `[apk-devkit/apkedit] 注意：...`，这是模块加载时的**预期警告**
> （提示 APKEditor CLI 参数未经真机核实），不是错误。
> JSON 结果正常输出到 stdout，不受影响；每个进程只打印一次。

---

## 五、典型流程

**改代码（smali）**：

```
1. apk_decode          解包到 unpacked/
2. file_list           找到要改的 smali 文件
3. file_read / write   改内容
4. apk_build           回编为未签名 APK
5. sign_align → sign_apk → sign_verify
```

**改资源（字符串/图标/ARSC）**：

```
1. apkedit_decode      解码为可编辑 json
2. file_read / write   改 values-*/strings 等
3. apkedit_build       重建（自带 zipalign）
4. sign_apk → sign_verify
```

直接用自然语言让 DSH 完成，例如：
「把 workspace 里的 app.apk 解包，改完 AndroidManifest 后回编并签名」。

---

## 六、双入口

| | plugin.mjs（主） | server.js（备用） |
|---|---|---|
| 类型 | cordis 原生插件 | MCP stdio 服务 |
| 工具名 | `apk_decode` | `mcp__apk-devkit__apk_decode` |
| 挂载 | 安装即生效 | 需手写 patch.yml 或 MCP 面板配置 |
| 渲染 | 有 `output.render` | 仅纯文本 |

两者共用同一套 `orchestrator` + `modules`，能力完全一致，可并存。
`server.js` 作为 bundle 支持不全时的退路保留。

MCP 协议版本 `2024-11-05`，实现 `initialize` / `tools/list` / `tools/call`。

---

## 七、已知限制

**功能缺口**

- `file_read` 仅支持 `utf8` / `utf16le` / `latin1`，
  **GBK / GB18030 会读成乱码**（老项目的 `res/values/strings.xml` 需注意）
- `apkedit_merge` 的分割包合并：**目录形式可用**；
  XAPK / APKM / APKS 官方 README 声称支持，**尚未实测**

**不提供（设计如此）**

- 可视化编辑器面板、音视频播放、图片预览 —— 需 GUI，命令行工具给不了
- Linux 脚本 / 任意命令执行 —— 会击穿 workspace 沙箱
- DEX / RES 混淆对抗 —— 合规红线

**工程限制**

- ZIP 大文件（>100MB）处理有内存压力（`adm-zip` 全量读入）
- workspace 沙箱**不防符号链接逃逸**：别往 workspace 放来源不明的 symlink
- `file_move` 跨盘（C:↔D:）会自动退化为「复制+删除」
- `file_list` 单次最多返回 5000 条

详见交接文档第六、九、十部分。

---

## 八、合规声明

本工具仅面向开发者对**自身拥有完整著作权**的 Android APK 项目进行调试、
二次打包、签名与资源编辑。

**禁止用途**

1. 破解第三方应用、去除或绕过签名校验、绕过授权许可；
2. 规避软件著作权保护技术措施；
3. 违反《计算机软件保护条例》第二十四条、《刑法》第二百八十五条相关条款的行为。

> ⚠️ **开源工具 ≠ 可以处理他人的 APK。**
> 本工具调用的底层组件（APKEditor、Apktool、smali 等）均为 Apache-2.0 /
> BSD 等宽松许可的开源软件，这解决的是"**你能不能用这个工具**"；
> 而"**你能不能用它去处理某个具体 APK**"由《计算机软件保护条例》
> 与目标应用的用户协议约束，**与工具是否开源无关**。

---

## 九、许可与致谢

本项目自研代码（orchestrator.js / server.js / plugin.mjs / lib/ / modules/）
采用 **MIT** 许可，见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

底层能力来自以下开源项目，本项目**仅通过子进程调用其官方发布的
可执行文件或 jar**，不复制、不翻译、不修改其源码，也不随本包分发：

| 项目 | 许可 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| [REAndroid/APKEditor](https://github.com/REAndroid/APKEditor) | Apache-2.0 | 二进制资源解码/回编/合并/反混淆 |
| [REAndroid/ARSCLib](https://github.com/REAndroid/ARSCLib) | Apache-2.0 | 随 APKEditor 分发，本项目不直接调用 |
| [iBotPeaches/Apktool](https://github.com/iBotPeaches/Apktool) | Apache-2.0 | 解包 / 回编 |
| [JesusFreke/smali](https://github.com/JesusFreke/smali) | BSD-3-Clause | DEX ↔ smali |
| AOSP（apksigner / zipalign / aapt2 / d8） | Apache-2.0 | 签名 / 对齐 / 信息 / JAR→DEX |

完整说明与致谢见 [NOTICE](./NOTICE)。

---

## 十、安全约束

- `lib/runner.js#guard` 强制 workspace 路径沙箱，请勿移除
- `file_delete` / `file_move` / `file_copy` 拒绝操作 workspace 根目录
- `file_rename` / `file_batchRename` 拒绝含路径分隔符的改名结果
- 签名密码经环境变量中转，不出现在进程命令行
- `server.js` 仅实现白名单方法（initialize / tools/list / tools/call）
- 子进程并发上限 2，防止 apktool / d8 吃满内存

**已加固项（原 D1 / D2 安全洞，现已修复并实测）**

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（95 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 95 plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

Its egress report goes

plugins.description: Android companion for DeepSeek Harness | chat, goals, approvals & notifications from your phone, over your LAN. Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. plugins.readme_text:
# 插件快捷调用 · dsh-plugin-quick-invoke

给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web UI 用的插件快捷调用面板：把已安装插件的名字快速、准确地写进提示词。

> A DeepSeek Harness plugin that puts an installed-plugin picker beside the composer. Drag a plugin name into the prompt at the drop point, pin a draggable rail in the right sidebar, and choose which plugins appear (with optional remarks) in Settings.

## 功能

- **入口**：新会话里位于「工作区 / 工作模式」同一行的扩展位；进入对话后，输入框工具栏左侧保留一个紧凑入口，不会因为发出第一条消息而消失。
- **上拉面板**：单击「插件调用」向上展开插件列表；面板整体抬到输入框卡片上方，不遮挡正在编辑的内容。鼠标移到某个插件上会加深底色。
- **拖拽插入**：在列表或右侧栏中按住插件名，拖到输入框的任意位置松开，插件名会插入到落点（走输入框自身的 Lexical 拖放通道，和模块化拖拽一致）。
- **右侧常驻栏**：双击「插件调用」入口，在右侧边栏打开 / 收起「插件调用」页；里面是一排可拖动的插件名，便于反复取用。
- **设置页**：`设置 → 插件快捷调用` 列出所有已安装插件，每个插件有：
  - 一个开关：是否出现在快捷调用面板 / 右侧栏中；
  - 一条备注：会以灰色小字显示在插件名下方；
  - 搜索框与「重新读取」，插件安装变化后可刷新列表。

默认只开启「用户自己安装、且当前处于启用状态」的插件；DSH 自带可选插件包默认关闭。主题、皮肤、插件市场这类不需要调用的插件，在设置里关掉开关即可。开关只控制是否出现在快捷调用里，**不会**启用或停用插件本身。

## 兼容性

- DSH `0.2.1-rc.1` 及以上（`dsh.compatibility.dshReleases` 声明了 rc.1 / rc.2）。
- 仅 Web / Desktop 的浏览器半边；无需额外 Host 依赖，无网络请求。

## 安装

在 DSH 里通过插件管理器安装 npm 包：

1. 打开 `插件` 页面 → 添加插件，输入 `dsh-plugin-quick-invoke`；
2. 或让 DSH 里的 Agent 调用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，`target` 写 `dsh-plugin-quick-invoke`；
3. 或手动装进 profile 后把 bundle 加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```bash
pnpm add dsh-plugin-quick-invoke
```

安装后如界面未立即出现，刷新一次 Web 页面（Desktop 窗口按 `Ctrl+R`）。

## 使用

1. 新会话：点输入框上方「工作区 / 工作模式」右侧的「插件调用」，向上展开面板；按住插件名拖进输入框即可插入。
2. 对话中：输入框工具栏左侧的紧凑入口同样可用。
3. 双击入口：右侧边栏常驻「插件调用」页，拖动其中的名字到输入框。
4. 设置里调整显示范围与备注。

偏好（开关、备注）保存在当前浏览器配置的 `localStorage`（键 `dsh-plugin-quick-invoke:preferences:v1`），不写入会话日志；清除站点数据或换浏览器配置后会还原默认。

## 开发与发布

本包是纯 ESM、无构建步骤：`index.js` 是空行为的 Host 半边，`client.js` 是自包含的浏览器半边（只 require `react`），`cordis.patch.yml` 插入 Host 装载行。

发布前先让 `package.json` 的 `repository` 指向 GitHub 仓库（收录条目与 npm 包靠它关联），再按需补 `author`，然后：

```bash
npm login
npm publish
```

校验打包内容：

```bash
npm pack --dry-run
```

`files` 白名单已包含运行所需文件；`LICENSE` 为 MIT。

### 收录到 awesome-dsh-plugin

本目录已按 [贡献指南](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/blob/main/contributing.md) 准备好提交材料，步骤见 [submission/README.md](submission/README.md)：

1. 创建公开 GitHub 仓库并推送本目录；
2. 给仓库加 `dsh-plugin` topic；
3. 运行 `node scripts/write-submission.mjs <github-owner>` 生成 `data/plugins/<owner>__dsh-plugin-quick-invoke.yml`，并回填 `package.json.repository`；
4. 仓库创建满 1 天后，向 awesome-dsh-plugin 提 PR，只新增该条目文件（PR 文案见 [submission/PR.md](submission/PR.md)）。

生成文件不会进入 npm 包（`files` 白名单只含运行所需文件）。

## 目录结构

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | bundle 清单：`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client` + 兼容性 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 插入 Host 装载行（id `plugin-quick-invoke`） |
| `index.js` | Host 半（无行为，仅让 bundle 有装载项） |
| `client.js` | 全部界面：入口、上拉面板、拖拽、右侧栏、设置页 |
| `locale/*.json` | 插件管理器里的标题 / 描述（zh / en） |
| `icon.svg` | 插件图标 |
| `LICENSE` | MIT |
| `submission/` | awesome-dsh-plugin 收录材料（生成的文件不进 npm 包） |
| `scripts/write-submission.mjs` | 按 GitHub owner 生成收录条目并回填仓库元数据 |

## 已知限制

- 新会话入口使用官方提供的该行扩展位（该行右对齐），因此位于这一行右端，而非紧贴「工作模式」。
- 拖拽插入的是插件的显示标题；没有本地化标题时回退为包名。
- 偏好按浏览器 origin 存储，不跨设备 / 浏览器同步。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Manage MCP servers inside DeepSeek Harness: enable/disable, OAuth 2.1 authorization, scheduled + after-expiry token renewal, and a tool browser with descriptions. Generated by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-manager

> Manage MCP servers from inside **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**: add / enable / disable / remove / reconnect,
> authorize them with **OAuth 2.1**, keep their tokens alive with **scheduled and after-expiry renewal**,
> and browse every tool each server exposes — with its description — in one settings page.

**本项目由 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 生成 / This project was generated by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.**

[功能](#功能) · [安装](#安装) · [使用](#使用) · [OAuth 2.1](#oauth-21-授权) · [自动续期](#自动续期) · [Agent 工具](#agent-工具) · [架构](#架构) · [安全](#安全说明) · [测试](#开发与测试) · [许可](#许可)

<details>
<summary>English summary</summary>

A DSH plugin that owns the whole MCP server lifecycle: a Settings page under
**Settings → Plugins → MCP Servers**, six agent-callable tools (`mcp_manager_*`), a loopback
HTTP bridge for the page, and a built-in OAuth 2.1 client (RFC 9728 discovery, RFC 8414/OIDC
metadata, RFC 7591 dynamic client registration, authorization code + PKCE S256, RFC 8707
`resource`, refresh, sign-out, paste-token fallback) with a token renewal policy that is editable
in the UI and also self-heals after expiry. Tokens live only in the Harness credential store.
Generated by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash; review before production use.
</details>

---

## 为什么需要它

DSH 官方的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 每个实例只连**一个**服务器，清单要手写进
`cordis.patch.yml`；它只支持静态 `headers`，**不做 OAuth**；token 过期后也不会续期，连接会
一直带着过期令牌，直到下一次调用 401。这个插件把这三件事补齐，并且不重新实现 MCP 协议——
它编排真正的 mcp-client 子插件，所以被管理的服务器在 Harness 里就是普通 MCP 工具。

## 功能

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| **服务器管理** | 添加 / 编辑 / 启用 / 停用 / 重连 / 移除；`stdio`（command/args/env/cwd）与 `streamable-http`（url/headers）都支持 |
| **工具浏览** | 每个服务器展开后列出全部工具：公共名 `mcp__<服务器>__<工具>`、**工具描述**、入参名；页面与 agent 都能查 |
| **OAuth 2.1** | 受保护资源发现、授权服务器元数据、动态客户端注册、授权码 + PKCE S256、一次性 `state`、`resource` 指示符、刷新、粘贴令牌兜底、退出授权 |
| **定时续期** | 后台按策略检查（默认每 5 分钟），在到期前（默认 10 分钟）自动换令牌并重连；策略可在页面上改 |
| **过期后自动续期** | 已过期的令牌下一轮必续；更关键的是 **401 自愈**——某次 `mcp__*` 调用被判未授权时立即换令牌重连，下一次调用恢复正常 |
| **失败退避** | 续期失败按 30s → 60s → 120s …（上限为检查间隔）重试，不会每轮都打授权服务器 |
| **如实状态** | `connected` / `no-tools` / `disabled` / `error` / `connecting`，不猜测"连接成功" |
| **给 agent 的能力** | 6 个工具：`mcp_manager_list` / `add` / `remove` / `set_enabled` / `tools` / `oauth` |
| **凭证安全** | OAuth token 只写进 DSH 凭据库，不进配置、不进日志、不进页面 |

## 安装

### 方式 1：一条命令

```sh
git clone https://github.com/nekojackie/dsh-mcp-manager.git
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /path/to/dsh-mcp-manager
dsh <profile>
```

`dsh plugin add` 会在 profile 里装包，并自动把 bundle 写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`；
`mcp-manager` 这行配置由 bundle 自带的 patch 插入，**不用手写 YAML**。

- `<profile>` 是 `~/.dsh/profiles/<名字>` 的名字，桌面版一般是 `desktop`；
- `dsh` 不在 PATH 时用应用目录下的 `resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh`
  （Windows 是 `dsh.cmd`）；
- 装完在 **设置 → 插件** 里能看到 `MCP Server Manager`（行 id `mcp-manager`，状态 active），
  旁边的 **MCP 服务器** 页签就是本插件的界面。

### 方式 2：让 DSH 自己装

把下面整段发给 DSH 助手即可，它自己会克隆、安装、重启并汇报：

```text
帮我安装并启用 DSH 插件：https://github.com/nekojackie/dsh-mcp-manager

1. 把仓库克隆到任意目录（例如 ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-mcp-manager；没有 git 就下载 ZIP 解压）；
2. 执行 dsh plugin --profile <当前 profile> add <该目录绝对路径>；
   如果 dsh 命令不可用，改用 plugin_manager 的 install_bundle，target 指向该目录；
3. 重启 DSH，确认「设置 → 插件」里插件行是 active、并出现「MCP 服务器」页签；
4. 用 mcp_manager_list 把当前 MCP 服务器清单贴给我；
5. 不要改动我已有的 MCP 服务器配置。
```

> 这是 AI 生成的插件，OAuth token 会写进 DSH 凭据库，安装前可以先看一眼下面的「安全说明」。

## 使用

### 设置界面

**设置 → 插件 → MCP 服务器**（与 "全部" 页签并列）：

- 每张卡片：名称、传输方式、命令或 URL、状态点、工具数、启用开关、刷新 / 重连 / 编辑 / 移除；
- 展开卡片：该服务器的每个工具 + 描述 + 入参；
- **自动续期设置**（可折叠）：启用开关、检查间隔（秒）、提前续期（秒）、"过期后仍自动续期"、保存 / 恢复默认；
- 授权成功后卡片会自己跟上：已授权 → 正在连接… → 工具数量，不需要手点刷新。

### 直接改配置

清单与续期策略都保存在本插件这一行的 `config` 里：

```yaml
- id: mcp-manager
  name: dsh-mcp-manager
  config:
    refreshIntervalMs: 300000      # 检查周期，0 = 关闭，默认 5 分钟
    refreshLeadMs: 600000          # 提前多久续期，默认 10 分钟
    refreshOnExpiry: true          # 过期后仍自动续期（默认开）
    servers:
      - name: demo                 # ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$，同时是工具前缀
        enabled: true
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', '@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything']
        env: {}
        cwd: ''
        toolCallTimeoutMs: 60000
        failOnStartupError: false
      - name: docs
        enabled: true
        transport: streamable-http
        url: http://127.0.0.1:3000/mcp
        headers: {}
        oauth:
          enabled: true            # 需要 OAuth 时
          scopes: []               # 留空 = 用服务器元数据里的 required_scopes
          clientId: ''             # 留空 = 动态客户端注册
```

服务器字段：`name` `enabled` `transport` `command` `args` `env` `cwd` `url` `headers`
`toolCallTimeoutMs` `failOnStartupError` `oauth{enabled,scopes,clientId,clientSecret,resourceMetadataUrl,authorizationServer}`。

## OAuth 2.1 授权

受 OAuth 保护的 `streamable-http` 服务器（其 `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource` 会声明
`authorization_servers` 与 `required_scopes`）不再需要手工复制 token：

1. 编辑服务器，勾选 **使用 OAuth 授权**，保存；
2. 卡片上点 **授权（浏览器）** → 插件完成发现 + 动态注册 + PKCE，返回授权链接并在浏览器打开；
3. 在授权页同意后回跳到 `http://127.0.0.1:<DSH 端口>/api/dsh-mcp-manager/oauth/callback`；
4. 插件换取 token（存进凭据库）、重连该服务器，工具随即出现。

| 其它操作 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 粘贴令牌 | 已有 access token 时的兜底；存为非过期授权 |
| 刷新令牌 | 立即用 refresh_token 换新并重连 |
| 全部续期 | 对所有已授权服务器强制续期一遍 |
| 退出授权 | 删除本地授权记录并断开 |

- 授权链接 10 分钟有效、`state` 一次性；重复打开会提示"已使用"，重新点授权即可（会顶掉旧尝试）。
- 令牌过期前 60 秒内的下一次连接也会兜底刷新。
- 刷新失败（`invalid_grant`）会清掉本地记录并把状态显示为未授权，不会静默失联。

## 自动续期

| 触发 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 定时 | 每 `refreshIntervalMs` 检查，`expiresAt` 进入 `refreshLeadMs` 窗口即续期 + 重连 |
| 已过期 | 过期但仍有 refresh_token 的授权，下一轮必定续期 |
| 过期自愈 | `mcp__*` 调用返回 401/unauthorized/invalid_token/token expired 等时，立刻续期 + 重连（每台 30s 最多一次，最多 3 次，30/60/120s 退避） |

页面会显示当前策略、上次续期时间、下次检查时间，以及"上次续期触发：定时 / 过期后自愈 / 手动"。

## Agent 工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `mcp_manager_list` | 列出受管服务器：传输、地址、状态、工具数、启动错误 |
| `mcp_manager_add` | 新增或替换（同名覆盖）一台服务器；含 `oauth` 设置 |
| `mcp_manager_remove` | 移除服务器及其配置 |
| `mcp_manager_set_enabled` | 启用 / 停用（保留配置） |
| `mcp_manager_tools` | 列出已注册的 MCP 工具：公共名、描述、入参名，可按服务器过滤 |
| `mcp_manager_oauth` | `status` / `authorize` / `paste-token` / `refresh` / `refresh-all` / `signout` |

## 架构

```
lib/index.js    Host 半边：清单校验与持久化（configEditor）、子插件编排（ctx.plugin 真 mcp-client）、
                6 个 agent 工具、12 条回环桥接路由（11 POST + GET 回调）、续期定时器与 401 自愈
lib/oauth.js    OAuth 2.1 引擎：仅 node:crypto + 全局 fetch；发现 / 注册 / PKCE / 换取 / 刷新 / 凭据读写
lib/client.js   Web 半边：settings.plugins.tab 页签，纯 JS（无构建、无 Harness 内部包依赖）
docs/*.md       实现契约（v1 基础 / OAuth / 定时续期 / 可编辑策略），Host 与 Web 两半的字段与接口
fixtures/*.mjs  本地测试夹具：假 MCP 服务器（stdio / HTTP）、OAuth 授权服务器 + 受保护 MCP、引擎端到端断言
```

数据流：页面 ⇄ `POST /api/dsh-mcp-manager/*`（仅回环）⇄ Host；Host 用 `configEditor` 写 profile patch 并
触发 Loader 重载，用 `ctx.plugin()` 把每个启用的服务器实例化为一个真正的 mcp-client，用
`ctx.tools.schemas()` 汇总 `mcp__*` 工具。

## 安全说明

- **OAuth token 只进 DSH 凭据库** `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`，记录键 `mcp-manager/<slug>`
  （服务器名 `docs` → `mcp-manager/docs`）。不写进 `cordis.patch.yml`、不返回给页面、不进 agent 上下文、不写日志。
- 页面拿到的只有：是否已授权、过期时间、scope、`clientSecretSet`（是否已保存）。
- 桥接路由只接受**回环**请求；除 OAuth 回调（GET，仅回环）外均只接受 POST。
- `clientSecret`、`headers`、`env` 属于配置，会留在 profile patch 里——共享机器请优先用凭据中心的环境变量。
- 授权页会展示 `client_id` 与 PKCE challenge；请不要把授权链接转发给别人。

## 已知限制

- OAuth 仅实现授权码 + PKCE 流程；依赖授权服务器支持**动态客户端注册**，否则需在表单里填 `clientId`。
- `client_credentials`、设备码等流程不支持。
- 过期自愈依赖错误文本能看出是鉴权问题（401/403/unauthorized/invalid_token/token expired 等）；
  服务端如果只回自定义错误，则只能等下一轮定时续期。
- 修改清单或续期策略都会重载插件，因此所有服务器会重连一次；"重连"按钮是单服务器路径。
- 停用的服务器不续期。
- 续期成功会重连该服务器（旧连接带着旧令牌），会有约半秒的重连窗口。
- 页面外观未做逐像素比对；逻辑与桥接行为有端到端测试。

## 开发与测试

仓库自带夹具，不需要外网：

```bash
# 1) OAuth 引擎端到端（会自己起授权服务器与受保护 MCP）
node fixtures/oauth-mcp-rig.mjs 8792 &
node fixtures/verify-oauth-engine.mjs 8792
# → 44 项断言：发现 / 动态注册 / PKCE / state / 回调换取 / Bearer 注入 / 过期刷新 /
#   invalid_grant 清库 / 粘贴令牌 / 退出 / 重放拒绝

# 2) 无鉴权的 MCP 服务器（stdio 与 HTTP），用来验证管理器本身
node fixtures/mock-mcp-server.mjs            # stdio
node fixtures/mock-mcp-http.mjs 8791         # streamable-http，路径 /mcp
```

语法检查：`node --check lib/index.js`、`node --check lib/client.js`、`node --check lib/oauth.js`
（三个文件都没有构建步骤）。

## 兼容性

- 开发与验证环境：DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`、Node 24 / Windows 11；使用 Node >= 20 的语法与 API。
- 依赖 Harness 提供的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`（运行时动态导入，不打包）。
- 回环回调天然适配桌面端；远程/容器部署时授权回跳地址需能访问 `127.0.0.1:<端口>`。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)

## 声明

**本项目由 DeepS

plugins.description: Generate images from a text prompt through any OpenAI-compatible relay and attach them to the DeepSeek Harness conversation.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-image-relay

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

DeepSeek Harness（`dsh`）的图片生成插件：给文字模型一个 `image_generate` 工具，通过任意 OpenAI 兼容中转站生成图片，并把图片作为附件放进会话。

插件不内置任何中转站地址或模型，也不会把 key 发到别处。安装后由你自己填写 Base URL、模型和 API Key。

## 安装

```sh
# Web profile
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Bai-Ziyi/dsh-image-relay

# 桌面端使用的 profile
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Bai-Ziyi/dsh-image-relay
```

安装后重启一次 DSH，然后打开 **插件 → 已安装 → Image Relay / 图片中转 → 配置**。

## 配置

| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| Base URL | 空 | OpenAI 兼容地址，例如 `https://your-relay.example/v1`。 |
| API Key | 空 | 中转站的 key，右侧眼睛按钮可切换显示/隐藏，默认隐藏。 |
| 模型 | 空 | 中转站要求的图片模型 id。 |
| 默认尺寸 | `1024x1024` | 模型未指定 `size` 时使用。 |
| 超时 | `180000` | 单次生成最长等待毫秒数。 |
| 另存目录 | 空 | 可选。留空只存附件库；相对路径基于当前工作区，也可以填绝对路径。 |

**API Key 会以明文保存在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里。** 请使用只在中转站生效、可随时吊销的 key；不要填主账号的长期密钥。插件只把 key 放在发往你配置的 Base URL 的 `Authorization` 请求头里。

填了“另存目录”后，插件会在该目录再写一份可编辑的图片文件（带 `.png` / `.jpg` 等扩展名），并在工具结果里返回绝对路径。这份副本使用 Host 权限写入，请填你信任的目录；留空则仍然只保存到 DSH 附件库。

## 使用

直接对模型说：

> 画一张 1024x1024 的橘猫头像，扁平插画风，白色背景

模型会调用 `image_generate`：

- `prompt`：必填，图片描述
- `size`：可选，默认用配置
- `model`：可选，默认用配置

返回的图片会作为附件显示在会话里；如果中转站返回的是 URL，也会同时带上 URL。

## 工作原理

1. 工具向 `POST {Base URL}/images/generations` 发送 JSON：`{ model, prompt, size }`。
2. 支持中转站返回 `b64_json` 或 `url` 两种结果；URL 会被下载。
3. 图片通过 DSH 的 attachment 服务持久化，因此可以回看，也可以被支持图片输入的模型继续查看。
4. 配置了“另存目录”时，再写一份带扩展名的副本到该目录，并返回绝对路径。
5. 请求使用 Host 的全局 `fetch`，所以已经配置的 DSH 出站代理会自动生效。

## 不做什么

- 只支持 OpenAI 兼容的 `/images/generations`；不包含图生图、编辑、`n>1`、`quality` 等参数。
- 不会自动生成图片；只有模型判断需要并调用工具时才会发请求。
- 默认只保存附件；只有配置了“另存目录”才会额外写一份副本。

## 兼容性

- DSH `0.2.x`；在 `0.2.1-rc.2` 上测试过。
- 依赖 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（版本与 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 内置一致）。工具注册使用 Host 的 `ctx.tools`，不额外依赖 `dsh-tools`。
- 客户端半侧注册到 `plugins.row.config`，需要同版本 DSH 的「插件」页。

## 开发

```sh
npm test
```

测试用 mock fetch 覆盖请求构造、key 直接使用、缺少 key 的拒绝、b64 解码和图片块渲染，不访问真实中转站。

## 许可证

MIT
