plugins.readme_text:
# VeriScope 门禁重放

**中文** · [English](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/README.en.md) · [日本語](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/README.ja.md) · [한국어](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/README.ko.md)

**给 AI 回答质量做发布门禁**：判定一批已经评测过的结果能不能发布，并留下可复验的回执。

- **两条通道**：重放 VeriScope 归档（调原 Python 门禁）；或仅用 Node 对任意已有逐条评分做阈值判定——不需要 VeriScope、Python 或 pandas
- **三态**：通过／失败／待复核。待复核永不转为通过，已确认失败不被附加异常掩盖
- **回执**：绑定输入、策略、判定器与环境；条件一变，旧结论自动失效
- **不评分、不调用模型**：只消费已有结果，不重新评测

[GitHub](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope) · [Gitee 手动镜像](https://gitee.com/kkbushishou/dsh-plugin-veriscope) · 完整 VeriScope：[主仓库](https://github.com/4444wjt/RAG_Evaluation_Demo)／[镜像](https://gitee.com/kkbushishou/rag-hallucination-evaluator)。Issue 和 PR 请提交到 GitHub。

## 支持哪些宿主

| 宿主 | 形态 | 怎么接入 |
|---|---|---|
| **DSH** | 插件（cordis bundle） | `dsh plugin --profile <名称> add dsh-plugin-veriscope` |
| **Claude Code** | MCP server | `claude mcp add --transport stdio --env VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR=<目录> -- node <绝对路径>/mcp.js` |
| **Codex** | MCP server | `config.toml` 内加 `[mcp_servers.veriscope]` |
| **无宿主 / CI** | CLI | `veriscope-check --archive … --policy …` |

DSH、Claude Code、Codex 三种宿主均有实测调用记录；MCP 与 CLI 不提供 `bind`／`complete` 与原生结果卡。配置示例见 [MCP 接入说明](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/MCP.md)。

> **升级提示（0.4.0 起）**：旧回执的当前有效性将进入 REVIEW，历史 PASS／FAIL 不会改写。升级前请备份完整状态目录及原归档，并使用插件外的持久状态目录；包内 `.local` 可能随重装丢失，单独导出回执不是完整备份。ReceiptV1 重新 replay，ReceiptV2 重新 check，取得新版回执。

---

下方“原 VeriScope 路径”及其 Python 说明仅适用于 replay。

支持原 VeriScope 归档，以及 B2 的 GateArchiveV1 和指定 Ragas records 布局。不支持的格式明确拒绝，不猜测或换算。

## 已有评分直接用：B2（0.6.0 本地候选）

已经用 Ragas 得到了评分？导出评分 JSON，写明要检查的指标和阈值，让插件执行门禁并保存回执。**无需安装 VeriScope，也不会重新调用模型评分。**

只需 Node ≥22.19，在宿主启动前显式设置 `VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR` 为可写持久目录。没有 settings UI，不读取 `.env`。B2 不使用 VeriScope／Python 路径。

> 使用 `veriscope_gate_check` 检查 `D:\data\scores.json`，策略为 `D:\data\policy.json`，格式为 `ragas-records-v1`，告诉我是否通过和原因。

源码可直接试构造样例：

```powershell
$env:VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR = 'D:\your-data\veriscope-state'
node scripts/check.mjs --archive examples/builtin/ragas-records.json --policy examples/builtin/policy.json --format ragas-records-v1 --json
```

- 支持 `GateArchiveV1` 和 Ragas `result.to_pandas().to_json(orient="records")` 布局；策略显式选择 `GatePolicyV1` 或 `GatePolicyV2`，不猜测字段或阈值。
- 对全部输入记录算等权均值；缺失值不补零、不跳过。完整均值不达标，或已知有效行违反显式逐条阈值，为 FAIL；其余缺证据为 REVIEW，全部完整达标才 PASS。
- 不把 `faithfulness` 改成 `pos_faithfulness`；B2 的 PASS 不等同原门禁，不证明评分或回答事实正确，也不检查导出前被删掉的记录。
- DSH／MCP 都提供 check；CLI 安装后的命令为 `veriscope-check`。`doctor({engine:"builtin"})` 不探测 Python；status／list 支持两种回执。
- B2 使用 ReceiptV2，首版只有文本，不接入 bind／complete；DSH 导出支持 JSON／Markdown，B2 暂不支持 share。回执仍无限保留，不自动清理。

**均值通过，仍可看到最差一条。** 每指标显示最差有效行及未达均值阈值的条数；诊断本身不改裁决。需要逐条拦截时，用 `GatePolicyV2` 加 `row_threshold`，沿用该指标的方向和单位。例如构造分数的均值为 0.81、其中一条为 0.41：只查均值可 PASS，显式要求每条 ≥0.5 才 FAIL。V2 使用 JSON 原数字词元作精确十进制比较；V1 原浮点判定保持不变。

规范、策略和导出方式见包内 `docs/B2.md`、`schemas/`、`examples/builtin/`。样例为文档构造，非真实评测。0.6.0 已发布至 npm；Windows 与 Ubuntu 远端 CI（含固定上游真实回放）均已验证，Claude 完整结构化错误交付仍待验。0.5.0 历史验收保留在 `docs/acceptance-b2-v0.5.0.json`。

## 原 VeriScope 路径：配置后上手

配置好环境后（见下一节），在 DSH 中依次输入：

1. “使用 `veriscope_doctor` 检查本机环境，告诉我需要修复什么。”
2. “使用 VeriScope 检查 `D:\数据\评测结果.json`，说明是否通过及原因。”
3. “使用 `veriscope_gate_list` 列出最近的门禁回执与当前有效性。”

之后还可以说：

> 检查上次的门禁结果现在是否仍然有效。

体检的“环境就绪”仅表示环境可用，门禁通过需实际重放。聊天能否自动选中工具取决于 DSH 的模型配置；需要时直接写出工具名。

三个常见的小场景：

- **想发给维护者**：“把这次门禁失败整理成可分享的求助摘要。”使用 `format: "share"` 生成本地 Markdown，先预览、再自行分享；不是回执。
- **归档打不开**：重放会在能确认时给出异常行列或字段位置，帮助定位；不会自动改文件。
- **昨天通过、今天待复核**：状态检查会列出已确认的阈值、版本、输入摘要等变化；无法核实的范围明确保留。

需要约束任务完成时，可以要求绑定本次检查；只有绑定的回执当前有效且为 PASS，才能登记完成。

**使用前请配置 VeriScope 与 Python 路径；插件不会重新调用评测模型。**

## 安装与配置

本文对应 **0.6.0 本地候选**，提供 DSH 插件和独立的 `veriscope-mcp` 入口。npm 可用版本以[包页面](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-veriscope)为准；MCP 配置与待验范围见下文。在已验证的 DSH CLI 中，需显式指定 profile；以下使用独立的 `veriscope-demo`：

```powershell
# 安装
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo add dsh-plugin-veriscope
# 查看已安装版本
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo list dsh-plugin-veriscope --depth 0
# 卸载
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo remove dsh-plugin-veriscope
```

二次开发可走**本地目录安装**，与 npm 包名安装分开：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo add 'D:\your-workspace\dsh-plugin-veriscope'
```

以上目录路径须替换为源码实际位置；不要将目录／link 安装结果当成 registry 安装证明。**安装成功不等于门禁通过**，原 replay 首次使用需配置 `VERISCOPE_ROOT` 与 `VERISCOPE_PYTHON` 并运行体检；只用 B2 则仅配置状态根。npm 包不含测试；同包包含 `docs/B2.md`、格式规范和 B2 样例，其余文档见仓库；`npm test` 仅供源码开发；`node scripts/verify-replay.mjs` 也仅在完整源码仓库及其验证材料就绪时可用，不属于安装包能力。完整文档请查看仓库。

0.3.x 历史已验证：Windows、DSH NEXT 2.0.18-next，内部 DSH／tools／skill **0.2.1-alpha.2**。Node ≥22.19；其他宿主版本未验证。另需兼容上游及 Python／pandas，固定依赖见 [上游说明](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/UPSTREAM.md)。插件不附送完整上游或业务归档。

DSH 入口要求 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 为 `0.2.1-alpha.2`，加载前核对版本，加载后检查 `defineTool`。缺失、不兼容、加载失败分别报 `SDK_MISSING`、`SDK_INCOMPATIBLE`、`SDK_LOAD_FAILED`，不会自动安装或切换版本；这些检查不代替宿主验收。MCP 不加载 DSH SDK。

### 配置项

**没有 settings UI，不自动读取 `.env`。** 路径只读宿主进程环境变量；cordis patch 只接受 `completionMode`。宿主自己的环境加载策略由宿主决定。

| 配置 | 入口 | 默认值与要求 |
|---|---|---|
| `veriscopeRoot` | `VERISCOPE_ROOT` | Windows 默认 `D:\RAG_Evaluation_Demo`；POSIX 必须显式设置 |
| `pythonPath` | `VERISCOPE_PYTHON` | 依次探测 `.venv`／`venv`：Windows 为 `Scripts/python.exe`，POSIX 为 `bin/python`；不回退 PATH |
| 状态根 | `VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR` | 原 DSH replay 默认 `<插件目录>/.local`；B2 和所有 MCP 工具必须显式设置持久目录 |
| 提醒模式 | cordis patch `completionMode` | `off`；只允许 `off` 或 `remind`，非法值报错 |

三个环境变量的显式值须为非空绝对路径，无效值不静默回退。在**启动 DSH 的同一终端**设置后启动或完全重启宿主：

```powershell
$env:VERISCOPE_ROOT = 'D:\your-workspace\VeriScope'
$env:VERISCOPE_PYTHON = 'D:\your-workspace\VeriScope\venv\Scripts\python.exe'
$env:VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR = 'D:\your-data\veriscope-state'
# 若从 GitHub 安装，可用此命令替代前文的 npm 安装命令
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo add github:4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope
```

先准备独立 profile 和对应宿主 CLI；安装命令不创建完整宿主配置。插件 bundle 已插入默认条目；在 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<名称>/cordis.patch.yml` 按已有 `id` 覆盖配置，不要再次 `insert`：

```yaml
- id: dsh-plugin-veriscope
  config:
    completionMode: "remind"
```

`off` 关闭停止事件提醒，全部工具仍可使用。`remind` 只提醒未完成的绑定任务，不承诺普通聊天全局阻断。路径不能写入这个 config。

## 跨宿主 MCP

MCP 仍为五个工具；V2 策略复用 check／status／list，不增加入口。0.5.0 历史实调用与未验范围见 `docs/acceptance-b2-v0.5.0.json`，不替代本候选验证。以下仅回顾 0.4.0 历史验收。

0.4.0 已在独立 Claude Code／Codex 宿主通过真实工具调用（控制接口，无模型对话），Windows 与 Ubuntu 真实回放均已验证。Claude 错误路径只返回文本，完整结构化交付仍有待验项，详见验收记录。使用绝对 Node 路径启动源码 `mcp.js`，配置及独立环境示例见 [MCP 接入说明](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/MCP.md)。无需加载 DSH SDK。首版只有 `veriscope_doctor`、`veriscope_gate_replay`、`veriscope_gate_status`、`veriscope_gate_list` 四工具，无原生卡片。batch／export 及 bind／complete 仍只在 DSH；会话绑定不会移植，MCP 报告的 `execution.session_id` 为 `null`。

当前 MCP 五工具都要求显式、合法的 `VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR`；未设置时返回待复核，不回退包目录。doctor 会写入并清理临时探针，replay 会写报告和回执，二者及新增 check 不是只读；status／list 为只读。业务 FAIL 不等于工具执行错误。宿主工具调用、Linux 真实回放及本版本验收状态以 [验收记录](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/acceptance-mcp-v0.4.0.json) 为准；注册成功或自写客户端通过不能替代宿主验收。

## 九个工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `veriscope_gate_check({archive_path, policy_path, format?})` | Node 独立阈值判定；消费已有逐条评分，生成 ReceiptV2，不需要 Python |
| `veriscope_doctor({engine?})` | 默认检查原 replay 环境；`engine:"builtin"` 只检查 Node 和显式状态根，附修复建议 |
| `veriscope_gate_replay({result_path, baseline?, faith?, ctx?})` | 实际执行已有归档门禁，保存独立记录，符合条件时生成 ReceiptV1 |
| `veriscope_gate_status({run_id, faith?, ctx?, baseline_run_id?})` | 只读检查回执当前有效性，不重放、不评分、不生成回执 |
| `veriscope_gate_list({limit?})` | 默认列出最近 50 条，允许 1–200；逐条复用 status，损坏记录另列 |
| `veriscope_gate_batch({paths?, dir?, baseline?, faith?, ctx?})` | 路径数组与目录二选一；顺序重放，最多 200 份，可取消，逐份留痕 |
| `veriscope_gate_export({run_id?, run_ids?, format})` | 导出 1–50 条记录到状态根 `exports/`；`share` 为白名单求助摘要，`md` 为完整报告，`json` 为原回执；不覆盖旧文件 |
| `veriscope_gate_bind({task_id, run_id, faith?, ctx?, baseline_run_id?})` | 在宿主提供的本会话内绑定受管任务与当前回执 |
| `veriscope_gate_complete({task_id, run_id})` | 复验本会话绑定，只在当前有效 PASS 下登记完成 |

### 参数与使用规则

- 原 replay 阈值默认 0.8，须为 0–1 有限数值，不为获得 PASS 自动调低。

plugins.description: DSH plugin: shows the DeepSeek account's remaining balance in the composer bottom bar.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-account-balance-pill

A [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that shows the remaining balance of the signed-in DeepSeek account in the composer bottom bar — the stat row under the message box that already carries `N turns · M steps`, tokens/s, token usage and the context ring.

```
[welcome icon] 余额 ¥12.34        [stats] 1 轮 160 步 · 254 tok/s     [usage] 10.9M tok · 缓存命中 98%   (ring) 9%
```

The pill shows the **total spendable balance** (topped-up + granted) per currency, e.g. `余额 ¥17.34`; hovering it breaks the total down into topped-up and granted amounts, shows when it was last refreshed, and reminds you that a click refreshes it.

- Package name: `dsh-account-balance-pill`
- Shape: one DSH **bundle** — a Host row inserted by `dsh.bundle.patch` plus a Web Client half; no dependencies, no build step
- Rendering: a single entry (id `account-balance`) in the slot `conversation.composer.dock`, next to the shipped `activity` and `usage` pills
- Data: the account Remote that ships with DSH (`ctx.get('remote.account').getBalance(...)`, the same call the **Settings → Account** panel makes). The plugin stores nothing, reads no credential file, and makes no network request of its own.

## Install / 安装

Install from GitHub into the profile you use:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:azkbzxf/dsh-account-balance-pill
```

A newly added bundle activates on the running instance (the Host row is live immediately and the Client half hot-loads into the open page). Replacing an already-installed copy needs a DSH restart for the fresh client build.

Inside DSH Desktop you can also use the plugin manager:

```json
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "D:\\path\\to\\dsh-account-balance-pill" }
```

Remove:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-account-balance-pill
```

## What it shows / 显示规则

| Account state | Bottom bar |
| --- | --- |
| Signed in with a balance | Wallet icon + `余额 ¥12.34`; tooltip with the topped-up / granted breakdown, last-update time and a click-to-refresh hint |
| Signed out, or no account grant (the Remote returns `null`) | Nothing — no placeholder, no error |
| Read failure (offline, host refused) | Keeps the last known value, dimmed as stale; stays hidden if no value was ever read |
| Currencies | `¥` for CNY and `$` for USD; topped-up + granted are combined per currency, CNY first |

Amounts are formatted by truncating to cents, matching the official Settings page so the pill never shows more money than is actually available; thousands are grouped. `0` shows `¥0.00`, anything under one cent shows `<¥0.01`.

## Refresh / 刷新时机

1. immediately when the pill mounts;
2. every 30 s while the page is visible (skipped while hidden, one catch-up read when it becomes visible again);
3. 1.5 s after a turn completes (when the `sessionStats` projection's `steps` changes);
4. when the window regains focus or the page becomes visible (only if the data is older than 15 s);
5. as soon as a late-loading account Remote appears;
6. on click.

One request is in flight at a time, requests are at least 3 s apart, and failures back off exponentially from 4 s up to 60 s before recovering automatically.

## Compatibility / 兼容性

- Targets the DSH Web GUI (the browser UI shared by DSH Desktop and `dsh web`), verified on DSH Desktop 2.0.18 with client `0.2.1-rc.2`.
- Uses only supported extension points: the list slot `conversation.composer.dock` and the shipped account Remote. It never replaces or edits existing UI, never reads another plugin's DOM or styles, never appends to `document.body`.
- Styles use Harness theme tokens only (`--dsw-*` / `--dsh-*`), so light/dark themes and font-size changes are inherited. All visible text goes through the DSH client locale service (zh/en) and follows the interface language.
- Every dependency is optional: no account Remote → the plugin loads and stays hidden; a read failure keeps the last value; a render failure is caught by an error boundary scoped to this one entry, so the rest of the dock is unaffected.
- The account service is read through the service registry (`ctx.get('remote.account')`) because the `ctx.remote.account` property chain is only readable from contexts that declare that dependency explicitly.
- `package.json` exports `"./package.json"` because DSH's client-module composition locates the package manifest through that export, and the `dsh.bundle.patch` row `name` matches the package name.
- The Host half is a no-op: it registers no credential, network client, tool or session resource.

## Configuration / 可调参数

The poll interval can be overridden globally (milliseconds, clamped to 5 s – 1 h):

```js
window.__DSH_ACCOUNT_BALANCE__ = { intervalMs: 60000 };
```

## Development / 开发

`test/harness.mjs` is an offline smoke test: it loads `client.js` with stub React/document/locale/slots/remote implementations and asserts the slot registration, locale namespace, request metadata, formatting, hidden/stale states and timer counts.

```sh
node test/harness.mjs client.js
```

File map: `client.js` — Client half (pill, store, formatting, styles); `index.js` — no-op Host half; `cordis.patch.yml` — the bundle patch; `locale/{en,zh}.json` — display metadata for the plugin list; `icon.svg` — artwork.

## Known limitations / 已知限制

- The balance comes from the DeepSeek account platform and is up to a few seconds behind, not ledger-real-time.
- The dock row only renders while a session's composer is visible (existing behaviour of the shipped slot).
- If the platform keeps failing while signed in, the plugin keeps backing off and logs one console warning on the first failure; it never opens a dialog.

## License

MIT.

plugins.description: Miran Fann for DeepSeek Harness: motion-graphics tools, a Miran settings page and DeepSeek motion skills. Needs the Miran Fann engine (npx miran-fann setup).
plugins.readme_text: # Miran Fann for DeepSeek Harness Motion graphics on this Mac, from a dsh session. The plugin starts the Miran engine, hands its tools to the model as `mcp__miran__*`, and adds a **Miran** section to dsh Settings. ```text dsh session ──tool call──► dsh mcp-client ──stdio──► ~/.miran/bin/miran mcp ▲ │ └────────────── frame, video, project JSON ◄───────────┘ ``` ## Install The engine comes first; the plugin only connects to it. ```sh npx miran-fann setup # the engine in ~/.miran/bin/miran ``` Setup adds the plugin to the `web` profile by itself when dsh is installed, and every automatic update of the engine brings the plugin of the same version. To add it by hand, use **Plugins** in the dsh web sidebar with the address below, or: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:rakibulrocky14/miran-fann-dsh#v0.1.6-beta.1 ``` dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer is needed (`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@next`). Restart `dsh web` after the install. `dsh --profile web --dump-config` shows the `miran-fann` layer when it loaded. ## Sign in Miran's tools run only for a signed-in install. Open **Settings → Miran**: the page shows the account, the engine version, the GPU backend and whether the tools are connected. **Sign in** runs the real flow (the browser opens miranfann.com, the engine receives the code); **Sign out** ends it. The plugin never fakes the sign-in and never works around it. ## Settings Everything on **Settings → Miran** is read from and written to the engine, so dsh, Claude Code and Codex agree: | Part | What it does | | --- | --- | | Account | Who is signed in; sign in and out through the engine | | Engine | Path, version, GPU, setup command when missing | | Workspace | Folder the engine reads and writes | | Tools | Tool surface (default, lean, full); the engine's own choice | | dsh tools | Connected state, reconnect | | Live viewer | Start the viewer, viewer theme, time units, preview quality | | Render defaults | Export quality, file-size limit, default voice | | API keys | Google Gemini, ElevenLabs, OpenRouter, fal, Replicate | | Generation | Image, video and draft models, per-call and per-day caps, spend so far | | Voices | Default voice, cloud voices, built-in voice | | Feedback and updates | Share feedback, auto-update, version, update now | | Skills | The skills this plugin gives the agent | Keys go to dsh's credential store **and** to Miran's own key store, as secret fields. The page only ever shows the last four characters. An environment variable with the same name wins over both. The **Built-in plugins → Miran** tab shows the same state as a card, with **Open live viewer**. ## Tools and skills The model sees the engine's tools as `mcp__miran__`. The default list is the engine's own `MIRAN_TOOLS_DEFAULT`; **Settings → Tools** offers the engine choice, `lean` (about 30 tools, the rest through `runScript`) and `full` (every tool in the schema). Skills ship in `skills//SKILL.md` and load into dsh's skill registry, so `/miran-...` and model-side loading use the same files. ## Configuration Profile settings live in `cordis.patch.yml`; every field has a default. | Field | Default | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | `enginePath` | `""` | Engine binary; empty means `~/.miran/bin/miran`, then `PATH` (`MIRAN_BINARY` also counts) | | `workspace` | `""` | Folder the engine reads and writes; empty leaves it to the engine | | `tools` | `"default"` | `default` follows `MIRAN_TOOLS_DEFAULT`, `lean` lists about 30 tools, `full` lists all | | `viewer` | `true` | Start the live viewer with the engine | | `viewerPort` | `47800` | Preferred viewer port; the next free one when taken | ## Troubleshooting **"Miran engine not found"** — run `npx miran-fann setup`, or set `enginePath` to the binary. The settings page prints the path it looked for. **Tools connected, but a call says sign-in is required** — open **Settings → Miran** and sign in; the engine gates every tool call on the account. **No Miran section in Settings** — the browser half did not load. Check that `dsh --profile --dump-config` lists `miran-fann`, then restart `dsh web` and reload the page. **A render returns no image** — the engine sends images as MCP image parts; dsh shows them in the session. If a call returns text only, the engine refused the render and the message says why. **The viewer will not open** — the port is taken. Change `viewerPort`, or stop the other viewer.

plugins.description: 奶蛙（bellylaugh）桌宠 DSH 插件：常驻 Deepseek harness 界面右下角，跟着 Agent 工作状态切换动作，任务完成时捧腹大笑。零依赖，支持热换宠物与笑声。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pet-bellylaugh · 奶龙桌宠 > 一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（DSH）桌面宠物插件：把奶龙放在 Web 界面右下角， > 动作跟着 Agent 的工作状态走，任务完成时捧腹大笑，并放一段「哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈」。

- 🐣 **零依赖**：宿主半只用 Node 内置模块，浏览器半只碰 DOM / fetch / Audio - 🎞️ **状态驱动**：待机 / 工作中 / 工具跑完 / 任务完成 / 出错，五种反应 - 🖱️ **可拖动**：拖着走、松手记住、右键归位 - 🎵 **音频可热换**：往 `assets/` 丢一个 `laugh.*` 就换掉了，不用改代码、不用重启 - 🧩 **素材可换**：覆盖 `assets/spritesheet.webp` 就是换宠物（8 列 × 9 行、单帧 192×208） ## 目录 ``` dsh-pet-bellylaugh/ ├─ package.json # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client 声明 ├─ cordis.patch.yml # bundle 自带的 loader 插入项 ├─ lib/host.js # 宿主半：监听 Agent 事件 + 提供 HTTP 接口 ├─ lib/client.js # 浏览器半：渲染桌宠、播动画、放声音 ├─ assets/spritesheet.webp # 默认宠物（8×9） ├─ assets/pet.json # 默认宠物的名字 ├─ assets/laugh.mp3 ├─ assets/pets/<名字>/ # 可选：放别的宠物，优先于默认那只 ├─ preview/*.png ├─ tools/preview.mjs # 假宿主预览，不装 DSH 也能看 ├─ LICENSE # MIT（仅覆盖代码） └─ NOTICE # 素材版权说明 ``` 两半的分工刻意做得很薄：宿主只负责把"现在忙不忙 / 刚干完什么"变成一个 JSON， 浏览器端每 500ms 拉一次。没有 RPC、没有 SSE、没有 WebSocket，出问题一眼就能看出来。 ## 安装 ```yaml # 在你 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 末尾追加 - insert: - id: ui-pet-bellylaugh name: 'dsh-pet-bellylaugh' ``` 再把本目录放进该 profile 的 `node_modules/`（软链、junction 或直接 `dsh plugin --profile add <本目录>` 都行）。 生效方式： - 改 `cordis.patch.yml` 后配置**热重载**，不用重启应用； - 浏览器端插件是在渲染 `index.html` 时注入的，所以要**刷新一次页面**才看得到宠物； - 改了 `lib/host.js` 需要重启 DSH（Node 的 ESM 缓存按包名留存）。 ## 开发时预览（不装 DSH 也能看） 浏览器端的动作完全由 `/state` 驱动，所以可以拿一个假宿主单独渲染： ```bash node tools/preview.mjs 18999 # 打开 http://127.0.0.1:18999/?mode=idle|busy|tool|done|error ``` ## 动作映射 精灵图是固定的 8 列 × 9 行网格（单帧 192×208），每一行是一段现成的动画。插件只做"选行 + 播帧"： | 状态 | 触发条件 | 精灵图 | 表现 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 待机 | 没有 Agent 在跑 | 第 0 行 · 6 帧 · 5.5fps | 站着呼吸、眨眼 | | 工作中 | 有 Agent 处于 `running` | 第 7 行 · 6 帧 · 7fps | 手在肚子上揉来揉去 | | 工具跑完 | 每次 Tool 调用结束 | 第 1 / 2 行 · 8 帧 · 13fps | 左右小跑两圈（方向随机） | | 任务完成 | 最后一个 Agent 回到 `idle` | 第 5 行 ×3 → 第 8 行 | 捧腹大笑再招手，气泡「哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈」，同时放笑声 | | 出错 | 本回合有 `agent/error` | 第 6 行 + 抖动 | 气泡「哎呀，好像出错了」 | | 被戳一下 | 鼠标点宠物 | 第 8 行 · 6 帧 · 9fps | 招手 | 没被用到的第 3、4 行（笑得更凶的两段）保留在表里，想换台词改 `ANIMS` 即可。 ## 素材来源 - **形象**：原样拷贝自本地 Codex 的 `~/.codex/pets/bellylaugh/spritesheet.webp`，一像素没改。 - **声音**：由作者从用户本地提供的一段音频转换而来。原文件是 **WMA(ASF) 容器套了个 `.flac` 后缀**， Chromium 放不了，所以用 Windows Media Foundation 转成了 `assets/laugh.mp3` （192 kbps / 48 kHz / 9.98 s，240 KB）。每次播放 4.2 秒后淡出，不会一直响。 ⚠️ 形象和音频属于第三方素材，**不在 MIT 许可范围内**，详见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。 ## 操作 | 动作 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | 单击（不拖动） | **越戳越嗨**，见下面「互动」一节的递进表 | | 长按 0.7 秒 | 抚摸它：眯起来摇三下 + 「❤️ 呼噜呼噜…」 | | 按住拖动 | 把宠物挪到任意位置；拖的时候会**朝拖动方向跑动**，松手记住位置（存 `localStorage`，刷新后还在） | | **Shift + 单击** | 立刻大笑一次，用来试听当前的音频 | | 鼠标右键 | 回到右下角默认位置（复位） | | 悬停 → 右上角 🔊 | 静音 / 取消静音 | | 悬停 → 右上角「龙」 | **隐藏**桌宠（黄底小圆，字取宠物名的**最后**一个字） |

## 互动 ### 点击递进 连着戳会一路升级，1.6 秒内没有下一次点击就重新计数： | 第几次 | 动作 | 台词（每次随机） | | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | 招手（第 8 行） | 嗨～ / 在呢在呢 / 有事吗？ / 戳我干嘛～ | | 2 | 拍肚子（第 7 行） | 嘿嘿～ / 舒服～ / 再来一下 / 咕噜咕噜 | | 3 | 怕痒（第 3 行） | 痒～哈哈哈 | | 4–6 | 捧腹大笑（第 5 行）+ **笑声** | 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈 | | 7+ | 不高兴（第 6 行 + 抖动） | 别戳啦！ / 晕了晕了 / 再戳要生气咯 / 住手住手 | 第 4~6 下会真的放笑声（就那段奶龙大笑），每次戳都从头重放、1.8 秒后淡出， 所以连戳是"哈哈哈…哈哈哈…"的节奏，不会叠成一团。静音状态下照旧不出声。 第 7 下之后计数清零，再戳又从头开始；停手 1.6 秒也会归零。 ### 抚摸 按住不动 0.7 秒算抚摸（移动超过 4px 就变成拖动，不会误触）。抚摸会打断正在播的动作， 换成拍肚子三圈 + 爱心台词。 ### 自己找乐子 空闲时每 42 秒掷一次骰子：45% 概率随便演一段（招手 / 待机 B / 拍肚子）， 50% 概率冒一句话；说话内容会根据 Agent 忙不忙切换（「发呆中…」vs「我帮你盯着」）。 隐藏、正在拖动、或已有动画在播时不会插话。 三段台词表和节奏档位都在 `lib/client.js` 顶部，改文案直接改数组即可： ```js const CLICK_STREAK_MS = 1600; // 连击窗口 const LONG_PRESS_MS = 700; // 长按阈值 const IDLE_TALK_MS = 42000; // 闲聊间隔 const GREET_LINES = ["嗨～", …]; ``` ## 隐藏与恢复 隐藏和恢复是**一对同款小黄圆**，各自取宠物名的一个字： | 位置 | 内容 | 作用 | | --- | --- | --- | | 悬停时右上角 | 「龙」（名字**最后**一个字） | 点击隐藏 | | 隐藏后原地 | 「奶」（名字**第一**个字） | 点击恢复 | 默认宠物叫「奶龙」，所以就是龙 ↔ 奶；换成豆包就自动变成「包」↔「豆」。

恢复入口是 **26px 的黄色小圆**，刚出现时会脉冲三下提醒位置，鼠标移上去会放大。 点它、或者按 Tab 聚焦后回车，宠物就回来了。隐藏状态记在 `localStorage` （`dsh-pet-bellylaugh:hidden`），所以刷新页面也还是隐藏的 —— 但那个小圆始终在， 不存在「藏了找不回来」的情况。想彻底不留痕迹就别用隐藏，直接按下面「怎么卸载」关掉插件。 隐藏期间插件**不轮询、不放声音**（省得一有任务完成就凭空传来笑声）； 重新显示时会静默对齐状态，不会把隐藏期间攒下的事件一次性补播。 ## 怎么换音频 **不用改代码，也不用重启** —— 丢文件就行： 1. 把音频放进 `dsh-pet-bellylaugh\assets\`，文件名以 `laugh` 开头，比如 `laugh.wav`。 2. 目录里**修改时间最新**的那个 `laugh.*` 会被选中，旧的不用删。 3. 宿主每 1.5 秒重扫一次目录，`/state` 里带出文件名和版本号（mtime）；版本一变， 浏览器端就换上新的 URL —— 连刷新页面都不必，下一次大笑就是新声音。 4. 一个 `laugh.*` 都没有时，会退而选 `assets\` 里最新的任意音频文件。 支持的格式：`mp3 / m4a / aac / wav / ogg / opus / flac / webm`（Chromium 能解的那些）。 > ⚠️ **WMA / ASF 不行**。Chromium 解不了这两个容器，得先转成上面任一格式再丢进来。 > 本项目自带的 `laugh.mp3` 就是从这样一个"WMA 套 .flac 后缀"的文件转出来的。 ## 怎么换宠物 跟音频一个待遇 —— **不用改代码**。两种方式： **A. 换掉默认那只**：直接覆盖 `assets\spritesheet.webp`（刷新页面生效）。 **B. 单放一个宠物目录**（推荐，可以和默认那只共存）： ``` assets/ ├─ pet.json # 默认宠物的名字，可留 ├─ spritesheet.webp # 默认那只 ├─ laugh.mp3 └─ pets/ └─ doubao/ # 目录名随意 ├─ pet.json # 可选：{"displayName": "豆包"} └─ spritesheet.webp ``` 规则： 1. 只要 `assets\pets\` 下有宠物，就**优先用它**（多个时取修改时间最新的那个）。 这条比"按时间取最新"更明确 —— Windows 的普通复制会保留源文件 mtime， 光比时间会让"刚拷进来的宠物反而不生效"。 2. 网格**列数/行数从图片实际尺寸算**：`宽 ÷ 192`、`高 ÷ 208`。 所以 8×9（1536×1872）和 8×11（1536×2288）两种 Codex 素材包都能直接用， 不会把 11 行压成 9 行。 3. 名字取同目录 `pet.json` 的 `displayName`，没有就退回目录名 —— 会用在提示气泡和 tooltip 上。 4. 宿主每 1.5 秒重扫，`/state.pet` 里带 `id / name / columns / rows / v`，版本一变浏览器就换图， 连刷新都不必。 > 你本机 `~/.codex/pets/` 里那 8 只里，`gugu-gaga` 和 `nai-long-2` 是 8×11 的 v2 素材包， > 其余是 8×9；把整个文件夹（`pet.json` + `spritesheet.webp`）拷进 `assets\pets\<名字>\` 就能换过去。 行序沿用同一套 Codex 约定（第 0 行待机、第 1/2 行跑、第 5 行大笑、第 7 行拍肚子、第 8 行招手）， 所以换任何一只 Codex 宠物，动作映射都成立。 ## 怎么卸载 两种，从轻到重： **① 临时关掉**（保留文件，随时能开回来） ```yaml # profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里，给这条加上 disabled - insert: - id: ui-pet-bellylaugh name: 'dsh-pet-bellylaugh' disabled: true ``` 配置**热重载**，改完刷新页面就没了；想开回来把 `disabled` 删掉即可。 DSH 的「设置 → 插件」页面里也有同样的开关。 **② 彻底移除**：删掉 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那条 `insert` 项，再删掉 `/node_modules/dsh-pet-bellylaugh`（如果是 junction，删链接即可，源目录还在），刷新页面。 > 只想让它安静但不想消失？悬停宠物，点右上角出现的 🔇 图标静音即可（记在 localStorage）。 拖拽用 `pointerdown/move/up` + `setPointerCapture`，位移小于 4px 视为点击，所以"点一下"和"拖一下"不会互相打架。 位置按"距右下角的距离"存储，窗口缩放时会自动夹回可视区域内。 ## 可调参数 | 想改什么 | 改哪里 | | --- | --- | | 大小 | `lib/client.js` 的 `--dsh-pet-fw` / `--dsh-pet-fh`（保持 12:13，否则会裁帧） | | 默认位置 / 层级 | `.dsh-pet { right / bottom / z-index }`，默认位置另见 `DEFAULT_POS` | | 音量 | `VOLUME`（默认 0.85） | | 笑声时长 | `LAUGH_MS`（任务完成后，默认 4200）/ `GIGGLE_MS`（点出来的，默认 1800） | | 轮询频率 | `POLL_MS`（默认 500） | | 哪一行演什么 | `ANIMS` 表 | | **眨眼快慢** | `ANIMS.idle.frames`：这是个**显式帧序列**（不是帧数），想更少眨眼就把两次 `1` / `4`（闭眼帧）之间多塞几帧睁眼姿势；`ANIMS.idle.fps` 控制整体速度 | | 拖起来跑多快 | `ANIMS.runR` / `ANIMS.runL` 的 `fps` | | 连击节奏 / 长按阈值 | `CLICK_STREAK_MS`（默认 1600）/ `LONG_PRESS_MS`（默认 700） | | 自动闲聊间隔 | `IDLE_TALK_MS`（默认 42000），设成 `0` 之外的大数即可近似关掉 | | 互动台词 | `GREET_LINES` / `HAPPY_LINES` / `ANNOYED_LINES` / `PET_LINES` / `IDLE_LINES` / `BUSY_LINES` | | 挪不动了想复位 | 右键宠物 | > `ANIMS` 里 `frames` 写数字时表示"播 0..n-1 全套"，写数组时表示"按这个顺序播"， > 两者都支持。待机之所以用数组，是因为直接循环 6 帧会让它每 1.1 秒眨一次眼， > 现在改成 30 帧的序列，眨眼间隔约 2.9–3.8 秒。 ## 接口 | 方法 | 路径 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | GET | `/pet-bellylaugh/state` | 当前快照：`busy`、`running`、`lastTool`、`toolSeq`、`doneSeq`、`errorSeq`、`clientMountedAt`、`laugh{file,v,size}`、`pet{id,name,columns,rows,v}` … | | GET | `/pet-bellylaugh/sheet` | **当前生效的精灵图**（由目录扫描决定），带版本号 ETag | | GET | `/pet-bellylaugh/audio` | **当前生效的笑声**（由目录扫描决定），带版本号 ETag | | GET | `/pet-bellylaugh/assets/` | `assets/` 里白名单扩展名的文件，带 mtime ETag | | POST | `/pet-bellylaugh/report` | 浏览器端挂载上报，纯诊断 | 文件名只接受纯文件名（拒绝 `/`、`\`、`..`），扩展名必须在白名单里，所以请求路径拼不进文件系统。 媒体一律 `Cache-Control: no-cache` + 基于 mtime/size 的 ETag：文件换了就换校验值，没换就 304。 `clientMountedAt` 非空说明宠物真的挂到页面上了。 ## 已知边界 - **最小化窗口时宠物会跟着消失，这是插件模型的硬边界，不是 bug。** DSH 桌面端是 Electron 主进程 fork 一个 `ELECTRON_RUN_

plugins.description: Version browser for installed DeepSeek Harness plugins: list published versions, switch or roll back, and uninstall from the Plugins page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-versions

Version browser for **DeepSeek Harness** plugins. It adds an **Installed plugins** page under **Settings → Plugins** where you can see every published version of an installed plugin, switch to one, roll back, or uninstall it — all through the host's own `pluginManager` service.

English | [中文](./README.zh.md)

## Why

The official plugin manager intentionally has no version picker: third-party plugins are upgraded by uninstalling and reinstalling, and only official on-demand bundles get an explicit **Update** button. Pinning a known-good version, or returning to one after a regression, means editing `package.json` by hand.

This plugin adds exactly that missing surface, without replacing the market or the installer.

## Features

- Lists the bundles the current profile installs, with version, source spec, and whether the bundle is removable
- Expands a bundle into its full published version list from the registry (publish date, `latest`, deprecated flags)
- Switches version through `pluginManager.removeBundle` → `pluginManager.installBundle`, saving an exact dependency
- **Automatic rollback**: if the target version fails to install (peer gate, missing version, network), the previous version is installed back and the failure is reported
- Uninstalls a profile bundle from the same tab
- Works with the profile's configured registry (private registries included) and falls back to `registry.npmjs.org`

## Install

The npm package is not published yet, so install straight from this repository:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:DangDangDeng/dsh-plugin-versions
```

or with an explicit Git URL:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add git+https://github.com/DangDangDeng/dsh-plugin-versions.git
```

In DSH Desktop the `desktop` profile is managed by the application, so use **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter `github:DangDangDeng/dsh-plugin-versions` instead of the CLI. Restart or refresh the page afterwards. Add `#<tag>` or `#<commit>` to pin a revision.

Once published to npm, `dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-versions` will work as well.

## Use

1. Open **Settings → Plugins**.
2. Select the **Installed plugins** tab.
3. Expand a plugin to see its versions. The current one is tagged, and the newest is tagged `latest`.
4. **Switch** asks for confirmation, then removes and reinstalls the plugin at that version. A failure rolls back automatically.
5. **Uninstall** removes the bundle; its configuration is kept.

Refresh the page after a switch so the browser loads the other version's client half.

## How a switch works

```
pluginManager.listBundles()        find the installed bundle, remember its version
pluginManager.removeBundle(name)   unload + remove the dependency
pluginManager.installBundle(name@version, { saveExact: true, enabled: true })
   ├─ success → ChangeResult.application: applied | restart-required
   └─ failure → remove the half-installed package, install the previous version
```

`installBundle` refuses a package the profile already depends on (`already-installed`) in HMR profiles, which is why the removal is not optional. The host performs the same check before pnpm runs, so an incompatible peer range is reported without touching the profile.

## HTTP surface

The client half talks to the host half over one loopback-only route:

```
POST /plugin-versions/api/{list|versions|switch|remove}
```

Requests must carry `x-requested-with: XMLHttpRequest`, must not be `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`, and must arrive on a loopback `Host` (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `::1`). Only bundles already installed in this profile can be switched or removed, so the route cannot be used as a general package installer.

## Limitations

- Loopback only: a page served with `--trusted-host` from another machine is refused.
- No automatic update check; this is a version browser, not an updater.
- Compatibility is not pre-checked per version — the host rejects an incompatible version and the switch rolls back.
- A switch needs `HMR` to apply live; without it the host reports `restart-required`.
- The page must be refreshed before the new version's client half runs.

## Development

Plain ESM, no build step:

```
index.js          host half: HTTP route + pluginManager calls
client.js         browser bundle: registers the Versions tab into plugins.tab
cordis.patch.yml  inserts the bundle row
locale/*.json     bundle title and description
```

Point the installer at this directory (`dsh plugin add <path>`, or **Add plugin** with an absolute path). The directory is linked, so edits take effect after a restart.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: A permanent 'Delete session' action for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, behind a confirmation dialog.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-clean-delete

A permanent **Delete session** action for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, behind a
confirmation dialog that tells you what is about to go.

DSH ships a *Archive* action, which is reversible and keeps the session in the
Archived list. This plugin adds the irreversible counterpart, and — unlike a
naive `rm` of the session log — it actually makes the row disappear.

## What it does

Adds one row to the per-session `…` menu in the left sidebar, ordered after
Pin / Rename / Fork / Archive. Choosing it opens a modal that reports:

- whether the session is **still open on this machine** (it cannot be reopened afterwards),
- the **log size** about to be removed,
- **running turns, subagents, background jobs and reminders** bound to the session,
- how many reminders are deleted with it.

Confirming stops the session's work, unlinks its session directory and projection
checkpoint, and releases the id from every registry that would otherwise keep
listing it. Then the sidebar refreshes and the row is gone.

There is **no undo and no trash folder**. The dialog says so.

## Why it is not just `rm`

A session's directory is not the only thing that makes it appear. The Host's
session corpus is `persistence ∪ live`, so a session the Host still holds live
keeps coming back after its log is deleted:

1. the browser drops the row,
2. the next `sessions.refresh()` rebuilds the rows from the Host list and folds
   the live summary back in,
3. the row **returns**.

The visible symptom of this is that deleting several sessions in a row makes the
earlier ones reappear, and that archived rows come back stuck in Archived forever
(the old id was never removed from the archive set, so it accumulated dead ids).

`release()` therefore detaches through the same teardown the owning fiber uses,
in the order the agent loop's own disposal uses — **agents first, then
sessions** — plus `unarchiveSession(id)` and `workspace.detachSession(id)`. The
browser keeps its own `retired` set and re-applies every retirement after each
refresh, so rows stay retired until the Host's `api-session/removed` agrees.

## Install

This package ships a `dsh.bundle` manifest, so `dsh plugin` installs it as a
profile layer by itself — **you do not need to edit `cordis.patch.yml`**. Bare
`@deepseek-ai/*` imports are resolved by the host itself, so the package declares
**zero dependencies** — do not add them.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-clean-delete
```

That is the npm name, and it is also the repository name.

From a source clone, `dsh plugin` is a pnpm passthrough, so a `file:` path works
too:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-session-clean-delete
```

That command does two things: it adds the package as a dependency, **and** it
appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`. The second
half is the one people miss — without it the package is just an unused
dependency, because the bundle patch in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)
is only read for packages the bundle list names.

Verify it joined the tree — the entry must appear under a banner naming the
plugin's own `cordis.patch.yml`, which is the part that is easy to miss:

```bash
dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config | grep -B1 session-clean-delete
```

```
# == …/dsh-session-clean-delete/cordis.patch.yml
- id: session-clean-delete
  name: dsh-session-clean-delete
```

A row under a banner for the *profile's* `cordis.patch.yml` means something
inserted this plugin by hand and it is **not** installed as a bundle — the
dependency is present but the layer never composes. `--dump-config` never
mounts, so it is safe against the live profile.

Finally **restart the harness**. The bundle is composed at boot, so there is no
partial effect: until it restarts, the menu row is not there.

### If nothing happens

- **Re-running the same add is a no-op** — same spec, same version.
  `rm -rf ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-clean-delete` first, or
  the profile keeps serving the old copy forever.
- pnpm **copies** the package into the profile rather than symlinking it, so
  editing your clone does not change the running plugin. Copy
  `lib/*.js` into `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-clean-delete/lib/`.
  `client.js` hot-reloads; `index.js` is host-side and needs a restart.
- `dsh plugin` needs `pnpm` on `PATH` (`corepack enable pnpm`), or it fails with
  "pnpm was not found".
- pnpm installs a version **older** than the registry `latest` when a release is
  less than 24 h old — that is `minimumReleaseAge`, a supply-chain guardrail, not
  a stale cache. Wait, or use a `^x.y.z` range so the newer release arrives on
  its own.

## Design notes

**A Typert `Remote` service, not an HTTP route.** The host half registers one
`TypertRemoteService` named `sessionDelete` with `describe` and `deleteSession`.
The Gateway auto-claims every endpoint a live `TypertRemoteService` declares, and
the browser calls it over the ordinary channel:

```js
ctx.connection.rpc.call('/api', `sessionDelete/${method}`, { args: { request } })
```

So there is no route to register and no permission to grant — the browser peer is
the owner principal.

**It deliberately does not check `Origin`.** In the desktop app the renderer
origin is the custom scheme `dsh-app://app`, and the shell's `protocol.handle`
strips `origin`, `host`, `cookie` and `sec-fetch-site` before forwarding to the
Host. A plugin route that validates `origin === 'http://' + host` therefore 403s
*every* request from the desktop app while working fine under `dsh web`. The
Remote-service path avoids the question entirely.

**The postcondition is checked against the disk.** A successful `rm` is not
treated as proof; `removeLog()` stats the path afterwards and throws
`delete/failed` if it survived.

## Files

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half: `TypertRemoteService`, the delete sequence, registry release. |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half: the menu row and the `shell.overlay` confirmation dialog. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch named by `dsh.bundle`; inserts this plugin into a profile. |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | Plugin titles for the Plugins panel. |

The in-app dictionary lives in `lib/client.js` (`zh` is the key-set source of
truth, `en` is checked complete against it); `locale/*.json` is the metadata the
Plugins panel reads.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.readme_text:
---
description: "Gemini subagent: drive the official Google Gemini CLI as a one-shot coding subagent inside DeepSeek Harness (subagent_gemini delegation tool)."
kind: "package-bundle"
---

# dsh-subagent-gemini

> **发布状态：暂未发布到 npm / DSH 插件市场。**
> Gemini CLI 目前尚未提供 Gemini 4，且本插件需要用户自备 Gemini API key 才能完成端到端验证；
> 在验证通过前不提交市场收录，避免把未经验证的插件放给用户。代码、测试与 CI 均已就绪，验证后可发布。
>
> 想用 Gemini 4 请安装 [`dsh-subagent-antigravity`](https://github.com/PipeDream941/dsh-subagent-antigravity)。

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Adds a **Gemini subagent** to DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a parent session can call
`subagent_gemini` to run a Google Gemini CLI coding agent in a **separate process**
inside the parent workspace, let it edit files and run commands on its own, and
get only the final answer back.

The shape is the same as the official Codex subagent (`subagent_codex`) and the
community Cursor subagent (`cursor_code`):

- **Fresh process, fresh session** — every delegation spawns a new `gemini --acp`;
- **Final answer only** — the child's thoughts, tool calls and stderr never enter the parent conversation;
- **One task per run** — no follow-up input or continuation (use the native `subagent`/`fork` backends for those);
- **Safe diagnostics** — failures report fixed stage/category facts, never stderr, paths or credentials.

> Community plugin; not affiliated with Google. Gemini CLI is Google's official CLI — this plugin only drives it from DSH.

## How it works

```
parent session (DeepSeek model)
   │  calls tool subagent_gemini({ description, prompt })
   ▼
DSH subagent seam (ctx.subagents)
   │  provider: gemini (registered by this plugin)
   ▼
@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp (official ACP subagent backend)
   │  spawn, ACP handshake, auto-answered permissions, process-range cleanup, safe diagnostics
   ▼
gemini --acp --skip-trust  (separate process, parent cwd)
   │  uses Gemini CLI's own tools (file edits / shell / search / MCP …)
   ▼
final answer → parent conversation
```

This plugin owns the Gemini-specific parts — **locating the executable**, **validating configuration**
and **detecting credentials at load time with actionable guidance**. Process lifecycle and the ACP
protocol are handled by DSH's official backend, so a DSH upgrade does not require rewriting the protocol here.

## Requirements

| Dependency | Version / notes |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.1-rc.2` series (provides `ctx.subagents` and the ACP subagent backend) |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24` |
| Google Gemini CLI | a build that supports `--acp` (`0.60+`, latest recommended) |
| Gemini credential | Gemini Developer API key (recommended), or Vertex AI / Code Assist variables |

Install the CLI:

```bash
npm install -g @google/gemini-cli
gemini --version
```

## Install the plugin

**From the DSH plugin market (recommended):** search for `dsh-subagent-gemini`, install and enable it.

**From the command line:**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-subagent-gemini
```

Then add the package to that profile's `package.json` → `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart (or let the
profile recompose):

```json
"dsh": {
  "profile": {
    "bundles": ["…", "dsh-subagent-gemini"]
  }
}
```

Once enabled, every agent sees the global tool `subagent_gemini` (a running session picks it up on its next request).

## Credentials (important)

Gemini CLI needs its own credential. **Google account browser login (OAuth) no longer works**: Google retired
the individual Gemini Code Assist OAuth client for Gemini CLI, and the CLI reports
*"This client is no longer supported for Gemini Code Assist for individuals"*.
Use an **API key** instead:

1. Create a key at <https://aistudio.google.com/apikey>;
2. Store it where Gemini CLI looks (no plugin config required):

```bash
printf 'GEMINI_API_KEY=your-key\n' > ~/.gemini/.env
chmod 600 ~/.gemini/.env
```

Gemini CLI loads `~/.gemini/.env` automatically. Environment variables also work:

- `GEMINI_API_KEY` — Gemini Developer API;
- `GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI=true` + `GOOGLE_API_KEY` — Vertex AI;
- `GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_GCA=true` — Google Code Assist license.

To pass variables to the child explicitly, use the plugin's `env` config (see below). The plugin never reads,
logs or returns secret values.

## Usage

The model calls it like any other delegation tool:

```json
{
  "name": "subagent_gemini",
  "arguments": {
    "description": "Fix login timeout",
    "prompt": "In the workspace, find the login request timeout and raise it from 5s to 15s, run the related tests, and reply only with what you changed and the test result."
  }
}
```

- `description` — 3–5 word task name shown in the subagent list;
- `prompt` — a **self-contained** task; the child cannot see the parent conversation, so include paths, constraints and acceptance criteria.

When the run finishes the parent receives a completion notice with Gemini's final answer or a safe failure
diagnostic. The child's tool traffic and reasoning stay out of the parent session.

## Configuration

Override the `subagent-gemini` entry's `config` in a profile patch:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `providerName` | `gemini` | Name registered on `ctx.subagents`; must be unique in one profile |
| `command` | empty (auto-detect) | Path to the `gemini` executable; empty searches `PATH`, then `~/.local/bin`, `/opt/homebrew/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, … |
| `args` | `['--acp', '--skip-trust']` | CLI arguments; `--acp` is always kept, `--skip-trust` is present by default |
| `model` | empty (CLI default) | Fixed model id such as `gemini-2.5-flash`; becomes one `--model` argument |
| `permission` | `allow` | Auto-answer for child permission requests: `allow` approves (edits/shell), `reject` declines (read-only) |
| `env` | `{}` | Extra environment variables layered over the credential-scrubbed parent environment |
| `disposeEofGraceMs` | `6000` | Time the child gets to flush after stdin EOF before escalation |
| `disposeGraceMs` | `3000` | Failure-observation and SIGTERM→SIGKILL escalation grace |

Example — fixed model, read-only child:

```yaml
- id: subagent-gemini
  config:
    model: gemini-2.5-flash
    permission: reject
```

## Security and permissions

- `permission: allow` means **unattended**: the child may edit workspace files and run commands without a human
  approval prompt. That is what makes delegated coding tasks possible; use it in trusted workspaces and review
  `git diff` afterwards.
- `--skip-trust` trusts the parent workspace for the child session only, so a delegation never stalls on an
  interactive trust prompt.
- The child is a separate process with its own credential environment: DSH's subprocess seam scrubs credential-like
  variables from the parent environment; only variables in `env` are forwarded.
- No telemetry. No credential is read, logged or returned by this plugin; the key is managed by Gemini CLI itself.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| Delegation fails with a `process-start` diagnostic | `gemini` not found. `npm install -g @google/gemini-cli`, or set `command` to an absolute path |
| `Gemini API key is missing or not configured` | No credential. Write `~/.gemini/.env` as above (`chmod 600`) |
| `This client is no longer supported for Gemini Code Assist for individuals` | The retired OAuth login is in use. Switch to an API key |
| Child starts but never answers / times out | Check network reachability of the Gemini API; if it needs a proxy, put `HTTPS_PROXY` in the plugin's `env` |
| Want to check the machine setup | Run `npm run smoke` in the plugin checkout (costs one API request and prints PONG) |

## Compatibility and development

- Depends on the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp@0.2.1-rc.2`, so protocol work tracks the official backend;
- Unit tests: `npm test` (32 cases: config normalization, executable discovery, credential detection);
- End-to-end self-check: `npm run smoke` (requires an API key);
- Reference implementations: the official Codex subagent (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex`) and the official ACP
  backend (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp`); all three share the same `ctx.subagents` contract.

## Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile des

--- ## 它是什么 在 DSH 会话输入框上方放一块 **Agent Teams 可视化画布**：队长居中、成员在下、任务按依赖深度分泳道排列，中间用 **SVG 贝塞尔虚线**画出「谁依赖谁」和「谁正在做哪个任务」。 CC-haha 桌面端的 Agent Teams 面板有一套很好用的视觉语言 —— 泳道底板、虚线总线、任务卡状态徽章。这个插件把那套布局搬到 DSH 的 Web UI 里，用的是原版几何常量与路径算法，不是照着重画的近似版本。 ## 长什么样 ``` ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 🤖 Agent Teams [tally-squad] [实验特性] │ ├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ 3/6 2 8 1 │ │ 并行执行 完成 进行中 待办 │ ├───────────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────┤ │ 1 · 团队 · 队长居中，成员在下 │ 通讯 88 条 │ │ │ 全部 | 报告 | 私信 │ │ 🤖 team-lead ├──────────────────────────┤ │ 协调·等待汇报·收件箱 51 │ 👩‍💻 frontend-dev 17:15 │ │ ┆ ┆ ┆ ┆ │ P1 已修，mobile.png... │ │ 👨‍💻 🧪 🔍 👩‍💻 │ │ │ backend qa-eng reviewer frontend│ 🤖 team-lead 17:15 │ │ │ 后端 8000 已停... │ │ 2 · 共享任务列表 · 按依赖排层 → │ │ │ ┌─无依赖·可立即做─┐┌─第2层─┐┌收尾┐│ 👩‍💻 frontend-dev 17:14 │ │ │ #1 后端实现 ═══╪╪═▶#4 ││ #6 ││ 你抓到的真实 bug... │ │ │ #2 前端实现 ═══╪╪═▶#5 ││ ││ │ │ │ #3 QA 阶段一 ✓ ││ ││ ││ │ │ └────────────────┘└──────┘└────┘│ │ ├───────────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────┤ │ ┄┄ 依赖未满足 ┄┄ 依赖已满足 ┄┄ 正在执行 ┄┄ 刚解锁 ┄┄ 飞行中 │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ## 连线怎么画的 这是本插件的核心。四条连线各司其职： | 连线 | 形状 | 虚线 | 含义 | |---|---|---|---| | **任务依赖** | 三次贝塞尔，前置任务右缘 → 后继任务左缘 | `7 7` | 满足时用负责人强调色并流动，未满足用边框色 | | **队长总线** | 折线：队长脚下 → 横向总线 → 各成员顶部 | `6 6` | 汇报关系 | | **成员 peer 总线** | 折线：成员脚下 → 横向总线 → 成员脚下 | `4 7` | 同级通讯 | | **执行 tether** | 三次贝塞尔，成员脚下 → 任务顶部 | `8 6` | 正在执行该任务的成员，流动动画 | 依赖边的路径函数： ```js function dependencyPath(from, to) { const fromX = from.x + TASK_WIDTH const fromY = from.y + TASK_HEIGHT / 2 const toX = to.x const toY = to.y + TASK_HEIGHT / 2 const middle = fromX + (toX - fromX) / 2 return `M ${fromX},${fromY} C ${middle},${fromY} ${middle},${toY} ${toX - 5},${toY}` } ``` 泳道划分用「最长依赖路径」算深度，带环与缺失节点兜底： ```js function depthOf(id) { if (depths.has(id)) return depths.get(id) if (visiting.has(id)) return 0 // 环 → 回退 0 const task = byId.get(id) if (!task) return 0 // 缺失节点 → 0 visiting.add(id) const deps = task.blockedBy.filter(d => byId.has(d)) const depth = deps.length === 0 ? 0 : 1 + Math.max(...deps.map(depthOf)) visiting.delete(id) depths.set(id, depth) return depth } ``` 卡片是普通 DOM 绝对定位，连线是叠在上面的一层 `

# dsh-delete-archived

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin to permanently delete **archived** conversations.

[中文](README.zh.md)

## What it does

- **Host side** (`lib/entry.js`) registers two HTTP routes and one agent tool:
  - `POST /plugin/dsh-delete-archived/delete` with `{ "sessionId": "..." }`
  - `GET  /plugin/dsh-delete-archived/list`
  - Tool `delete_archived_conversation(sessionId)` — callable by the assistant in a conversation.
  - Deletion removes the session's JSONL storage directory (all format generations) and clears
    the workspace registry: the archive marker, the pin marker, and each workspace's session
    accounting. Sessions that are not archived, or still resident in memory, are refused (a live
    session would rewrite its log on the next flush and resurrect the data).
- **Client side** (`lib/client.js`) adds a "Delete conversation" entry to the per-session "..." menu
  in the sidebar, shown **only for archived sessions** (two-step confirm, inline error on refusal).

## Difference from dsh-archived-chats

The community index already lists `dsh-archived-chats`, which also lists and permanently
removes archived conversations. This plugin does not re-implement that capability: the
increment here is (a) a "Delete conversation" row in the sidebar's per-session "..." menu for
archived sessions only, and (b) the model-callable `delete_archived_conversation` tool. If you
only need bulk cleanup, `dsh-archived-chats` is the smaller dependency.

## Destructive tool

`delete_archived_conversation` is **model-invocable**: the assistant can call it without any
second confirmation. It removes the session's JSONL directory and its workspace registry
entries, and the deletion cannot be undone. The sidebar entry is the human-confirmed path
(two-step confirm); treat the tool as an automation-level capability and keep it out of
workflows you do not want deleting archived sessions on their own.

## Behavior notes

- Only **archived** sessions can be deleted; archive a session first.
- Deletion is serialized per session. Being still held by the host is not a reason to refuse:
  archiving already stopped the agent and the host's `ArchivedSessionGate` refuses further steps,
  so the log is no longer written; the response reports `heldAtDelete` as evidence.
- The session-search index in this deployment is `:memory:`/`openAt: never`, so no index cleanup is
  needed; deployments that enable content search clean up the SQLite rows automatically on the next search.
- Content-addressed image attachments may be shared across sessions and are intentionally not reference-counted.

## Install

```sh
# Local directory — quit the Desktop app first; --profile is required.
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <absolute/path/to/this/dir>

# From GitHub
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:<owner>/dsh-delete-archived
```

Then restart Harness so the new bundle composes. This package has **zero runtime dependencies** and
ships plain JavaScript, so a GitHub install needs no `allowBuilds` code-execution approval.

## License

MIT

# dsh-relay-reasoning

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Real reasoning levels — **off / low / medium / high / max** — on every model of your OpenAI-compatible relay, right in the DSH model picker.

## The problem

Relays such as a self-hosted gateway fronting many models accept the `reasoning_effort` request parameter, but DSH offers no reasoning control for them. The reason is structural: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` only publishes selectable levels for a model whose `reasoningEfforts` field declares them, so a route configured by hand shows nothing.

Declaring those levels by hand means repeating seven lines for every model — and re-doing it whenever the model list changes.

## What this plugin does

It writes `reasoningEfforts` into the `llm-pi-ai` profile entry for every model on the configured providers, and the picker immediately offers those levels. No restart, and no editing of your model list.

**It keeps up with your configuration.** The first pass runs at activation, and every later profile configuration reload — adding a relay or a model from the settings UI, editing a route — runs it again and fills in whatever is missing. A relay you connect while DSH is running gets its levels without a restart.

## Why these five levels

pi-ai understands seven levels, but a relay does not distinguish all of them. Measured over three prompts and two passes on one relay route, median reasoning tokens per level:

| Level | median reasoning tokens |
|---|---|
| off | 0 |
| minimal | 108 |
| low | 122 |
| medium | 155 |
| high | 142 |
| xhigh | 125 |
| max | 359 |

`max` is roughly double every other level, so it is a genuinely stronger tier and is included by default.

The five middle levels (`minimal` through `xhigh`) land within each other's noise on this route, so publishing them would only duplicate choices. They stay out by default but can be requested through `levels` if a route of yours does distinguish them.

If your relay turns out to ignore `max`, drop it with `levels: [off, low, medium, high]` so the picker does not offer a level that does nothing.

## Install

From the DSH workshop (Settings → Workshop → Plugins), or directly:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle → dsh-relay-reasoning
```

Development builds can also be installed from a checkout:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle → <path to this repository>
```

## Configuration

The plugin row takes an optional config:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: relay-reasoning
      name: dsh-relay-reasoning
      config:
        target: llm-pi-ai                 # profile entry id to configure
        providers: []                     # empty = every provider on that entry
        levels: [off, low, medium, high, max]  # published levels, ascending
        force: false                      # true = rewrite once at activation even if already correct
        debugLog: ""                      # optional file path for diagnostics
```

`providers: []` means the plugin covers every provider on the entry, so adding a new relay needs no plugin change.

`levels` defaults to `off, low, medium, high, max`. Narrow it if your relay ignores a level:

```yaml
levels: [off, low, medium, high]
```

Any subset of `off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max` is accepted; names are published in ascending order and unknown names are dropped.

## Idempotent

A pass writes nothing when every model already declares exactly the configured levels; it inspects and stops. Updating the package, and the configuration reload caused by the plugin's own write, therefore never churn your configuration, and any leftover declaration from a manual setup is detected and rewritten.

Changing `levels` does rewrite the affected models, because their current declaration no longer matches.

`force: true` is honoured at activation only — it rewrites once, including declarations that are already correct. Later reloads ignore it, because honouring it every time would rewrite the same declaration and reload in a loop.

## How it works

Three details are worth knowing if you read the source.

**It does not override the `llm-pi-ai` row.** A Cordis loader patch replaces a row's `config` wholesale rather than merging it, so a patch that added `reasoningEfforts` would erase `baseURL`, the credential reference, and the whole model list. The plugin instead calls `settings.mutate()` with path-scoped operations, touching only `providers.<name>.models[i].reasoningEfforts`.

**It writes outside the transaction.** The HMR config editor refuses to nest transactions, and its guard reads an `AsyncLocalStorage` store that survives awaits and timers, so deferring is not enough. The plugin runs the write through `hmr.executing.exit()` — the same mechanism `dsh-hmr` uses when wiring a config watcher from inside a transaction.

**It listens to `app-boot/config-reload`.** Every successful profile reload emits that event — including a relay added from the settings UI. The plugin inspects once shortly afterwards; a reload caused by its own write only finds everything already correct and stops, so there is no loop, and a burst of events collapses into one inspection.

## Compatibility

- Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.1`.
- No runtime dependencies: only `node:fs` and Host-provided services.
- Works with any OpenAI-compatible route declared on the `llm-pi-ai` entry, not just one relay.

## License

MIT

# dsh-chinese-thinking

强制模型**思考（内部推理 / reasoning / 思维链）过程始终使用中文**的 DSH Host 插件。
回答语言不受影响，仍跟随用户提问的语言。

## 原理

向 `ctx.systemPrompt` 注册一个系统提示词段落（`dsh-chinese-thinking`，默认排序 `10`，
紧随部署人设前缀之后）。每次组装系统提示词时都会带上该段落，因此对主会话、
子代理与工作流子代理统一生效。

## 文件

| 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `src/index.ts` | Host 插件入口源码（对象形式 `apply(ctx, config)`） |
| `dist/index.min.js` | esbuild 压缩产物，`package.json` 的 `exports` 指向这里 |
| `dist/index.d.ts` | `tsc` 生成的类型声明 |
| `tsconfig.json` | TypeScript 编译配置（`src` → `dist`，strict 模式） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 把插件行 `dsh-chinese-thinking` 插入 profile 配置树 |
| `package.json` | 组合包清单（`dsh.bundle.patch`） |

## 开发

本项目为 TypeScript 工程，源码在 `src/`，编译输出到 `dist/`：

```
pnpm install        # 安装 typescript、esbuild 等开发依赖
pnpm run build      # tsc 出类型声明 + esbuild 压缩出 dist/index.min.js（安装 bundle 前必须先执行）
pnpm run typecheck  # 只做类型检查，不输出
pnpm run watch      # 监听类型声明，改动后自动重新生成
```

修改 `src/index.ts` 后请重新执行 `pnpm run build`，bundle 运行时加载的是 `dist/index.min.js`。

## 配置

在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 row `config` 中调整（patch 替换整份 config，请保留想留下的字段）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-chinese-thinking
  name: '@devilspiderx/dsh-chinese-thinking'
  config:
    enabled: true    # false 临时关闭
    order: 10        # 系统提示词段落排序
    text: |          # 可选：覆盖默认指令全文
      ...
```

## 安装

```
plugin_manager  action=install_bundle  target=<本目录绝对路径>
```

安装后如未即时生效（`restart-required`），重启 DSH 即可。
卸载：`plugin_manager action=remove_bundle target=@devilspiderx/dsh-chinese-thinking`。
