plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-split

[**中文**](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

**给 DeepSeek Harness Web 加一个自由分屏**——开一个分屏视图放在旁边，同时盯住两个、三个甚至四个会话；每个窗格渲染的是那个会话**真正的对话**，连输入框都能直接用。

![三个窗格](screenshots/split-panes.png)

## 功能

- **侧栏入口**：侧栏里的「分屏」按钮把分屏视图作为一个主面板打开。
- **自由布局**：向右/向下分屏；把一个窗格拖到另一个窗格上＝交换；拖到窗格边缘＝把窗格挪过去；拖分隔线改比例；**双击分隔线**横竖翻转并回到 50/50。
- **从各处填充窗格**：从左侧会话列表把一行拖进窗格、点行尾的「放入分屏窗格」按钮，或者用窗格右键菜单。
- **真对话**：每个窗格挂载官方的 `conversation.content` 槽位，流式输出、工具调用、附件、输入框的行为与正常视图完全一致。
- **未读点同步**：侧栏的未读指示同步到窗格标题上，一眼看出哪个窗格在说话。
- **导入运行中会话**：一次把正在跑的会话按窗格上限排进分屏，不会关闭任何会话。
- **布局持久化**：整棵窗格树（分栏、比例、分配）存在 `localStorage`，刷新后恢复。
- **中英双语界面**：插件自带中文与英文文案。
- **宿主侧零行为**：宿主那一半只负责声明客户端 bundle，不碰 Session 域。

![窗格右键菜单](screenshots/pane-menu.png)

## 安装

插件是一个带 loader patch（`cordis.patch.yml`）的 bundle，和普通 DSH 插件一样安装：

```bash
# 直接从 GitHub 装
dsh plugin --profile web add github:yuloop/dsh-web-split

# 或者从本地目录装
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-web-split
```

装完**重启 DSH**，然后刷新页面，侧栏就会出现「分屏」入口。

> `cordis.patch.yml` 用包名 `dsh-web-split` 指向 `index.js`。如果你是手工把文件拷进本地插件目录（而不是用安装器），把 patch 里的 `name` 改成 `index.js` 的绝对路径——开发机上就是这么跑的。

## 已知限制（重要）

在**窗格里点击文件链接或图片**会弹错误框：

```
无法打开文件 / sidebarRight: no session surface is mounted
```

原因：文件链接是通过右侧栏的 `sidebarRight.require()` 打开的，而它只认「当前显示在会话列上的那个会话」。全局的 `main` 面板不带会话上下文，所以这个调用会抛错。窗格本身照常渲染、滚动、输入；**只有文件/图片预览受影响**——想看文件就点侧栏那个会话回到普通视图，再点链接。

这条限制也正是本版本采用「面板式」的原因：还有一个「浮层式」变体（把网格浮在会话列上，让右侧栏继续工作），它换掉了网格所在的位置，发布时还不稳定，因此**不包含在 1.0.0 里**。

## 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness Web，且带官方 UI 包（`dsh-client-ui-layout`、`-session`、`-conversation`、`dsh-client-locale`、`dsh-api-session-controller`）。
- 开发与验证用的是 DSH `0.1.1-rc.2`。

## 目录结构

```
client.js          Web 端全部实现（面板、窗格树、拖放、i18n、CSS）
index.js           宿主侧：只声明 bundle，不注册别的
cordis.patch.yml   loader patch 片段（insert id: web-split）
package.json       manifest，含 dsh.client 声明
docs/DEVLOG.md     开发日志，逐日记录（中文）
screenshots/       README 用的截图
```

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Android companion for DeepSeek Harness | chat, goals, approvals & notifications from your phone, over your LAN. Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect. Relay and local network are two different setups, not two settings of one, so pick the one that matches wha

plugins.description: SOLIDWORKS for DeepSeek Harness: dsh models parts, assembles them, checks interference, counts the BOM and makes drawings in a running SOLIDWORKS 2016+, on the same PC or in a Windows VM. Your files read-only by default.
plugins.readme_text:
``` ___ _ __ dsh-solidworks / __| \ / / \__ \\ \/\/ / SOLIDWORKS for DeepSeek Harness: |___/ \_/\_/ model, assemble, check, draw and export, in the SOLIDWORKS on your desk ``` **dsh drives the SOLIDWORKS you already have open: 2016 and later, on the same PC or in a Windows VM on your Mac.**

21 tools · verified on SOLIDWORKS 2016 SP1 and 2019 SP0 · one bridge exe, no runtime to install, no admin · your files read-only by default · MIT

Watch it · Get started · Tools · What it will not do · How it works · Proof · When to skip it · llms.txt · 中文

---

**One paragraph in, a flange out.** You describe the part; dsh models it in the SOLIDWORKS on your desk, checks the volume against its own arithmetic (158,983.493 mm³ both ways), and looks at it from four sides. It can also put parts together, check them for collisions, count a bill of materials, make the drawing, and work on the files you already have, read-only unless you say otherwise. ## Watch it Every clip is a real session: dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 with `deepseek-flash`, SOLIDWORKS 2019 SP0 in a Parallels VM, recorded from the SOLIDWORKS window. The captions are the session's own tool calls and results, and its own closing words. Time spent thinking is fast-forwarded; nothing is cut or reordered. [How the clips are made](scripts/clips/README.md). ### Point at it You select a face in SOLIDWORKS and say what to do with it. dsh reads your selection (the flange's top face, 8 edges), rounds every edge of it at 2 mm, and explains why the volume went down by 360.218 mm³ even though one fillet adds material.

### Put parts together, check they fit A shaft is modeled, both parts saved, and assembled with the shaft through the bore and the flange 40 mm up. Interference: 0 pairs. dsh also counts faces that only touch, and points out that a 30 mm shaft in a 30 mm bore is a line-to-line fit. Then the bill of materials.

### Draw it The drawing lays its views out in projection at the largest standard scale that fits, brings in the model's dimensions, and comes back to your workspace as a PDF.

Left: the PDF as exported. Right: sw_view, four views on one picture, which is how dsh looks at what it made.

## Get started You need dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 or later (its `dsh plugin add` uses pnpm, so pnpm on the PATH) and a running SOLIDWORKS 2016 or later. ### dsh and SOLIDWORKS on the same Windows PC ``` dsh plugin --profile web add @dshworks/dsh-solidworks ``` Start SOLIDWORKS, start dsh, ask. The plugin runs its bundled `swbridge.exe` on the first SOLIDWORKS question; there is nothing to pair or install. ### dsh on a Mac, SOLIDWORKS in a Windows VM 1. On the Mac: `dsh plugin --profile web add @dshworks/dsh-solidworks`, then start dsh once. It listens for the bridge and writes a pairing kit. 2. In the VM, signed in as the person who uses SOLIDWORKS, open `\\Mac\Home\.dsh\dsh-solidworks\windows\` (Parallels shares your Mac home folder there) and double-click `pair.cmd`. That installs the bridge for that Windows user, connects it to dsh, and starts it at every sign-in. No administrator, no firewall rule: the bridge dials out to dsh, so Windows never opens a port. If you ask dsh before pairing, the answer says where the kit is. On VMware, another PC, or a Mac without Parallels sharing, copy the `~/.dsh/dsh-solidworks/windows/` folder to the Windows machine and run `pair.cmd` there. If the VM reaches your Mac on an address the kit did not list, set it: ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml - id: dsh-solidworks config: advertise: ['10.211.55.2'] # Parallels' usual host address ``` Undo it in the VM with `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-solidworks\swbridge.exe uninstall`. ### Any other MCP client, on the Windows PC `swbridge.exe mcp` is a plain stdio MCP server with the same 21 tools: ``` claude mcp add solidworks -- C:\tools\swbridge.exe mcp ``` The exe is in this package at `bin/swbridge.exe` and on every [GitHub release](https://github.com/dshworks/dsh-solidworks/releases) with its SHA-256. ## Tools Lengths are millimetres, angles degrees, mass kilograms, whatever units the document uses; field names say so (`value_mm`, `mass_kg`). Geometry is addressed in one space everywhere: model-space points `[x, y, z]` in mm, Y up, the front plane at z = 0, top at y = 0, right at x = 0. Faces and edges are picked by a point on them. `doc` is a path, file name or title of an open document and defaults to the active one.
All 21 tools | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `sw_status` | Release (2016 SP1, 2019 SP0, ...), every SOLIDWORKS instance, the open documents, and any dialog SOLIDWORKS is waiting on. Called first. | | `sw_open` | Open a `.sldprt`, `.sldasm` or `.slddrw`, read-only unless asked, and activate it. | | `sw_new` | A new, empty part or assembly from SOLIDWORKS' default template. | | `sw_inspect` | Type, units, configurations, material, custom properties, bounding box, body and component counts. | | `sw_features` | The feature tree with suppression state and rebuild errors. | | `sw_parameters` | Every dimension (`D1@Sketch1`, value, unit, driven or not) and equation, global variables marked. | | `sw_components` | An assembly's component tree: file, configuration, state, fixed, position. | | `sw_mass_properties` | Mass, volume, surface area, density, centre of mass. | | `sw_probe` | What is at a point: the face, edge or vertex there, with its surface or curve, area or length, normal or axis, diameter and the feature that made it. Without points, whatever the user has selected in SOLIDWORKS right now. Two entities also give the distance and angle between them. | | `sw_edit` | In memory, then one rebuild: configuration, suppress/unsuppress, global variables, dimensions, custom properties. Each change comes back with before, after and its own outcome. | | `sw_build` | Model a part in steps: sketch (lines, polylines, rectangles, circles, arcs, centerlines) on a plane or a face, extrude or cut (blind, through all, mid-plane, draft), revolve, fille

plugins.description: Pi 扩展 + DSH bridge：把当前上下文镜像成普通文件，由模型自己删除 stale block。灵感来自 Facebook Research 的 CLM harness。
plugins.readme_text:
# oh-my-clm

一个可直接加载到 Pi 的精简 live-context 扩展，参考
[Facebook Research context-language-models](https://github.com/facebookresearch/context-language-models/tree/main/clm/clm_harness)
的“把当前上下文镜像到普通文件、由模型自行整理”思路。

## 核心体验

Pi 为下一次请求构建当前 branch 的 projection 时，扩展会把可编辑部分镜像到当前 session 的临时目录：

```text
/tmp/clm-${sessionId}/LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md
```

`${sessionId}` 是运行时 session ID。多个 session 即使使用同一个工作目录，也不会共享或覆盖 mirror。旧版本生成的 `.pi/clm` 文件不会被自动迁移或删除。

模型可以调用 Pi/DSH 都提供的 `cleanup({ blockIds: [...] })` 工具，按 editable block ID 删除 stale、重复或自指噪声。cleanup 在一次工具调用内完成 host-side 变更，不依赖完整 block body 或 `old_string`。需要缩短已有 block 时，rewrite 脚本要在同一个 host-side 工具调用内完成 read+write；普通 edit 只适用于完整且未截断的 body。DSH 会等触发文件编辑的 session event 发布完成后再应用 native replacement，所以脚本必须在工具返回前写完，不能在后台持续重写 mirror：

```text
<!-- clm-v2 -->
<!-- CLM_SNAPSHOT ... -->

[[CLM_ENTRY id=1 role=assistant]]
这段旧内容可以被改写成一句更短的事实摘要。
[[/CLM_ENTRY id=1]]
```

- 只修改 block body；保留 `CLM_SNAPSHOT`、`CLM_ENTRY` 和 closing marker。
- `id` 是从 `1` 开始的可读编辑序号；不要改 ID，也不要重排 block。扩展内部仍用 Pi 的 opaque entry ID。
- 删除一个可编辑 block 会从后续 projection 中省略该消息；删除最后一个 block 时保留 `<!-- CLM_EMPTY -->`。
- 初始用户任务受到保护，不会出现在可编辑区域中；user-authored block 可以被省略，但不能被模型改写。
- mirror preview 有固定的单 block 和总大小上限；截断只影响显示，不改变 canonical source。
- `cleanup({ blockIds: [...] })` 按当前 1-based editable ID 删除 block；load-bearing block 1 始终保留，assistant/tool-result 配对也会整体处理。未知、重复、过期或协议损坏的 ID 会整体拒绝。
- DSH 的 runtime context 会包含当前可编辑 block 的 `<oh-my-clm-block-index>`，每条记录给出 cleanup 使用的 1-based ID、role 和短 preview。列表较长时只显示头部 40 个和尾部 40 个，中间省略并给出 ID 区间。`cleanup` 的 tool result 也会返回刷新后的 index。所以清理时不需要为了确认 ID 或内容去读 `LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md`；只有需要完整、未截断的正文做 rewrite 时才读 mirror。
- 如果工具结果读取了 `LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md`，该结果会在未来 projection 中替换成短指针，避免 mirror 自我复制。
- 改写或删除 assistant tool turn 时，配对的 tool result 也会一起处理，避免孤立的 tool message。
- 合法修改在 `turn_end` 通过 Pi 原生 `context_edit` 持久化；原始 session JSONL 不会被改写。

由于 context edit 属于当前 branch，`/tree`、fork 和 session resume 继续遵守 Pi 的分支语义。

## 试用

在仓库根目录运行：

```bash
pi --extension ./extensions/clm.ts
```

或以 Pi package 方式临时加载：

```bash
pi -e .
```

开始一项会产生几轮工具输出的任务。需要整理历史时，模型可以按 block ID 调用 `cleanup({ blockIds: [...] })`，也可以按系统提示对
`/tmp/clm-${sessionId}/LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md` 做同 call 的 rewrite/edit；手动压缩直接使用 Pi 原生 `/compact`。扩展不额外发送 “compact LLM turn”。

## 命令

```text
/clm
/clm status
```

`/clm` 与 `/clm status` 等价，Pi 扩展和 DSH 插件都提供。Pi 侧显示 mirror 路径、字节数、可编辑/保护 block 数、preview/canonical 估算 token、Pi context usage、目标预算、shrink-only 策略和 branch 上已持久化的 context edit 数量。DSH 侧显示当前 session 的 mirror 路径、mirror 与 canonical projection 是否一致、字节数、可编辑/保护 block 数、preview/canonical token 估算、DSH surface 节点数、shrink-only 策略和 mirror 限制；命令只读，不修改 session 或 mirror。两个宿主都不提供 `/clm refresh`。

扩展会在 session start、branch 切换和请求前自动刷新 mirror；没有 `/clm refresh` 命令。在 agent turn 之外直接修改 mirror，会在下一次同步时被恢复为 canonical projection，避免未经校验的内容进入 session。

## 预算与生命周期

`CLM_CONTEXT_BUDGET` 是一个近似的目标预算，不是第二个 context window，也不会阻止已经过大的请求。接近目标时，扩展会在 `context` hook 返回一条临时 nudge，要求模型只做一次 mirror 编辑；该 nudge 不写入 session history。没有设置预算时不发送 nudge。

超过 Pi 自身 context window 时，交给 Pi 原生 auto-compaction；需要手动整理时使用 Pi 原生 `/compact`。这避免在已经过大的完整上下文上再追加一次 `/clm-compact` LLM 请求。

```bash
CLM_CONTEXT_BUDGET=32000 pi --extension ./extensions/clm.ts
```

所有接受的 mirror 编辑都采用固定的 shrink-only 策略：按 Pi 的结构化估算，编辑后的上下文必须严格短于编辑前。不能安全缩短上下文的编辑会被拒绝。系统 prompt 等 mirror 之外的固定 token 会计入预算估算。

mirror 的显示上限是固定的：单 block 约 `12000` 字符，总 mirror 约 `96000` 字符。

token 计数使用共享格式层的 provider-independent `estimateMessageTokens(message)`，按消息分别估算。对当前 Pi 支持的 text、thinking、tool call、图片、system sections 和 tool declarations，它采用与 Pi host 一致的 `3.5 chars/token` 近似及 rounding。共享层不导入 Pi runtime，所以 DSH 的 `reasoning`、`tool-call`、`tool` 和其他自有消息形状仍走 fallback 估算。当前 Pi extension 的公开 `ExtensionContext` 只提供 effective system prompt，`fixedRequestTokens` 因此只计该 prompt；tool declaration overhead 只有在 host 传入结构化 system message 时才会被计入，否则这个估算就不完整。它不是 provider 的精确 tokenizer；Pi/DSH 自身的 context window 仍是最终约束。

生成的 `/tmp/clm-${sessionId}/LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md` 位于系统临时目录，不属于发布包，也不应提交到 Git。目录默认使用 `0700`，mirror 文件默认使用 `0600`；宿主仍负责临时文件清理和内容审计。

## DeepSeek Harness（DSH）适配

仓库同时提供一个最小 DSH/Cordis host bridge，契约依据官方
[`deepseek-harness`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/)（`master`）的 Cordis plugin、agent-loop、session projection 资料，并参考
[`dsh-ops`](https://github.com/T-Auto/dsh-ops) 的 Community v0.15 manifest 形态；它保留同一份
`src/features/live-context/context-format.ts` 镜像、解析、snapshot 和编辑规划实现：

- 社区插件发现入口是 [`dsh-plugin.json`](./dsh-plugin.json)，host entry 为构建后的 `dist/dsh/index.js`；官方 bundle 安装元数据位于 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 和 [`cordis.patch.yml`](./cordis.patch.yml)。在 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 中，实际生效的是 bundle 元数据；`dsh-plugin.json` 的 Community permissions 目前不应被描述为运行时强制隔离。
- DSH 生命周期使用官方 Harness 的 Cordis `agent/created`、`agent/pre-step`、`session/event`、`systemPrompt.section()`、`systemPrompt.context()` 和 `tools.register()` 扩展点；cleanup 直接对当前 session surface 执行按 ID 的 native replacement，不读取 mirror 文件。`systemPrompt.context()` 负责把 block index 放进模型可见的 runtime context；DSH 自己的 runtime-context snapshot 也会从 mirror records 中排除，避免 index 递归列出自身。普通 mirror 编辑的 `session/event` 只排队 reconcile，实际 mutation 延迟到 `Session.append()` 发布完成、且 `step/start` 打开新 step 之后执行；`agent/pre-step` 只等待已排队的收敛，不执行 mutation。session projection 仍由 DSH 提供，session log 仍是事实来源。
- DSH 会按当前 session ID 生成 `/tmp/clm-${sessionId}/LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md`。DSH 文件工具可以直接编辑这个 host-side mirror；sandboxed bash 可能拥有不同的 `/tmp`，除非宿主显式共享该 session 目录。
- DSH 注册 `/clm` 命令（`/clm` 与 `/clm status` 等价）：从当前 session surface 实时计算 mirror 状态，报告 mirror 路径、artifact 是否与 canonical projection 一致、字节数、可编辑/保护 block 数、preview/canonical token 估算、DSH surface 节点数、shrink-only 策略和 mirror 限制。它只读，不写 mirror、不追加 session event，也不缓存状态，因此在第一次 bridge pass 之前也能给出准确结果。
- bridge 会对 mirror 编辑执行与 Pi 侧相同的 snapshot、结构安全和 shrink-only 校验；合法编辑通过 DSH 原生 `Session.append()` 的 `surfaceOp: { op: "replace" }` seam 写入当前 session，处理后再把 mirror 重写为新的 canonical DSH projection。
- 当前 bridge 会改变 DSH active surface，这与 Pi 的 branch-local `context_edit` 不是一回事：cleanup 和普通编辑会追加 `tool/result` content replacement 或 `developer/message` replacement（omission 用空 content，assistant 改写用缩短后的文本），原始事件仍保留在 append-only session log 中，`deriveMessages()` 使用新的 surface。DSH 明确禁止 `assistant/message` 携带 `sourceEventSeqs`，而每个 replacement 又必须引用所有被遮蔽的节点，所以 assistant block 不能原地替换成另一个 assistant message。改写后的文本以 developer 身份进入模型可见历史，不再归属原模型回复。它不生成 proposal/receipt 文件，也不注册自定义 session event；reconcile 在事件回调之外串行执行，避免 `Session.append()` reentrant failure。所有 omission 和 assistant 改写都使用 append 时真正打开的 `turn`/`step`（正数），`tool/result` replacement 保持原 event envelope、只改 `content`，并带 `sourceEventSeqs: [targetSeq]`。
- host entry 不复制 `dsh-ops` 的 Rust 工具、shell、PTC 或 TUI 矩阵，只做 live-context 适配。DSH 仅依赖 host 提供的 Cordis 生命周期，运行时不导入 Pi 的 coding-agent 包。

安装 DSH bundle 时，按官方 Harness 的插件管理流程把本仓库目录（或 `npm pack` 产物）交给当前 profile；不要手写 profile 的 `package.json`、`dsh.profile` 或 `cordis.patch.yml`。外部 E-012 报告验证了 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 的安装、Cordis activation、system prompt 和真实 mirror/file-tool 路径；本地实现另外依据官方 Harness commit `1517a4dbca0a2789ff1d41ba439600f8547d23fa` 的 `Session.append()`/surface replacement 契约，通过 mock seam 回归测试验证 active-surface mutation。

版本更新说明（0.1.0–0.1.6）已移至 [changelog.md](./changelog.md)。

本地检查 DSH bridge：

```bash
npm test
npm run check
npm run typecheck
npm pack --dry-run
```

如果要交给 DSH 插件管理器安装，使用专门的 DSH 打包脚本：

```bash
npm run build:dsh:plugin
# 默认输出：artifacts/oh-my-clm-<version>.tgz

# 也可以指定输出目录或具体文件
node scripts/build-dsh-plugin.mjs ./out
node scripts/build-dsh-plugin.mjs --output ./out/oh-my-clm.tgz
```

这个脚本会先编译并检查 host entry，再生成只包含 DSH host、运行时 `dist`、manifest、bundle patch、locale、icon 的 npm tgz；Pi extension、TypeScript 源码、测试文件和开发依赖不会进入该专用包。`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 仅作为可选 peer 声明用于兼容性检查，不产生运行时依赖，也不得改回 `dependencies`（原因见 [changelog.md](./changelog.md) 的 0.1.1 说明）。普通 `npm pack` 仍用于构建同时包含 Pi 与 DSH 内容的完整包。

`npm run build:dsh` 会从 `src/features/live-context/dsh-bridge.ts` 和共享格式层生成 `dist/`；`npm pack` 的 `prepack` 也会执行这一步。仓库测试主要是 mock host 和契约/包检查；外部 DSH 验证报告另外覆盖了真实 CLI 安装、bundle activation、system prompt 和 mirror/file-tool 生成。DSH 文件工具运行在宿主侧时可以访问 `/tmp/clm-*`；sandbox 内的 bash 不一定共享同一个 `/tmp`，应按提示使用文件工具编辑 mirror。`Session.append()` 的 replacement 会走正常 `session/event` 发布路径；需要立即验证后端崩溃持久性的部署应由宿主使用官方 `session/flush` 检查点，插件本身不

plugins.description: Arknights PRTS Wiki lookup tool plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ark-wiki

为 DSH 提供一个模型可调用的工具 `ark_wiki_lookup`：查询 PRTS Wiki 的《明日方舟》数据（干员及其技能/天赋/档案/密录、物品、关卡、剧情），返回结构化结果，由模型据此作答。

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/wsk114514/dsh-ark-wiki)

> **非官方粉丝项目**：与 Hypergryph（鹰角网络）、《明日方舟》官方及 PRTS Wiki 均无隶属关系；所有游戏数据与 wiki 文本的版权归原权利方，本项目仅做实时查询与展示，仅供个人非商业用途。详见[免责声明](#免责声明与权限)。

## 安装

### 方式一：从 GitHub 源码安装（当前可用）

```bash
# 1. 装到目标 profile（把 web 换成 desktop / 你实际使用的 profile 名）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wsk114514/dsh-ark-wiki
# 2. 把包名 "dsh-ark-wiki" 写进该 profile package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 数组
```

### 方式二：npm

包**尚未发布到 npm**（npm 2026 年起要求发布者使用安全密钥 / 2FA，见 [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md) 的「已知阻塞」一节）。发布后改为：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ark-wiki
```

装完直接在对话里用自然语言提问，例如：

- 「阿米娅的属性、技能和天赋」
- 「至纯源石是干什么用的」
- 「1-7 的掉落和敌人」
- 「0-1 坍塌 行动前 有哪些台词」「12F 干员密录」

## 安装（本地开发路径）

插件是标准 DSH bundle（`dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`）。已实测可用的挂载方式：

```powershell
# A. 在 DSH 会话里用 plugin_manager 工具（推荐，自动完成 link + bundles 注册）
#    action: install_bundle
#    target: C:\path\to\dsh-ark-wiki
#    实测返回 {"stage":"enable","enabled":true,"changed":true,"application":"applied","warnings":[]}
#    并在 profile 里生成 node_modules\dsh-ark-wiki junction，
#    同时把 "dsh-ark-wiki" 追加进 profile package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles。

# B. 命令行（real syntax，注意 --profile 是必需参数）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add C:\path\to\dsh-ark-wiki
# 等价于在 %DSH_HOME%\profiles\desktop 里执行 pnpm add <该路径>；之后仍需把包名加进
# 该 profile package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 数组（或由 plugin_manager 代劳）。
```

**开发期热重载**：插件是 junction 链入的，改完 `lib/*.js` 后不必重启 DSH——在会话里对 loader entryId 执行一次 disable → enable 即可让宿主重新 import 模块（实测 `{"application":"applied","warnings":[]}`，随后 `Tool/listTools` 立即出现新 schema）：

```jsonc
// plugin_manager, action: set_plugin, target 用 entryId 而不是包名
{ "action": "set_plugin", "target": "include:dsh-ark-wiki", "enabled": false }
{ "action": "set_plugin", "target": "include:dsh-ark-wiki", "enabled": true }
```

注意：`set_plugin` 传包名 `dsh-ark-wiki` 会返回 `{"application":"failed","error":{"code":"unknown-plugin"}}`，必须用 `include:<包名>`（可从 `plugin_manager` list_plugins 里查，或读 profile 的 `node_modules/<包名>/cordis.patch.yml` 中的 `id`）。

它依赖宿主注入的 `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`（peerDependencies，宿主自行解析，插件不打包它们）。

## 工具契约

```jsonc
// 参数
{ "query": "阿米娅", "category": "operator" }   // category 可选：operator | item | stage | story
```

`category` 省略时按查询词自动判定：含「行动前 / 行动后 / 密录 / 剧情 / 序曲」或 `/BEG`、`/END` 时先当剧情查；形如 `1-7`、`S4-7`、`CE-5` 的代号先当关卡查；其余先查物品（仅接受完全同名），再查干员，然后关卡，最后剧情。

剧情类别同时接受剧情页标题（`0-1 坍塌 行动前`）与章节/活动名（`黑暗时代·上`）；后者返回 `candidates`（最多 8 条），模型可据此再查具体标题。

返回值是一个 canonical JSON envelope（`output.schema` 已声明，`additionalProperties: false`）：

| 字段 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | `ok` / `not_found` / `error` |
| `category` | `operator` / `item` / `stage` / `story` / `unknown` |
| `query` | 原始查询词 |
| `matchedBy` | `exact` / `prefix` / `fuzzy` / `redirect` / `search` / `none` |
| `entry` | 命中条目的结构化数据（`type: 'json'` 节点，字段随类别而定） |
| `candidates` | 未命中时的近似条目建议（最多 8 条） |
| `message` | 给模型看的说明（模糊匹配、未找到、错误原因） |
| `source` | `{ endpoint, page }`，可回溯到 PRTS 页面 |

`render(args, value)` 把 envelope 渲染成 `[{ type: 'text', text }]` 的 Markdown 摘要；非精确命中会附「匹配说明」，末尾附 PRTS 来源链接。

`entry` 的主要字段（`entry.category` 表明类别，`entry.url` 指向 PRTS 页面）：

- `operator`：`name`、`aliases[]`（中/英/日其他名称）、`stars`、`profession`、`subProfession`、`position`、`tags[]`、`feature`、`nation`、`organization`、`team`、`race`、`sex`、`birthday`（如 `12月23日`）、`designer`、`painter`、`obtainMethod[]`、`releasedAt`、`id`、`index`、`page`
  - `skills[]`：`{ index, name, nameEn, nameJa, chargeType, triggerType, unlock, levels[] }`，`levels[]` 为 `{ level, description, initialSp, spCost, duration }`（`level` 形如 `1级`…`7级`、`专1`…`专3`）
  - `talents[]`：`{ slot, name, levels[] }`，`levels[]` 为 `{ condition, effect, potentialEffect }`（`condition` 如 `精英2 X模组3级`，`potentialEffect` 为满潜时的效果）
  - `buildingSkills[]`：`{ name, phase, level }`（基建技能）
  - `profile`：体检档案，`{ gender, combatExperience, birthplace, birthday, race, height, infectionStatus, infected, physicalStrength, mobility, endurance, tactics, combatSkill, artsAdaptability, cellFusionRate, crystalDensity }`（缺失字段省略；六维为「优良/标准/普通…」评级文本）
  - `archives[]`：`{ title, condition, text }`（基础档案、综合体检测试、客观履历、临床诊断分析、晋升记录等；`？？？` 占位段被过滤）
  - `records[]`：`{ set, index, page, url }`（干员密录：密录集名、第几话、PRTS 页面；`page` 可直接用 `category: story` 查台词）
- `item`：`name`、`itemId`、`rarity`（0 起算）、`rarityStars`、`kind`（分类）、`description`、`usage`、`obtain`、`page`
- `stage`：`code`、`name`、`type`、`subtype`、`difficulty`、`sanityCost`、`region`、`unlock`、`recommendedLevel`、`squadLimit`、`initialCost`、`costLimit`、`lifePoints`、`enemyCount`、`mapSize`、`fastestClear`、`drillCost`、`description`、`firstClearDrops[]`、`normalDrops[]`、`extraMateriel[]`、`reward`、`terrain`、`note`、`challenge{}`、`enemies[]`、`id`（游戏内部关卡 ID）、`story{}`（`{ before, after, extra? }`，每项 `{ title, page, url }`）、`page`
- `story`：`title`、`storyType`（主线/活动/干员密录…）、`storyGroup`（章节目录标题）、`chapter`、`kind`（`主线剧情`/`活动剧情`/`特殊剧情`/`干员密录`）、`textPath`（剧本资源路径）、`characters[]`（登场角色前 20）、`lineCount`、`truncated`、`lines[]`（最多 60 条，`{ speaker, text }`，`speaker` 为 null 表示旁白）、`operator`（干员密录所属干员）、`page`

掉落项形如 `{ name, condition }`（`condition` 为「固定掉落」「三星获得」等，可能为 null）；敌人项形如 `{ name, count, level }`。

## 免责声明与权限

- **非官方**：本项目是第三方粉丝工具，与上海鹰角网络科技有限公司（Hypergryph）、《明日方舟》官方运营方以及 PRTS Wiki 维护团队均无任何隶属或授权关系。
- **版权**：干员资料、剧情台词、物品描述等文本在运行时从 PRTS Wiki 实时读取，其版权归原权利方所有。本项目不打包、不分发、不缓存到磁盘；仅将单次查询结果交给当前对话中的模型用于回答。
- **用途**：仅供个人学习、研究与非商业查询使用。请遵守 PRTS Wiki 的访问规则，不要用本插件做批量抓取或高频轮询（插件内部有 10 分钟内存缓存与 8–12 秒超时）。
- **权限范围**：只读。仅通过 HTTPS 访问 `prts.wiki` 的公开 `api.php`；不读取本地文件、不读取任何凭据或环境变量、不上传对话内容、无遥测、无需 API Key。网络请求可通过宿主的 `AbortSignal` 取消。
- **风险**：查询结果依赖 PRTS 的页面模板结构（详见[已知限制](#已知限制)），PRTS 改版时相应字段会降级为空而不是编造数据；模型回答前应核对返回的 `source` 链接。

## 数据来源

全部走 PRTS 官方接口 `https://prts.wiki/api.php`，没有第三方爬虫或缓存服务：

1. **干员**：`ark-info` 包（`getOperators({ extraFields })`）→ 内部使用 MediaWiki Cargo `chara` / `chara_extra_info` / `char_obtain` 三张表。干员列表在进程内缓存 10 分钟，并按 zh/en/ja 名称建索引。
2. **技能 / 天赋**：PRTS **没有**这两类数据的 Cargo 表（`action=cargotables` 只返回 `building_skill2`、`char_building_skill`、`char_memory`、`char_mod`、`chara`、`chara_data`、`item`、`loot` 等），所以改为解析干员页 wikitext：`{{技能|…}}`/`{{技能2|…}}` 每个模板块一个技能（模板名的数字后缀随技能而变，**不是**槽位号），`{{天赋列表3|…}}` 里的 `天赋N`/`天赋N效果`/`天赋N条件` 与 `潜能增强_天赋N*`。基建技能另外走 Cargo `char_building_skill`（按 `_pageName` 过滤）。页面结果按干员缓存 10 分钟；页面取不到时静默降级为「只有基础档案」，不影响其余字段。
3. **物品**：Cargo `item` 表（`where: name LIKE '%关键词%'`）拿 `itemId`/`rarity`/`description`，再取页面 `{{道具信息}}` 模板补 `用途`/`获得方式`/`分类`（补全失败不影响主结果）。
4. **关卡**：直接按标题取页面正文，解析 `{{普通关卡信息}}` / `{{剿灭关卡信息}}` / `{{突袭关卡信息}}` / `{{敌方情报}}`；标题不存在时用 `action=query&list=search` 找候选页再解析前 3 个。命中后还会用剧情索引补出关联的「行动前 / 行动后」剧情链接。
5. **剧情**：PRTS 同样**没有**剧情 Cargo 表，所以分两条腿：① `Template:剧情导航`（约 146 KB）按表格行解析出 1700+ 条剧情页链接与所属章节/类型，得到「标题 → 页面」索引；② `char_memory` Cargo 表提供干员密录的 `storySetName/storyIndex/storyTxt`（`storyTxt` 是页面指针）。命中后取剧情页 wikitext 里的 `{{剧情模拟器|…}}`，解析 `剧情类型`/`剧情分组`/`文本路径` 与 `文本数据` 演出脚本（`[name="杜宾"] 台词`、`[Character(...)]`、`[Dialog]` 等），台词截断到 60 条。两个索引各缓存 10 分钟。
6. **干员档案**：解析干员页的 `{{人员档案set|…}}`（体检档案键值）与 `{{人员档案|档案N=…|档案N条件=…|档案N文本=…}}`（档案资料多段），与技能/天赋共用同一次页面请求。

`lib/prts.js` 负责 HTTP 细节：默认 8 秒超时（干员页/剧情索引放宽到 12 秒）、网络/5xx 重试 1 次、`AbortSignal` 透传（宿主取消会真正中断请求）、API 错误包装成 `PrtsError`。工具整体 `timeoutMs: 30000`：首次调用要先拉干员列表（约 1 秒，PRTS 偶尔到 10 秒）+ 详情页，后续命中缓存。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-ark-wiki/
├── package.json         # name/version/type/exports/dsh.bundle.patch/peerDependencies
├── cordis.patch.yml     # 插件加载补丁（- insert: id: dsh-ark-wiki）
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js         # defineTool 定义、output schema、render、apply(ctx)
│   ├── prts.js          # PRTS HTTP 层：apiGet / cargoQuery / searchTitles / pageContent / 模板解析
│   └── sources.js       # 四类词条解析（含剧情/密录/档案）、匹配评分、缓存、resolveLookup 调度
├── tools/
│   └── harness.mjs      # 本地契约 + 数据端到端测试（node tools/harness.mjs live）
├── README.md
├── LICENSE              # 代码 MIT；数据版权归属见文件末尾
└── RELEASING.md         # 发布清单（npm + GitHub topic + 收录站提交）
```

## 本地测试

```powershell
node tools/harness.mjs offline   # 不联网：schema 编译、参数校验、apply(ctx) 生命周期、effect 清理
node tools/harness.mjs live      # 联网：17 个真实查询 + 期望断言（技能/天赋/档案/密录/剧情），输出 allValid
$env:HARNESS_

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 本地音乐播放器插件：树形歌单、直接流式播放、零 token 消耗
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-music-local

DeepSeek Harness 的**本地音乐播放器**插件。把一个音乐根目录下的**每个子目录（树形，任意深度）当成一个播放列表**，直接流式播放，不改动、不转存、不读取音频文件头。

设计目标：**零 token 消耗**。

> 要求：DSH `>= 0.2.0`、Node `>= 20`。可选依赖 `ffmpeg`（仅 dts / dsd / ape 这类需要转码的格式用到）。


---

## 为什么是零 token

插件刻意**不**做下面任何一件事：

| 常见做法 | 本插件 |
| --- | --- |
| `ctx.tools.register(...)` 注册 `music_play` 之类的模型工具 | ❌ 不注册 |
| `ctx.systemPrompt.section(...)` 往系统提示里塞音乐库清单 | ❌ 不注入 |
| `inject: ['llm', 'tools', 'systemPrompt']` | ❌ 只 `inject: ['webServer']` |
| 把曲库内容塞进对话上下文 | ❌ 完全不进上下文 |

因此它**不会出现在模型的工具列表里，也不会撑大系统提示**。音乐库的浏览、搜索、播放、切歌全部发生在**浏览器半体 ↔ 宿主 HTTP 路由**之间，与 LLM 毫无关系。无论你放 38 首歌还是 3.8 万首歌，每轮对话的 token 开销都是 **0**。

---

## 安装

先在 profile 目录里把插件装成依赖（下面三种方式任选其一）。

**方式 A — 直接从 GitHub 装（推荐）**

```bash
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop"
pnpm add github:xiao000xue/dsh-music-local
```

**方式 B — 已经有本地源码副本**

```bash
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop"
pnpm add file:D:/dsh-plugins/dsh-music-local
```

**方式 C — 完全不用包管理器**

把本仓库整个目录复制到 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-music-local`。
插件不依赖任何第三方运行时库，有 `lib/` 与 `cordis.patch.yml` 就能跑。

装好之后，在 profile 的 `package.json` 里把插件挂进 `bundles`，然后重启 DSH：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-music-local": "github:xiao000xue/dsh-music-local"   // ← ① 依赖（随安装方式而定）
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        // ... 其它 bundle ...
        "dsh-music-local"                                     // ← ② 挂载
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

profile 位于 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile名>/package.json`（桌面端通常是 `desktop`）。

插件自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会被自动读取（由 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明），**无需手改 profile 的 patch 文件**。

> 用 `file:` 依赖时，`node_modules` 里是源目录的副本 —— 改了源码要重新 `pnpm install` 才生效。
> 想改一行看一行，直接用 `node_modules/dsh-music-local` 里那份改，或改用 junction/symlink。


---

## 使用

重启 DSH 后：

* **输入框下方**出现一条**播放条** —— 上一首 / 播放暂停 / 下一首 / 进度 / 音量 / 打开面板。
* 点右侧按钮展开**播放面板**（浮层，可拖动、可缩放，位置记在 `localStorage`）：
  * 左栏 = **树形歌单**：音乐根目录下的**每个子目录（任意深度）**都是一个歌单节点，
    ▸/▾ 逐层展开收起（展开状态记在 `localStorage`），歌单名右侧的数字是该文件夹（含子文件夹）的曲目数；
  * 右栏 = 选中歌单的曲目，支持搜索框过滤（在哪个歌单里搜就只搜它的子树）；
  * 点一行 = 播放（再点当前这首歌 = 播放/暂停），**双击 = 从头播放**；
  * 顶部 = 设置，可改音乐根目录、重扫。

面板里 `右键 / 悬停` 曲目可以看到解析出的「歌手 - 歌名」。

---

## 设置的存放位置

| 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `$DSH_HOME/music-local.json` | 音乐根目录、扫描开关等 |
| `$DSH_HOME/music-local-prefs.json` | 上次播放曲目、播放模式、音量 |

`$DSH_HOME` 即 DSH 的数据目录（桌面端由机器级环境变量 `DSH_HOME` 指定）。

---

## 格式支持

分成两条路：

**① 浏览器原生可播**（直接给出 `206 Partial Content` + `Range`，秒开、可任意拖动）

```
mp3  m4a  m4b  m4r  aac  flac  wav  ogg  oga  opus  webm
aif  aiff aifc alac  mp4  caf  3gp
```

**② 需要 ffmpeg 实时转码**（dts / dsd / ape 这类浏览器不认的格式）

```
dts  dff  dsf  ape  wma  asf  wv   tta  mpc  tak  ofr
ac3  eac3 amr  au   snd  mid  midi spx  m4p
mkv  avi  mov  flv  rm   rmvb wmv  mpg  mpeg ts  vob
```

转码走**管道**，不落盘：`ffmpeg -i <文件> -f s16le -`，边解边送。
已探到时长时会在上方拼一个**定长 WAV 头**，于是 `Range` 请求能换算成 `-ss 秒数`，**拖动进度条可用**；探不到时长则回退为流式 WAV（能播，但不能精确拖动）。

### ffmpeg 自动挑选

机器上可能装了好几份 `ffmpeg.exe`，其中不少是**精简版**（`--disable-everything`，只认识 mp4/mp3/flv），拿它转 dts 会直接 `Invalid data found when processing input`。

插件启动后会在常见位置搜 ffmpeg 并**打分**：

* `-muxers` 里有 `E s16le` → +4（能输出裸 PCM，转码才可用）
* `-demuxers` 里有 `dts` / `dsf` / `dff` / `ape` / `asf` / `avi` → 每项 +1

得分最高的那份才会被用来转码，且会被**真实解码验证**。找不到或只有精简版时，面板「设置」里会明确标注是 `完整版` / `精简版` / `未找到 ffmpeg`，第 ① 类格式依旧正常播放。

---

## 性能

* **扫描**：只解析文件名，**不读文件头**。3.8 万个文件约 **3 秒**。
* **缓存**：扫描结果常驻内存，只做一次；之后所有请求都是内存命中（`/manifest`、`/tracks` 从 ~3.2 s 降到个位数毫秒）。
* **列表渲染**：15k 行用原生 DOM + 分页（默认 300 条一页），不走 React 重渲染，滚动不掉帧。
* **曲名解析**：文件名里 `歌名-歌手` 与 `歌手-歌名` 混着来。用「**配对对象去重计数**」判定 —— 歌名只会配对到一个歌手，歌手会配对到很多歌名。比纯词频稳，能扛住「车载合辑里大量重名文件」这种脏数据。

---

## HTTP 路由一览

宿主半体注册在前缀 `/dsh-music-local` 下：

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/config` | 根目录、曲库统计、ffmpeg 探测状态 |
| POST | `/config` | 改根目录并重扫 |
| GET | `/manifest` | 播放列表 + 曲目清单（紧凑编码） |
| POST | `/rescan` | 强制重扫 |
| GET | `/tracks` | 分页取曲目（`?ids=1` 取 id 列表，`?q=` 过滤） |
| GET | `/track` | 单曲详情 |
| GET | `/browse` | 浏览目录（用于设置里选根目录） |
| GET | `/probe` | 探测时长 |
| GET | `/stream/<id>` | 音频流（支持 `Range`；转码轨用 `?t=<秒>&d=<时长>`） |
| GET/POST | `/prefs` | 播放偏好读写 |

---

## 已知限制

* 转码轨的精确拖动依赖「能探到时长」，个别损坏文件的时长探测会失败，此时该曲不能精确 seek。
* 精简版 ffmpeg 只能转 mp4/mp3 类，第 ② 类格式会播不了 —— 面板会提示，放一份完整版 ffmpeg 到常见路径即可。
* 播放器不使用音频可视化（`createMediaElementSource` 在 DSH 里会导致静音），这是有意的取舍。

---

MIT

# dsh-thinkingview | 轻量化QoL插件

本插件在DSH输入栏下方的**模型选择**左侧新增了快速选择**思考强度**的快捷选择栏。点击可快速切换，无需打开二级菜单，提高工作效率。

> 兼容性：在 DSH 桌面版 **0.2.1-rc.2** 可运行

## 效果

![效果](./screenshot.png)

- 插件运行时从当前模型适配器公布的 `reasoning.efforts` 读取思考档位，理论可适配不同模型；
- 与官方二级菜单内的思考挡位保持同步；
- 模型无档位时，整排按钮自动隐藏。

## 已知问题

- 切换时会出现几个像素点的横移。
- 部分插件的安装卸载过程可能会导致本插件的 GUI 界面暂时失效，重启即可。

## 安装 / 卸载

不发布到 npm。两种装法任选其一。

### 方式一：直接从 GitHub 安装（推荐）

```powershell
# <DSH 安装目录> = DeepSeek Harness 的安装位置，dsh.cmd 在其 resources\runtime\cli\bin\ 下
& '<DSH 安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile desktop add github:Yulu224/dsh-thinkingview
```

### 方式二：clone 后挂载本地目录

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Yulu224/dsh-thinkingview.git
& '<DSH 安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile desktop add '<克隆目录>'
```

### 卸载

```powershell
& '<DSH 安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-thinkingview
```

plugins.description: Automatic same-session continuation, retry with backoff, goal revival, and restart recovery for the DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-autocontinue

A dsh plugin that keeps a session working when nobody is watching: it continues
the conversation on its own, retries through provider and network failures with
backoff, and refuses to let a goal session stall.

**Version 0.1.13** · verified on `dsh 0.2.1-rc.2`.

- [Why](#why)
- [What it does](#what-it-does)
- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Behaviour](#behaviour)
  - [1. Continuation](#1-continuation)
  - [2. Retry through outages](#2-retry-through-outages)
  - [3. Goal revival](#3-goal-revival)
- [Working with the goal round driver](#working-with-the-goal-round-driver)
- [Visibility](#visibility)
- [Commands](#commands)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [Install and update](#install-and-update)
- [Hard-won notes](#hard-won-notes)

## Why

A long unattended run dies in three boring ways: the model stops after one turn
and waits for a human; the uplink drops and the turn ends in `TRANSPORT`; or a
goal quietly loses its activation edge — the round driver disarms a goal on
error, and a session resume or fork deliberately leaves it disarmed. The work is
still perfectly resumable in all three cases. This plugin resumes it.

## What it does

| | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| **Continues** | An armed session's idle agent gets the next round queued for it, instead of waiting for a human to type "continue". |
| **Retries** | A turn that failed on the provider or network is retried forever by default, with exponential backoff that plateaus at a constant 5-minute interval. |
| **Revives** | A goal that stopped being driven — disarmed after a failure, left disarmed by a resume/fork, or paused — is re-armed so the objective keeps moving. |

Nothing runs until a session is **armed** (see [Quick start](#quick-start)).

## Quick start

```sh
# 1. install into a profile (see Install and update for the why-tarball)
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-autocontinue-0.1.4.tgz

# 2. arm the current session, from the session itself
/autocontinue on
```

Goal sessions arm themselves (`goalSessions: true`). Profiles that launch
sessions rather than a human — cron, headless, "called in" — set
`enabled: true` and get it for every session in that profile.

## Behaviour

### 1. Continuation

When an armed session's agent goes idle, the plugin queues a round: a normal user
message headed `<autocontinue> Round n/…` that tells the model to keep going, to
treat the workspace and tool results as authoritative, and to end its reply with
the done marker when the assignment is genuinely finished. The transcript reads
as an ordinary conversation.

The loop stops when any of these is true: the model ends a reply with the done
marker (`AUTOCONTINUE: DONE`), a turn is aborted (you hit stop — a human
interrupt is respected), `maxRounds` is reached, or you run `/autocontinue off`.

### 2. Retry through outages

Defaults are tuned for an unreliable uplink — retry **forever**, backing off to a
constant 5-minute interval:

| Consecutive failure | Wait before the retry |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 15 s |
| 2 | 30 s |
| 3 | 60 s |
| 4 | 2 min |
| 5 | 4 min |
| 6+ | **5 min, forever** (unless `maxRetries` is set) |

Each retry round names the exact failure and instructs the model to retry the
action that failed rather than restart completed work. Set `maxRetries` to give
up after N, or leave it at `0` to ride out an outage of any length.

Two implementation facts that matter if you touch this code:

- The retry is driven by `turn/end` with `reason.kind === 'error'` — the turn
  boundary that owns a failed request, carrying the harness's structured
  `LlmFailure` (`TRANSPORT`, `AUTH`, …).
- `agent/error` is deliberately **not** counted. A failed turn emits
  `agent/error` first and then `turn/end` with the same failure; counting both
  burned two retry credits per outage, so `maxRetries: 2` gave up after a single
  real retry. `turn/end` is the only counter.

### 3. Goal revival

A goal stops being driven for reasons unrelated to the objective, and a stalled
goal is worse than a failed turn because nothing retries it:

- the round driver **disarms** a goal on `agent/error`, so one network blip ends
  the goal's own continuation;
- a session **resume or fork** leaves an active goal disarmed by design (the
  driver never revives work on its own);
- the goal can be **paused**.

With `reviveGoals: true` (default), the plugin calls the sanctioned
`ctx.goals.resume(agent, ref)` — which carries no caller-authority gate — and the
goal round driver immediately takes the rounds back, keeping the goal's own
round accounting authoritative.

Deliberately **not** revived:

- **`blocked`** — that is the model, or the goal-tool policy, stating the work
  cannot proceed. Overriding it would fight the harness's own repeated-blocking
  policy.
- A goal whose **round budget is spent** — `resume` would throw; `maxGoalRounds`
  is the goal's decision to make, not this plugin's.

Revivals are capped by `maxGoalRevives` (default 5) so something that keeps
pausing a goal cannot ping-pong with it forever; the counter resets as soon as
the goal actually starts a round. Every revival is announced in the chat.

### 4. Restart recovery

A server swap (the `dsh-update` staged install + reload) or a crash stops the
process while a turn is still open: the persisted log ends inside `turn/start`
with no `turn/end`, and no live agent is left to continue it. On startup this
plugin scans the session corpus, and for every recently-written log that still
ends inside a turn it reopens the session through the same path the Web GUI uses
(`resolveAgent`) and queues a resume round.

That does three things the browser cannot be relied on for:

- the harness appends its synthetic `interrupted` closers, so the old turn is
  balanced instead of looking like a permanently running one;
- the session's agent preset and model selection are recomposed, and the goal
  round driver picks the work back up for a goal session;
- sessions with no browser tab still continue, which is what keeps a switch from
  orphaning work in another workspace.

The resumed session is told exactly what happened so it does not spend a round
working it out: the notice and the resume round name the durable cut
(`turn N, step M`), say the interruption was infrastructure — an update or a
crash — rather than a verdict on the plan, and tell the model not to investigate
it or re-plan from scratch. A goal session gets the same explanation as an
autocontinue notice riding the goal round.

The scan also reconstructs what the dead process owned, because a resumed model
cannot know it from the transcript alone:

- **Pending input.** The harness durably cancels queued inbox messages when the
  process disposes, so a message typed during a turn disappears on restart. The
  scan replays the raw `agent/inbox/spliced` history and re-queues messages
  canceled at that shutdown, deduped against input that is still pending or was
  already admitted (a steer move appears as a cancel plus a re-insert). The
  last handled cancellation seq is persisted per session, so a tab that
  reattaches and appends a fresh `session/end-seed` before the scan cannot hide
  the shutdown cancel behind a new resume marker.
- **Background jobs.** `job/registered` minus `job/settled` from the same
  generation is listed in the resume round. The processes are gone; naming them
  is what lets the model decide what to re-launch.
- **Subagent sessions.** Direct children of the resumed session created in the
  same generation are listed, so their work is not silently orphaned.
- **Active goals.** A session whose latest `goal/change` is `phase: active` with
  rounds left is reopened even when its last turn completed, so the goal round
  driver keeps the objective moving instead of leaving it parked until someone
  opens the workspace. Paused, blocked and complete goals are left alone.

Only logs modified within `resumeWindowMs` are considered, at most `resumeMax`
sessions are resumed per startup, and each session's failure is contained and
logged.

A resume notice looks like:

```
[autocontinue] dsh server restarted mid-run (turn 3, step 12); background jobs
from the old process are gone — c

plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）加密全量备份与恢复插件 —— 配置/会话/插件/工作区/Hindsight 记忆打包成加密分卷，带自包含还原器与 GFS 滚动保留，零外部依赖
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vault

**English** · [中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

**Encrypted full backup and restore for DSH (DeepSeek Harness)**

[![install](https://img.shields.io/badge/install-github%3Asoberkeen%2Fdsh--vault-2ea043.svg)](https://github.com/soberkeen/dsh-vault)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D18-brightgreen.svg)](https://nodejs.org)

> Packs **config / sessions / skills / plugins / workspaces / Hindsight memory / the DSH client installer** into
> **encrypted, chunked volumes**, written to a local directory and optionally pushed to a NAS (network share or WebDAV).
> Every package carries a **self-contained restorer** and a recovery ledger inside it, with GFS rotation and optional
> scheduled backups.
>
> **Zero build step · zero external dependencies**: the pure-ESM JavaScript under `lib/` *is* the source and the
> artifact. Only `node:` builtins are used — no 7z, no openssl, no rclone, no npm dependency — so it installs on any
> machine that runs DSH.
>
> Status (2026-10-17): **verified**. Real packages `core` (599 MB) and `full_all` (711 MB) both pass `verify`
> (plaintext hash and per-volume hashes agree) and `restore-drill` (30/30, 31/31). Runs on DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, with the
> settings panel, all six tools and the HTTP API exercised in a real injected session. Contract **checked against
> `0.2.1-rc.2`** — see [docs/compat-0.2.1-rc.2.md](./docs/compat-0.2.1-rc.2.md) (9 contracts, 8 unchanged, 1 additive).

---

## 1. Install

### From GitHub (recommended — the only distribution channel right now)

```powershell
# Official DSH CLI — maintains dependencies + lockfile + node_modules + profile bundles
& "<DSH install dir>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin add github:soberkeen/dsh-vault

# Pin a profile when you run more than one
& "<DSH install dir>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add github:soberkeen/dsh-vault
```

Then **fully quit DSH and start it again** (not the "restart" button on the crash dialog). A **Backup** entry appears
in the settings sidebar when it worked.

> **npm distribution is on hold.** The package name is reserved as `@lingfengmow/dsh-vault`, but npm's 2FA publishing
> policy (granular-token bypass of 2FA deprecated in 2026-07) and `npm publish`'s web-auth handoff disagree: the browser
> handoff returns 200 and the following PUT still returns 404. Six rounds of controlled experiments ruled out
> permissions, org, package name, token, network and client version. Full evidence chain in
> [docs/RELEASING.md](./docs/RELEASING.md). **Installing from GitHub is equivalent** — `lib/` is plain ESM with no build
> step.

### Local development

```powershell
# Hot injection, no restart (needs dsh-super-injector)
dev_inject_plugin  -dir "<absolute path to this directory>"

# Or write it into the profile (assembled from bundles on restart)
dev_install_package -dir "<absolute path to this directory>" -profile desktop

# Pack a tgz for another machine (no build step; the tgz is the artifact)
npm pack
```

**Requires**: DSH ≥ 0.2.0, Node ≥ 18 (the DSH runtime is enough), pwsh 7 (only for `restore.ps1`).
**Does not require**: 7z / openssl / gpg / rclone / any npm dependency. Docker is used only when backing up Hindsight's
Postgres database (`docker exec … pg_dump`).

### Self-check after installing

```powershell
npm run check                            # syntax gate
node scripts/client-register-test.mjs    # client registration contract, 8 assertions, must be all green
node scripts/health-check.mjs            # 15 runtime checks
```

---

## 2. Six tools (the AI-facing entry points)

| Tool | What it does | Key parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `vault_scan` | Scan and preview by importance tier (P0 must-keep / P1 optional / P2 excluded), **no side effects** | `scope`, `includeP1`, `topExcluded` |
| `vault_backup` | Run an encrypted backup and write it out | `password`, `outDir`, `scope`, `includeP1`, `dryRun` |
| `vault_list` | List historical packages (grouping volumes of one logical package) | `dir` |
| `vault_verify` | Full decrypt plus plaintext/volume hash check (writes nothing) | `package` (required), `password` |
| `vault_restore` | Restore: unpack to `--target`, or restore in place | `package` (required), `password`, `target`, `inPlace`, `only`, `list` |
| `vault_prune` | GFS rotation (dry-run by default, prints the delete list) | `dir`, `apply`, `hardDelete`, `keepLast`, `maxTotalGB` |

> Tool schemas are guarded by `scripts/schema-gate.mjs`: top-level `type:'object'`, `required` a top-level array of
> strings, and **no** boolean `required` inside property nodes. Historically an invalid schema made whole
> DeepSeek/mimo sessions return 400.

---

## 3. Scripts (the command-line entry points, all dependency-free)

```powershell
cd <this directory>

# ── Gates and regressions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
node scripts/schema-gate.mjs      # tool schema gate (must pass before registering; wired into build.sh) → 6 tools + required semantics PASS
node scripts/policy-test.mjs      # GFS retention unit tests (10 cases: minKeep/keepLast/day-week-month buckets/size cap/chain protection/trash) → 10/10
node scripts/boundary-test.mjs    # boundaries and robustness (11 cases: empty dir/zero bytes/20MiB spanning frames/long paths LongLink/Unicode/multi-volume/missing volume/tampering/wrong password/per-file hashes/corrupt header) → 11/11
node scripts/selftest.mjs "G:\DSH-Backup\_selftest"   # end to end (scan→pack→verify→unpack→negative cases) → 12/12

# ── Real runs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
node scripts/core-drop.mjs --dry                                  # estimate only (strongly recommended first)
node scripts/core-drop.mjs --out "G:\DSH-Backup"                  # core: config+sessions+memory+installer+plugins+orchestration
node scripts/core-drop.mjs --out "G:\DSH-Backup" --scope all      # also include workspaces (02-workspaces)

# ── Verify and drill ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
$key = (Get-ChildItem "G:\DSH-Backup\_keys\*.key.txt" | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1).FullName
$pkg = (Get-ChildItem "G:\DSH-Backup\*.vault" | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1).FullName
node scripts/verify-drop.mjs --package $pkg --key-file $key           # verify (password read from the key file)
node scripts/verify-drop.mjs --package $pkg --key-file $key --target D:\vault-check   # also unpack to compare
$pw = (Select-String -Path $key -Pattern '^密码：(.+)$').Matches[0].Groups[1].Value.Trim()
node scripts/restore-drill.mjs --package $pkg --password $pw          # clean-machine restore drill (five-way cross-check, no side effects by default)
```

**Build**: `bash scripts/build.sh` — for a zero-build package this only runs the `node --check` syntax gate, the
schema gate and a required-files existence check.

---

## 4. Password and key policy

| Source | Priority | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `--password <value>` | 1 | Explicit; shows up in the process command line, fine for a one-off local run |
| Env var `DSHVAULT_PASSWORD` (name configurable) | 2 | Suitable for scripts and scheduled jobs |
| Generated automatically | 3 | When `core-drop.mjs` gets no password it generates a **policy-compliant random** one (leading capital + special character + ≥8 chars), prints it once on stdout and **writes it nowhere by default**; pass `--write-key` to persist it to `<out>/_keys/<package>.key.txt` |

- **A key file is a decryption credential**: leaking it means the package can be opened. Move it somewhere safe, or copy
  it down and delete it.
- **A lost password means the package is unrecoverable** (AES-256-GCM, no backdoor, no recovery channel).
- The password is **never** written into the manifest, into documents inside the package, or into logs.

---

## 5. Backup scope and exclusion rules

**Partitions**

| Partition | Contents |
|---|---|
| `00-installer` | The DSH client installer (the prerequisite for restoring onto a bare machine; **exempt from the L4 large-binary rule**) |
| `01-dsh-home` | `$DSH_HOME`: config / s

plugins.description: 会话模式：Qwen 出主意，工具由 DSH 真执行。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-qwen-mode

会话模式：Qwen 出主意，工具由 DSH 真执行。

A DeepSeek Harness bundle that adds a session preset (`Qwen 模式`). The preset is a copy
of the standard preset with only three things changed — id, display name/description,
and order — so its tool list is identical to the standard mode and every tool call still
runs through DSH's own executors, permissions and sandbox.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add <path-to-this-checkout>
```

Requires a provider that exposes the `qoder` models (see `dsh-qoder-provider`). With the
provider in `display` mode the tools would be shadowed by the provider's own copies; this
preset deliberately does not mount those.

## 与标准模式的差别

1. `id` / 名称 / 说明 / `order`：它是一个独立可选的会话模式。
2. 不挂 `qwen-display`（旧「照搬显示」那套影子工具）。drive 模式下工具由 DSH 真执行，
   挂影子工具只会把它们遮蔽成空转。

# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.description: Windows screen control for DeepSeek Harness: screenshot, mouse and keyboard input, UI Automation and window management as agent tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control

[![CI](https://github.com/xiangwriter-dev/dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/xiangwriter-dev/dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Platform: Windows](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%2010%2F11-0078D4.svg)](#requirements)
[![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4F7CFF.svg)](#install)

**Windows screen control for DeepSeek Harness.** Six `screen_*` tools let an agent look at this desktop and drive it like a person: screenshot, move/click/drag/scroll the real mouse, type Unicode text, send key chords, read the UI Automation tree, focus windows, and wait for UI changes.

Like Codex's computer-use plugin, but built for DSH on Windows with **no dependencies, no MCP server, no compiler**: a single Windows PowerShell 5.1 worker does the Win32 work, and the agent gets first-class tools, approval gating, and an emergency stop.

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [Tools](docs/tools.md) · [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) · [Verification](docs/verification.md)

---

## Features

- **Look** — full virtual desktop, one window (works while covered, via `PrintWindow`), or a rectangle; PNG/JPEG with optional downscale and a cursor crosshair.
- **Act** — click, double/right/middle click, drag with interpolation, wheel scroll, Unicode typing (Chinese, emoji), key chords such as `ctrl+shift+t`.
- **Understand** — UI Automation tree with control type, name, automation id, rectangle, enabled/off-screen state and values; window list with process names and rectangles.
- **Image-aware** — when the routed model accepts images, the screenshot is committed through the attachment service and returned as a real image block; text-only routes get the file path plus metadata instead.
- **Safe by default** — desktop input is gated by `inputPolicy: "ask"` (one approval per session), `Ctrl+Alt+Esc` stops all input for 30 s, and every call reports the cursor position it actually read back.
- **Cheap to run** — one long-lived worker per profile, serialized requests (~100 ms per action after the first), automatic restart, one-shot fallback when the host forbids piped stdio.

## Requirements

- Windows 10 or Windows 11 with an interactive desktop session.
- DeepSeek Harness (tested with 0.2.1-rc.2).
- Windows PowerShell 5.1 (`powershell.exe`), which ships with Windows. PowerShell 7 is not required.
- Optional: a model that declares image input, for screenshot understanding. Text-only models can still work through `screen_ui`.

## Install

### From GitHub (recommended)

```sh
dsh plugin add github:xiangwriter-dev/dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control
```

### From a local checkout

```sh
git clone https://github.com/xiangwriter-dev/dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control.git
dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control
```

In the desktop app, the equivalent is **Settings → Plugins → Install bundle** with the directory as the target.

### From a release tarball

```sh
dsh plugin add https://github.com/xiangwriter-dev/dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control/releases/latest/download/dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control.tgz
```

After installing, the tools appear on the next turn. The plugin row is called **Screen Control** in Settings → Plugins.

### From the plugin market (Discover)

DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 ships the plugin market as an **experimental bundle that is disabled by default**, and it has no built-in index: the Discover tab reads the index URLs you add. Enable the bundle once (Settings → Plugins → *Plugin market*; the package is `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-plugin-market-bundle`), then add this index:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiangwriter-dev/dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control/main/market/index.json
```

The index uses the harness's plugin market format 1 and pins the `v0.1.0` commit, so installing from Discover gets exactly the released code. See [docs/market.md](docs/market.md) for the entry, the update procedure, and the exact validation rules.

## Quick start

Ask the agent for an outcome, not a keystroke:

> Open Notepad, type a haiku about the sea, and screenshot the result.

A typical tool sequence:

1. `screen_windows { action: "list", title: "记事本" }` — is the target already open?
2. `screen_capture { window: "记事本" }` — look before acting.
3. `screen_pointer { action: "click", x: 640, y: 520 }` — click the text area.
4. `screen_keyboard { action: "type", text: "…" }` — type.
5. `screen_capture { window: "记事本" }` — verify the text is really there.

Pixels picked from a screenshot can be reused directly:

```jsonc
// 1) capture returns: source {x:0,y:0,width:2560,height:1600}, scale 0.625
{ "name": "screen_capture", "arguments": { "max_width": 1600 } }

// 2) click the pixel you saw in that image — the plugin maps it back to the screen
{ "name": "screen_pointer", "arguments": { "action": "click", "x": 400, "y": 300, "coordinate_space": "image" } }
```

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `screen_capture` | Screenshot the desktop, a window, or a region; returns path, geometry and (for image-capable models) the image. |
| `screen_pointer` | Move, click, double/right/middle click, drag, scroll. Screen or image coordinates. |
| `screen_keyboard` | Type Unicode text, send a key chord, or paste through the clipboard. |
| `screen_windows` | List top-level windows or focus one by title/handle. |
| `screen_ui` | Read the UI Automation tree of a window as text, with rectangles. |
| `screen_wait` | Sleep, or wait for a window title to appear. |

Full parameter and return contracts: [docs/tools.md](docs/tools.md).

## Configuration

The plugin row accepts these keys (all optional; defaults shown):

```yaml
inputPolicy: ask            # ask | allow | deny
capture:
  maxWidth: 1600            # downscale screenshots to this width
  format: png               # png | jpeg
  quality: 82               # jpeg quality
  keepShots: 20             # reserved for capture retention
failsafe:
  enabled: true
  hotkey: ctrl+alt+esc
  cooldownMs: 30000
bridge:
  command: ''               # override the powershell.exe path
  timeoutMs: 15000          # per-action timeout
  restartLimit: 2           # consecutive worker restarts allowed
  idleTimeoutSec: 1800      # worker exits after this much idle time
```

`inputPolicy`:

- `ask` — default. The first pointer or keyboard action in a session asks for approval; the grant is remembered for that session.
- `allow` — no prompts (only for fully trusted sessions).
- `deny` — read-only: screenshots, window and UI Automation queries still work, input is refused.

## Safety and privacy

- **Approval gate.** Desktop input is what a person's hands do; the plugin routes the first input action of a session through the harness approval channel. Screenshots and UI trees never prompt.
- **Emergency stop.** Hold `Ctrl+Alt+Esc` while any input tool runs (or before it) and input is refused for 30 seconds with `E_FAILSAFE`.
- **Elevated windows.** Windows' UIPI blocks synthetic input to processes at a higher integrity level (an administrator app). Run the harness at the same integrity level if you need to drive one; the plugin reports `E_UIPI` when it can detect the refusal.
- **Locked screen.** The secure desktop cannot be captured or driven; expect `E_LOCKED`.
- **Screenshots contain everything on screen**, including other windows. The plugin has no redaction; do not use it on a desktop with content you would not share with the model provider.
- The worker never touches the network. It receives JSON lines on stdin and returns capture files under your temp directory.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause and fix |
| --- | --- |
| `cannot start PowerShell` | `bridge.command` is wrong, or the host forbids child processes. The bridge falls back to one-shot runs automatically. |
| `SetCursorPos failed` / `SendInput rejected input` | The process is confined by an external sandbox, or the desktop is locked. Run the harness in the interactive user session. |
| Screenshot is black | Hardware overlay, DRM-protected video, or the secure deskto

# 🛡️ dsh-permission-rules - **1024 store channel**: `npm i -g dsh1024` once, then `dsh1024 plugin --profile web add dsh-permission-rules` (counts toward the [deepseek1024.com](https://deepseek1024.com) install ranking). [![Gitee](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gitee-mirror-c71d23?logo=gitee)](https://gitee.com/perrylink/dsh-permission-rules) [![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?ref=badge) [![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules) **Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness.** *Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not.* [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--plugin-✅-green)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![dsh-doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor/main/badges/PerryLink__dsh-permission-rules.svg)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor#verified-徽章) [![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-top-rated.svg)](https://dsh.market/) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-brightgreen.svg)](#) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/actions) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?label=version)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/releases) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-permission-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-permission-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules) [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)
--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**
